izzyondroid:com.dosse.dozeoff.name: DozeOff
izzyondroid:com.dosse.dozeoff.summary: Disable Doze on your rooted Android device
izzyondroid:com.dosse.dozeoff.description:
Since Doze was introduced in Android 6.0, it's been a constant source of pain for developers who can't keep background processes running reliably, and users who are constantly missing important notifications because the system automatically decides to kill background services. Some ROMs are worse than others, with MIUI being the worst offender and AOSP being somewhat tolerable.
 DozeOff automatically disables Doze when the system is booted on your rooted device, simple as that.
 On Android 12L and newer, DozeOff will also disable Phantom Process Killing.
 You can also choose keep the CPU and WiFi awake at all times, but this will drain the battery very quickly.

izzyondroid:de.storchp.opentracks.osmplu.name: OSM Dashboard Offline for OpenTracks
izzyondroid:de.storchp.opentracks.osmplu.summary: OpenStreetMap dashboard for OpenTracks without internet permission
izzyondroid:de.storchp.opentracks.osmplu.description:
Offline version of the OpenStreetMap dashboard for OpenTracks . Can be used as standalone GPX and location viewer as well.
 It shows a selected track with start- and endpoints on a map from OpenStreetMap based on the Mapsforge VTM library. This version only supports offline maps, which have to be downloaded manually.
 Join the OSM community and help to improve the map, see www.openstreetmap.org/fixthemap 
 Some offline maps can be found here:
 Mapsforge 
 Freizeitkarte Android 
 OpenAndroMaps 
 Some maps require special themes to render correctly! These need to be downloaded and configured accordingly.
 Some browsers (e.g. Firefox) require a long click on the link and "Open link in external app" and then choose OSMDashboard.
 Manual downloaded offline maps or maps shared with other apps can be opened from your Android device. Select the directory in the menu "Map directory".

izzyondroid:eu.heili.wormhole.name: Wormhole File Transfer
izzyondroid:eu.heili.wormhole.summary: A simple end-to-end file transfer app.
izzyondroid:eu.heili.wormhole.description:
With Wormhole, you can easily and securely share files of any size, with anyone, anywhere. Whether you're sending a document to a colleague, a photo album to a friend, or a video to a family member, Wormhole makes it simple and secure.
 Wormhole generates a QR code or a passphrase that the recipient can use to access the files. This eliminates the need for complicated file sharing setups or email attachments.
 The files are transfered using an end-to-end encryption, which ensures that your files are protected from prying eyes. This means that only the intended recipient can receive the files you send.
 Wormhole is also an open-source app, which means that the source code is available for anyone to view and contribute to. If you're interested in learning more about how Wormhole works, or if you want to contribute to its development, you can find the source code on GitHub at the link provided. https://github.com/wormhole-app/wormhole
 Overall, Wormhole is a powerful and user-friendly file transfer app that offers unparalleled security and ease of use. Whether you're a professional or a casual user, Wormhole is a great choice for anyone looking to share files securely.

izzyondroid:stasis.client.android.name: stasis
izzyondroid:stasis.client.android.summary: Backup and recovery system with emphasis on security and privacy
izzyondroid:stasis.client.android.description:
stasis is a backup and recovery system with an emphasis on security and privacy; no personal information is collected, no unencrypted data leaves a client device and all encryption keys are fully in the control of their owner.

fdroid:ca.littlesvr.everyonestimetable.name: Everyone's Timetable
fdroid:ca.littlesvr.everyonestimetable.summary: Looking for a prof's or friend's school timetable? Look in here!
fdroid:ca.littlesvr.everyonestimetable.description:
Everyone's Timetable is a mini social network for sharing timetables in your school.
* Save your own timetable in a school-specific format, so you'll have easy access to it all the time.
* Find timetables for other people in your school. No more hunting down timetables on professor's websites!
* Add or update a timetable for someone else, who can't be bothered to do it themselves.
Currently supports the following schools: Seneca College, Sheridan College. Contact us to add support for your school!
The app needs internet access to find, download, and update timetables but can be used without an internet connection if all you want to do is look at a timetable you already have in your list.

fdroid:com.ahad.macat.name: maCat
fdroid:com.ahad.macat.summary: Catalogue your wardrobe and browse it with a full-screen swipe feed
fdroid:com.ahad.macat.description:
maCat is a simple personal catalogue for clothes, shoes and jewellery.
Photograph each item and browse your wardrobe full-screen, one item at a

fdroid:com.dasp.worldcup2026.name: 2026 Football Fixtures Widget
fdroid:com.dasp.worldcup2026.description:
2026 Football Fixtures Widget shows the 2026 international football tournament fixture list with schedule and score-style home-screen widgets.
The app updates once per day from the public openfootball/worldcup.json data file and falls back to bundled CC0 fixture data when offline.
This is an unofficial fan app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by FIFA, the tournament organizers, or any football federation.
Features:
- Daily schedule refresh
- Bundled fallback schedule
- Fixture list
- Today view

fdroid:com.georgeyt9769.cardabase.name: Cardabase
fdroid:com.georgeyt9769.cardabase.summary: Lightweight digital wallet to securely scan, store, and manage loyalty cards off
fdroid:com.georgeyt9769.cardabase.description:
Ditch the plastic and declutter your wallet with Cardabase, a lightweight, secure, and open-source digital wallet for all your loyalty cards, tickets, and barcodes.
Built with privacy and simplicity in mind, Cardabase is entirely offline-first. Your personal data, card numbers, and scanned images never leave your device.
Key Features:
• 100% Offline & Private: No tracking, no data collection, and no internet connection required to manage your cards.
• Fast Barcode Scanning: Easily scan physical cards using your device's camera or import them from images.
• Encrypted Storage: Protect your sensitive cards and data with password-secured local encryption.
• Screen Brightness Control: Automatically adjusts your screen brightness when displaying a card for seamless scanning at checkout counters.
• Import & Export: Take full control of your data with easy backup and restore options.
• Modern, Lightweight UI: Fast, clean design optimized for daily use without bloat.
Cardabase is fully open-source (MIT License). Code and contributions are welcome on GitHub.

fdroid:com.martinmimigames.tinymusicplay.name: Tiny Music Player
fdroid:com.martinmimigames.tinymusicplay.summary: Android 1.0+ minimal (<20KB) notification based audio player
fdroid:com.martinmimigames.tinymusicplay.description:
This project is a light-weight, simple, yet compatible notification based audio player.
Supports Android 1.0+
It allows you to play audio and video files, like how you expected to. Most importantly it is designed in hope to make it compatible with different Android versions.
Its usage is as easy as opening or sharing the file you want to play with the app, or selecting it directly from the app. Enjoy your music!
This project is a branch from Little Music Player, but intended to be as small as possible, with only basic function.
You can find most information about Tiny Music Player just below.
Notices
The app will not be able to function properly without notification permissions being granted.
For Android 13+, due to new notification restrictions, the app will bring you to the settings page if the permission is not granted.
Features
- It's free
 Everyone should have the right to listen to music, therefore we aim to make it accessible.
- No advertisement
 We simply want a distraction-free experience for you, so you can relax and enjoy!
- Compact
 Less than 20 kB in size, one of the tiniest audio player apps on Android! No need to worry about bloated apps again.
- Unbelievably compatible
 Strangely addicted to support, we believe that nobody should be excluded due to an older device. Therefore we have theoretical support starting all the way back from Android 1.0, and tested support on Android 2.3 and above. Isn't it amazing?
- Clean & Simple
 No awkward layout, no hidden options and straightforward, so you can focus on the content. Enjoyment is key, right?
- It simply works :)
 Even in the modern world, there is always something seeming to fail. Luckily for you, this app was designed to work just like it is supposed to. It supports all audio types that your device supports.
- Minimal permissions required
 Have you ever met an app asking for a bunch of unrelated permissions? Have you ever had some strange requests reminding you of a malware? **Not this app!** The only 3 required permissions are notification, foreground service and read storage permission, so you know it's safe to use.
- No hidden third-parties
 It is completely open-source, and uses as little third-party libraries as possible.
If you worry about size, compatibility or privacy, this is the best app for you!
We use the foreground service permission to provide audio playing while using other apps.
we use the notification permission to provide playback control for audio playing.
We use the read storage permission on older devices to open the audio files. (not required for newer devices)
Issues and pull requests are always welcome!
Last update of Description:
- 27-01-2023 dd-mm-yyyy
Important:
- Please read the license!

Copy to clipboard straight from the Android "Share" menu.

fdroid:de.chadenas.cpudefense.name: Chip Defense
fdroid:de.chadenas.cpudefense.summary: A tower defense game with a microprocessor theme
fdroid:de.chadenas.cpudefense.description:
Chip Defense is a casual game for Android devices of the tower defense genre. It centres around a design of electric circuits and logical chips, evoking the good ol' days of 8 bit microprocessors.
The attackers in this game are represented as bits and bytes. To defend the cpu against them, the player builds chips in designated slots. These "towers" deal damage by operations such as subtraction, right shift, bitwise and, etc. As usual in these games, the chips can be upgraded in strength.
The game features "heroes of the information age": persons that had great influence on the development of modern computers. They come with a short biography und provide global bonuses that make the game considerably easier.
Currently, there are more than 25 heroes and heroines. The game comes with 32 predefined levels, but it has also an "endless" mode with randomly generated levels. Supported languages are English, French, and German.
Supported operating system versions: From version 1.58 onwards, Android 6 or later is required. Devices running Android 5 (i.e. more than 10 years old) should use version 1.57.

fdroid:de.jepfa.personaltasklogger.name: Everyday Tasks
fdroid:de.jepfa.personaltasklogger.description:
Track, log and schedule your Everyday Tasks 
Do you have the need of remembering what you did? Do you need to know about what to do next? Are you lost in your daily household tasks? Do you think your roommate does less than you?
If so, track and log your tasks with EverydayTasks and create schedules for repetitive tasks. See how much time you have spent for certain tasks, and get notified if a scheduled task is due.
 Core features of the app 
- Log tasks you did easily and quickly.
- Track your tasks to the minute.
- See statistics of your done tasks, e.g. how much time you spent on what.
- Create schedules for repetitive tasks with a custom interval and get notified when they are due.
- Use dozens of predefined tasks and variants or create your own tasks.
- Dark theme support.
For more information see everydaytasks.jepfa.de 
If you like the app please star it on GitHub

fdroid:io.github.kotchwane.bonavortaro.name: Bona vortaro
fdroid:io.github.kotchwane.bonavortaro.summary: Esperanto dictionary, with the whole Reta Vortaro, offline
fdroid:io.github.kotchwane.bonavortaro.description:
Bona vortaro is an Esperanto dictionary for Android. It contains the whole Reta Vortaro (ReVo), the free Esperanto dictionary, with its translations into more than 170 languages, and works without Internet access.
• Search in Esperanto and in your other languages, with or without accents (cx → ĉ), and with wildcards (*ologio).
• The most used translation first: "deviner" gives "diveni" before "duonkompreni"; rare or advised-against words after the others.
• Read clear articles: definitions, examples, remarks, links between words, and the translations in your languages, the examples' too.
• See which words are official (Fundamento, Official Additions), and browse the list of each Addition.
• Long-press a word to look it up, whatever its form: "arbojn" finds "arbo".
• Meet a word that isn't in the dictionary? The search suggests the roots and affixes it may be built from: "malsanulejestrano" = malsanulej + estr + ano.
• More translations in French, English and German: thousands of words that Reta Vortaro lacks, from Wiktionary, with a dotted underline in the articles.
• Definitions from the Esperanto Wiktionary for hundreds of words that Reta Vortaro lacks.
• Words advised against by "Vortoj de la bona lingvo" (labonalingvo.org), with what to say instead: "eskalatoro", preferably "rulŝtuparo".
• The origins of the words, which you can turn off: "akvo", from Italian "acqua", Latin "aqua" (Rajki's etymological dictionary, Wiktionary).
• After each example, the work it comes from; icons for the fields.
• Leaf through the dictionary from root to root, or discover a random root.
• Your recent searches, day and night colours, text size.
The app's interface is in Esperanto. You can search, and read the translations, in any of the dictionary's 170+ languages.
The name is a tribute to "La bona lingvo" by Claude Piron. Bona vortaro is based on PReVo by Neil Roberts.

fdroid:io.github.vendelin8.elements.name: Elements

fdroid:io.github.vendelin8.elements.description:

I take no responsibility if your life goes up or down based on this. Use with
attention and responsibility.

flathub:io.github.juancarlosbernal.Folde.name: FolderPlay
flathub:io.github.juancarlosbernal.Folde.description:
FolderPlay is a minimalist music player developed in Rust and GTK4. Its philosophy is simple: letting you enjoy your local collection by faithfully respecting your disk's folder structure—it doesn't group by artist, album, or genre. It simply respects your order.
 Designed with a strong focus on Lossless Hi-Res audio playback.
 Above all, simple and intuitive.
 Displays your music folders in the exact order you have them on your disk. Access to /home/music and secondary/network/NAS drives mounted at /mnt.
 Supports Hi-Res Lossless audio formats: FLAC up to 384 kHz / 32-bit, DSF / DFF (DSD) — DSD64 (352.8 kHz), DSD128 (705.6 kHz), DSD256 (1.4 MHz), DSD512 (2.8 MHz), and all other popular audio formats.
 HiFi audio output selector (PipeWire/ALSA) for passthrough with external DAC, or standard legacy output for compatibility (PulseAudio).
 Smooth folder navigation. Stores song metadata, cover art, and folder information in a local database — no disk reads required to display your collection. Populates the database in seconds and updates changes silently in the background, allowing you to manage large music libraries effortlessly.
 Anti Bad Bunny feature: removes any Bad Bunny song from your collection (for the sake of your mental health). Let's promote real music! (Files are not deleted from disk — they are just hidden, in case you have a relapse...).
 Instant search by song, artist, or album.
 Fluid adaptive UI for different screen sizes.
 Blurs the background color based on the dominant color of the currently playing track's cover art.
 Light and Dark mode.

flathub:org.jreleaser.cli.name: jreleaser
flathub:org.jreleaser.cli.summary: Release projects quickly and easily with JReleaser
flathub:org.jreleaser.cli.description:
JReleaser is a release automation tool. Its goal is to simplify creating releases and
publishing artifacts to multiple package managers while providing customizable options.
JReleaser takes inputs from popular builds tools (Ant, Maven, Gradle) such as JAR files,
binary distributions (.zip, .tar), JLink images, or any other file that you’d like to
publish as a Git release on popular Git services such as GitHub, GitLab, or Gitea.
Distribution files may additionally be published to be consumed by popular package managers
such as Homebrew, Chocolatey, Snapcraft, or get ready to be launched via JBang. Releases
may be announced in a variety of channels such as Twitter, Zulip, SDKMAN!, and more.

fedora-packages:diffutils/diffutils.name: diffutils
fedora-packages:diffutils/diffutils.description: Diffutils includes four utilities: diff, cmp, diff3 and sdiff. Diff compares two files and shows the differences, line by line. The cmp command shows the offset and line numbers where two files differ, or cmp can show the characters that differ between the two files. The diff3 command shows the differences between three files. Diff3 can be used when two people have made independent changes to a common original; diff3 can produce a merged file that contains both sets of changes and warnings about conflicts. The sdiff command can be used to merge two files interactively. Install diffutils if you need to compare text files.

fedora-packages:djvulibre/djvulibre.name: djvulibre

DjVu can advantageously replace PDF, PS, TIFF, JPEG, and GIF for distributing scanned documents, digital documents, or high-resolution pictures. DjVu content downloads faster, displays and renders faster, looks nicer on a screen, and consume less client resources than competing formats. DjVu images display instantly and can be smoothly zoomed and panned with no lengthy re-rendering. DjVuLibre is a free (GPL'ed) implementation of DjVu, including viewers, decoders, simple encoders, and utilities. The browser plugin is in its own separate sub-package.

fedora-packages:keydb/keydb.name: keydb
fedora-packages:keydb/keydb.description: KeyDB is a multi-threaded fork of Redis, an advanced key-value store. It is often referred to as a data structure server since keys can contain strings, hashes, lists, sets and sorted sets. You can run atomic operations on these types, like appending to a string; incrementing the value in a hash; pushing to a list; computing set intersection, union and difference; or getting the member with highest ranking in a sorted set. In order to achieve its outstanding performance, Redis works with an in-memory dataset. Depending on your use case, you can persist it either by dumping the dataset to disk every once in a while, or by appending each command to a log. KeyDB also supports trivial-to-setup master-slave replication, with very fast non-blocking first synchronization, auto-reconnection on net split and so forth. Other features include Transactions, Pub/Sub, Lua scripting, Keys with a limited time-to-live, and configuration settings to make Redis behave like a cache. You can use Redis from most programming languages also.

firefox-addons:2969550.name: Privacy Shield
firefox-addons:2969550.summary: See what websites know about you. Detects fingerprinting, trackers, and manipulative UI tricks. Works offline, no data leaves your browser
firefox-addons:2969550.description:
Browser extension that shows you what websites know about you. Detects fingerprinting, trackers, and dark patterns. 100% offline and private.
Fingerprint Detection 🔍
Detects 19+ fingerprinting techniques:
- Canvas - Drawing patterns unique to your GPU
- WebGL - GPU renderer and vendor info
- Audio - AudioContext processing differences
- Fonts - List of installed fonts
- Screen - Resolution, color depth, pixel ratio
- Navigator - User agent, language, platform
- Hardware - CPU cores, device memory
- WebRTC - Local IP address leaks
- Timezone - Timezone offset fingerprinting
- Plugins - Installed browser plugins
- Battery - Battery status API
- Client Rects - Element rendering differences
- Speech - Available speech synthesis voices
- Storage Estimate - Available storage detection
- Media Devices - Connected media devices
- Permissions - Granted permissions fingerprinting
- CSS Media - Media query fingerprinting
- Gamepad - Connected gamepads
Tracker Detection 📊
Identifies known trackers:
- Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel, TikTok, etc.
- Ad networks (Criteo, Taboola, DoubleClick)
- Analytics services (Hotjar, Mixpanel, Segment)
- Session replay tools
- Social media widgets
- Tracking cookies & URL parameters
- Bounce trackers & beacon trackers
API Monitoring
Alerts when pages access:
- Geolocation
- Camera / Microphone
- Clipboard (read/write)
- Notifications
- Local storage usage
Dark Patterns (16 categories)
Detects manipulative UI patterns:
- Confirmshaming - Guilt-trip decline buttons
- Visual Misdirection - Hidden/tiny reject buttons
- Fake Urgency - Countdown timers, "only X left"
- Pre-selection - Pre-checked marketing consent
- Hidden Cost - Surprise fees at checkout
- Cookie Banner Manipulation - Deceptive cookie dialogs
- Obstruction - Hard to cancel/unsubscribe
- Sneaking - Adding items to cart without consent
- Trick Questions - Confusing double-negatives
- Disguised Ads - Ads that look like content
- Forced Continuity - Hard to cancel subscriptions
- Nagging - Repeated popups and interruptions
- Privacy Zuckering - Confusing privacy settings
- Social Proof - Fake reviews/activity notifications
- Roach Motel - Easy to sign up, hard to leave
- Notification Spam - Excessive push notification requests
Privacy Score
Each page gets a privacy score (0-100) and grade (A-F) based on:
- Fingerprinting techniques detected
- Number of trackers
- Tracking cookies
- Sensitive API access
- Dark patterns found
Settings
- Toggle individual detection modules
- Sensitivity levels (low/medium/high)
- Auto-scan on page load
- Show badge count on icon
- Notify on high-risk sites
- Highlight detected elements on page
- Whitelist trusted domains
Statistics
- Total scans performed
- Average privacy score
- Total trackers/patterns detected
- Worst and best sites list
Privacy
100% Offline & Private:
- All detection happens in your browser
- No data sent to external servers
- No tracking, no analytics
- No account required
- Settings stored locally only
- Open source

firefox-addons:2976476.name: URL Security Scanner
firefox-addons:2976476.summary: Privacy first URL security scanner. Inspect links for phishing, malware, and redirects locally before you click. Security without surveillance.
firefox-addons:2976476.description:
URL Security Scanner is a privacy first security tool designed to protect you from phishing, malware, and suspicious links without tracking your browsing history. Unlike other scanners that send every URL to a cloud server, this extension performs its core analysis locally on your device.
🛡️ Key Features: 
* Local-First Analysis : Instantly detects suspicious patterns, IP addresses, and known phishing indicators without exposing your data.
* Link X-Ray : Right-click any link to "Scan Target" before you visit. See the final destination, redirect chains, and risk score in a sleek tooltip.
* Safe View Mode : Open risky links in a sandboxed environment that strips scripts and harmful code, allowing you to read content safely.
* Redirect Tracker : Detects and warns you about excessive redirect chains often used by scammers to hide malicious destinations.
* Privacy by Design : No account required. No browsing history is sent to the cloud. External lookups (like domain age) are performed anonymously.
 Why use URL Security Scanner? 
Most security tools trade your privacy for protection. We believe you can have both. Whether you are checking a suspicious email link or verifying a site's age, URL Security Scanner gives you the intelligence you need to browse safely.

firefox-addons:3019734.name: SecurityShrimp APEX
firefox-addons:3019734.summary: APEX — the SecurityShrimp Anti-Phishing EXtension. Spot phishing before you fall for it.
firefox-addons:3019734.description:
SecurityShrimp APEX (Anti-Phishing EXtension) augments every page you visit
 with context-aware warnings that help you spot phishing attempts
 before you hand over a password.
It runs entirely in your browser. Nothing is sent to any server. No
 telemetry. No accounts. No data collection of any kind.
WHAT IT CHECKS
• Look-alike domains. paypa1.com , goog1e.com , arnazon.com , tvvitter.com 
 — homoglyph tricks that fool a quick glance get flagged against the
 top 20,000 sites on the web.
• Unicode / IDN domains. Punycode-encoded URLs (xn--...) are decoded
 and shown so you can see what the address bar is actually rendering.
• Misleading link text. When a link reads " paypal.com " but actually
 points at evil.example, a warning appears on hover.
• Insecure connections. HTTP-only sites get a warning before you type
 anything sensitive.
• First-time visits. Sites you've never been to before are flagged so
 you can pause and verify the address bar before entering credentials.
HOW IT HELPS YOU RECOGNIZE FAMILIAR SITES
Every domain you visit is shown alongside a unique color and emoji
 fingerprint, derived locally from the domain name. Your bank, your
 email, your work tools — each gets a stable visual signature you'll
 start to recognize. If you ever land on a look-alike, the colors and
 the emoji will be different, even if the name looks right.
CONFIGURABLE TO HOW YOU WORK
• Show tooltips on every input, only on password fields, or never.
 • Whitelist specific sites or wildcards ( paypal.com , *.google.com).
 • Toggle the misleading-link warnings independently.
PRIVACY
Everything happens on your machine. The extension uses your browser
 history (locally) to detect first-time visits, and downloads a public
 list of the top 20,000 domains once a week from Majestic to power the
 look-alike check. That list arrives bundled so the extension is
 useful from the first second after install.
OPEN SOURCE
Source code: https://github.com/SecurityShrimp-LTD/anti-phishing-extension 
 Licensed GPLv3. Forked from the original ZecOps Anti-Phishing

bluejetty:00036425:ios.name: Fruit Merge : Match Fun
bluejetty:00036425:ios.summary: Welcome to Fruit Merge: Watermelon Match, the ultimate fusion of strategy and relaxation! Dive into a world of juicy fruits and addictive puzzles where your goal is to merge similar fruits to create new ones and climb the ladder to fruitful
bluejetty:00036425:ios.description:
Welcome to Fruit Merge: Watermelon Match, the ultimate fusion of strategy and relaxation! Dive into a world of juicy fruits and addictive puzzles where your goal is to merge similar fruits to create new ones and climb the ladder to fruitful victory.
In Fruit Merge: Watermelon Match, your task is simple yet challenging: drop fruits strategically onto the board and watch them merge when they collide with others of the same kind. As you successfully merge fruits, you'll unlock higher tiers of fruits, each more delicious and rewarding than the last. But beware, as the board fills up, you must stay well below the spillover limit to keep the game going!
Featuring a delightful array of fruits and vibrant graphics, Fruit Merge: Watermelon Match offers a visually stunning and relaxing gaming experience. Immerse yourself in the tranquil sounds of nature and the satisfying pops of merging fruits as you unwind and sharpen your strategic skills.
But the fun doesn't stop there! Fruit Merge: Drop Puzzle also boasts an engaging leaderboard where you can compete with players from around the world for the top spot. Can you rise to the challenge and claim the title of ultimate fruit merger?
Key Features:
- Merge fruits to create higher tiers and earn points.
- Strategically drop fruits to avoid reaching the spillover limit.
- Relaxing sounds and vibrant graphics make for an immersive experience.
- Compete against players worldwide on the leaderboard.
- Easy to learn, but difficult to master – perfect for players of all skill levels.
Download Fruit Merge: Watermelon Match now and embark on a juicy adventure that will keep you coming back for more! Whether you're looking to unwind after a long day or challenge yourself with addictive puzzles, Fruit Merge: Watermelon Match has something for everyone. Get ready to merge, pop, and climb your way to fruity victory!

bluejetty:00026095:ios.description:
Introducing 'The Find my App', the ultimate app to locate your lost Bluetooth devices in seconds. Never lose your wireless headphones, watch, or any other Bluetooth device again! Our smart algorithms and real-time device radar ensure you can effortlessly find your items with just a few taps.
KEY FEATURES:
- Device Radar: Instantly discover all nearby devices in real-time.
- Distance Meter: Tap on a device to view a score on a scale of 100, indicating proximity.
- Supports Various Bluetooth Devices: Compatible with wireless earphones, portable speakers, Fitbit trackers, fitness trackers, and more.
- Pinpoint Location Updates: Get precise location updates on the built-in live map feature.
- Personalized Efficiency: Pin your favorite devices at the top of the list for maximum convenience.
HOW IT WORKS:
1. Open The Find my App.
2. The app automatically starts searching for nearby devices.
3. Move around to track the distance score and locate your lost device.
4. When you're close, the app plays a sound to help you find your device.
5. Congratulations, you've found your device!
Discover the power of our app, which utilizes Bluetooth signal strength to locate any Bluetooth device around you!
HOW IT WORKS:
1. Open The Find my App.
2. Select the device you want to find.
3. Observe the Distance Score as you move around to track your lost devices.
4. Your device should be within proximity.
DEVICE RADAR:
Stay informed with the device radar, displaying all nearby devices at a glance.
DISTANCE SCORE:
Select a specific device and witness the calculated distance score. Watch as this score changes while you search for your lost devices.
SUPPORTED DEVICES:
- AirPods
- Apple Watch
- iPhone
- Apple Pencil
- iPad
- Bluetooth Devices
- Bluetooth earbuds, earphones, headphones
- Bluetooth Smart Watches, Sport Watches
- Portable Speakers
- Fitness Trackers, and many more.
Download The Find my App now and experience the ultimate Bluetooth device finder. Never lose your precious items again!
PRIVACY POLICY
Read our privacy policy here: https://sites.google.com/view/airpodstracker/privacy
TERMS OF USE
Learn more about our terms and conditions here: https://sites.google.com/view/airpodstracker/terms
PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION
Device Tracker currently offers 2 auto-renewable subscriptions for USD $4.99 per week and USD $9.99 per month respectively. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions can be managed anytime by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase. Accounts will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Any unused portion of a free trial period (if offered) will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication (where applicable).

bluejetty:00075195:ios.description:
Show off your creativity and color various drawing art with your imagination. Let's nothing restrain your creative vision and make dull grey pictures bright and lovely. Make sure you use the right glitters to color mandalas. Your drawing sparkles and twinkles.
You can paint the coloring mandalas with watercolors, crayons, oil paint, and enjoy the coloring book with creative ideas and feel like an artist with a complete variety of anti-stress pictures. Engage yourself in hours of peaceful color therapy with dozens of number painting pages including mandala drawing, flora, fauna, and geometric designs in color blocks.
How To Play:
- To play this game, you need to select which picture do you want to paint.
- Then you can choose the sparkly glitters you like and touch the screen on a specific number.
- A video tutorial is available to learn the glitter coloring procedure.
- Identify the target area by using the hints system that appears at the top of the app.
- Check the color percentage and complete the artworks with soothing music.
- Unlock new images after watching an ad or go to the subscription mode to unlock everything, remove ads, and unlimited hints.

- Color pages according to the number and highlighted area.
- Finger Coloring Experience by dragging your finger on the screen.
- Become relaxed and zen with sandbox coloring.
- Color beautiful florals, patterns, mandalas, gardens, famous paintings, and more.

- Enjoy intuitive design and smooth performance of coloring books.

- Paint easily and watch how you draw the image in the end.
- It allows you to express feelings, fears, and thoughts.

Take a deep breath and relax with glitter color by number mandalas. You will always get a harmonic work of art as a result of the coloring process.

For kids aged 4–7, or as a catch-up for older children; start your free 7-day trial today!
HOW KIDS LEARN WITH PHONICS HERO:
PHONICS GAMES KIDS LOVE:
Your child joins our superhero, Zak, on his mission to rescue his friends from Dr. Lazybones. Our lively, kid-friendly phonics games keep kids excited to learn. Along the way, they'll feed tigers, dress up pooches, catch monsters, make mud pies and more!
STEP-BY-STEP LEARN TO READ APPROACH:
Our expertly designed games teach kids each of the essential phonics skills. From learning letter sounds to blending (reading) and segmenting (spelling) words, tackling tricky sight words and eventually reading full sentences.
EVIDENCE-BASED LEARNING:
Phonics Hero's games are rooted in the Science of Reading, drawing on research from the US, UK and Australia. Our systematic, synthetic phonics games teach kids to read and spell, quickly and stress-free.
WHAT YOU GET WITH PHONICS HERO:
• Personalized Placement Test
Matches your child's phonics and reading level with our games.
• 850+ Unique Games
Strikes the perfect balance between fun kids games and effective phonics learning.
• 3 Years of Phonics Content
Our games go from learning the abc to confident reading and spelling.
• Choose an Accent
Games are in an American, Australian or English accent.
• Progress Reports
Track your child's progress through our website.

Parents:

• 88% see better spelling skills.
• Consistently praised with "Games my kids love, love, love!"
• Trusted in over 40,000 homes worldwide.
Teachers:
• Our games are used in over 12,000 schools across the globe.

bluejetty:00175154:ios.description:
This app requires the Tempest sensor device, which is available to buy separately.
Need to set up and configure your Tempest Weather System? The Tempest app will walk you through a few simple steps, including connecting your home’s WiFi network. Once you’re up and running the app will quickly become your go-to for real-time weather conditions, lightning and rain alerts, and the most accurate forecast for your location - guaranteed. 
Data available in the Tempest app includes: 
Temp, humidity, dew point, feels like, heat index 
Barometric pressure, sea-level pressure, trends 
Lightning detection and alerts up to 40 km
Wind, UV, solar irradiance 
Rain rate, accumulation, rain onset alerts
10-day forecast 
Historical weather data graphs
Smart Home Ready:
Use this app to save time, energy, and water by integrating with popular smart home and irrigation services. Use your weather data to optimize heating and cooling, adjust your irrigation schedule, and alert your family when lightning storms approach. Tempest is compatible with Google Assistant, Rachio, IFTTT, Siri, Alexa, Homey, and many more.
Weather Geek Worthy:
The Tempest device features an all-in-one sensor and long-range wireless connectivity (1000ft), sonic anemometer, and haptic rain sensor, but it is far more than just a cutting-edge piece of hardware. Each Tempest leverages WeatherFlow-Tempest’s patented Nearcast Technology™, which feeds real-time observed weather data from your backyard into a machine learning system to dramatically improve forecast accuracy where it matters most.
Completely Customizable:
Tempest’s open API and shareable data enable third-party use, with built-in publication to desktop software and online services.

bluejetty:00178054:ios.name: Airplane Games for Flying Fun
bluejetty:00178054:ios.summary: Do you adore airplanes and all things that fly? Then fly into some fun with the Airplane Games for Flying Fun App! This interactive and informative app was designed by teachers with over 15 years childcare experience, using their philosop
bluejetty:00178054:ios.description:
Do you adore airplanes and all things that fly? Then fly into some fun with the Airplane Games for Flying Fun App! This interactive and informative app was designed by teachers with over 15 years childcare experience, using their philosophy of learning through play. With over 30 airplane games, sounds, and flashcards this app will get everyone excited about airplanes and the airport! 
Airplane Flying Game
Take off and have some fun flying airplanes in this interactive exciting game! You’ll get to fly different airplanes and helicopters that are going to a birthday party, on a jungle safari, over the city to rescue superheroes, to visit the King and Queen, and even a rocket in space. And along the way you get to collect things for your trip, like birthday presents, or jewels, but watch out for the birds in the sky as you fly! 
Airplane Tap Sounds
If you love planes then you’ll have a blast with the Airplane Tap Sounds. Like the old flip page comic books you tap the screen to make the airplane take-off, do stunts, float a hot air balloon, and even make another plane release a Glider plane! These sounds are interactive fun that give you the choice of how fast or slow the planes will go, and along with the entertaining music you’ll have a blast making aircraft fly high! 
Airplane Games
These games feature 7 different aircraft that you’ll have a blast playing with! Each plane has four games, including spot the difference, a size game, a matching puzzle, and a counting game. These games are interactive fun and designed to promote learning through play by teaching cognitive skills, early math concepts, and size recognition. With spot the difference you will have to look really closely to see what plane is different. With the size game you’ll be asked to find the smallest, medium, or largest airplane on the screen. The matching puzzle game has you find the other half of the plane, and will show you the finished plane when you choose the right one. And in the numbers game you will be asked to count the planes on the page and find the right number in the clouds above. All the games are interactive and entertaining and will keep any little pilot having fun! 
Airplane and Airport Flashcards
With the airplane flashcards you will find out what the different types of planes and other aircraft are really named, and hear an interesting fact about the aircraft. With the airport flashcards you will find out about all the parts of an airport, and flying in an airplane. Also with an interesting fact about that part of an airport. The flashcards are super fun and will get you excited about flying and going to the airport!
Suitcase Game
Who loves to pack a suitcase? Then gear up for some fun with the Suitcase Game! In this interactive game you’ll be packing a suitcase for a trip to the beach, the jungle, the North Pole, to visit the King and Queen, a birthday party, and to see pirates. You will get four objects to choose from and you have to decide which is the right one for your trip. In the end you will have packed 6 different items for your trip, and get to see the full suitcase. This game promotes creativity and reasoning skills and is designed for fun!
Rev your engines and get ready to take-off for some fun with airplanes, aircraft, and the airport in the Airplane Games for Flying Fun app!

bluejetty:00074479:ios.description:
Au Editor is a powerful iOS multi-track audio editing application designed for audio producers, music creators, and recording professionals. Whether you're creating music, editing sound effects, producing podcasts, or in need of precise audio editing tools, Au Editor is your perfect choice.
Multi-track Audio Editing: Easily import, arrange, and edit multiple audio tracks using an intuitive interface, blending diverse sound elements seamlessly.
Various Audio Import Options: Au Editor supports various audio import methods, whether you need to extract audio from videos, download audio from the internet, or use local audio files, ensuring you can effortlessly access the materials you need.
AI Voice and Accompaniment Separation: Leveraging advanced AI technology, Au Editor can automatically separate vocals and accompaniment, allowing you to edit them separately or create remixes.
Center Channel Extraction: A classic vocal and accompaniment separation algorithm that provides excellent results for remixing.
Accompaniment Recording: Au Editor introduces the accompaniment recording feature, enabling you to record while playing back tracks, creating unique music and soundscapes.
Fade In and Out: Add fade-in and fade-out effects to achieve smooth audio transitions and eliminate abrupt starts and ends.
Left/Right Channel Separation: Separate the left and right channels of stereo audio, offering more creative options for sound design and mixing.
Channel Editing and Balancing: Easily edit and balance channels within Au Editor to ensure each sound element is harmoniously aligned.
Noise Reduction: Reduce background noise, enhance recording clarity, and make your audio sound exceptional.
Volume Envelopes: Use volume envelope adjustments for precise control over volume curves on tracks, achieving smooth audio mixing and volume adjustments.
Sound Effects Editing: Au Editor provides a rich set of sound effects editing tools, including pitch shifting, speed adjustments, reverb, chorus, delay, and equalization, enabling you to enhance and creatively process your audio.
Multiple Audio Format Support: Au Editor supports various audio formats, including WAV, AAC, FLAC, M4A, MP3, AIFC, ensuring compatibility with a wide range of audio files.
Multiple Audio Quality Export: Choose the appropriate audio quality settings for export, with Au Editor supporting various quality options to meet your project requirements.
Built-in Metronome: Au Editor features a built-in metronome, helping you maintain precise control over the rhythm and beats of your music, making it easy to create perfect musical compositions.
Versatile Export Options: Au Editor offers a wide range of export options, including batch export of audio clips, exporting tracks, mixing exports, exporting individual audio blocks, and exporting selected ranges. This saves you time and boosts your workflow efficiency.

- Powerful boosts such as bombs, rainbow ball and lightning ball to help you in hard levels 
- Play daily and win free rewards like powerups, coins and more 
- Save your progress on the cloud and play anywhere 
- Meet different birds and monsters in your journey 
- Over 1500 free levels with more added each month

bluejetty:00148727:ios.summary:
YOUR HOUSE – A Game You Can Read, A Book You Can Play

bluejetty:00148727:ios.description:
YOUR HOUSE – A Game You Can Read, A Book You Can Play
Try YOUR HOUSE for free and unlock the full game for the complete story via in-app purchase.
- Award-Winning Escape Game
- Best Mobile Game – Málaga Indie Awards 2023
- Official Selection – The Leftfield Collection, EGX 2023
- Official Selection – Adventure X 2024
- Hidden Gem Award – DevGAMM 2024
What if a house could tell a story? What if it held secrets meant just for you?
Welcome to YOUR HOUSE, an award-winning text-driven mystery game where puzzles and storytelling merge to pull you deep into a chilling tale of identity, ambition, and deception.
This is more than a game—it’s a living puzzle, a literary thriller, and an escape room in a book. As you read, explore, and solve, you’ll uncover the intertwined fates of two women: a lost teenager searching for answers, and a wise woman fighting against societal expectations to embrace her true self. The house holds their story—but only if you dare to uncover it.
A HOUSE FULL OF SECRETS
- Unlock hidden doors and access secret rooms brimming with forgotten truths.
- Investigate cryptic objects and piece together a story lost in time.
- Read and solve puzzles seamlessly woven into the narrative.
- Explore underground passages leading to shocking discoveries.
THE STORY BEGINS AT MIDNIGHT
On the night of her 18th birthday, Debbie’s life unravels:
Expelled from school.
Betrayed by her best friend.
Struck by a car on her way home.
Then, as the clock strikes twelve, an envelope appears on her bed. Inside: a key, a cryptic postcard, and an address.
With nothing left to lose, Debbie steals a motorcycle and speeds toward the mysterious location. What awaits her is beyond imagination.
A massive, ominous house looms in the darkness. Who sent her here? What’s hiding inside? The deeper she ventures, the stranger things become. Doors appear where they shouldn’t. Shadows whisper half-truths. And at the heart of it all lies a secret powerful enough to change everything—if she’s brave enough to uncover it.
FEATURES
Text-Driven Gameplay – A gripping five-chapter thriller where reading and puzzles drive the experience.
Striking Noir Visuals – A haunting comic-book aesthetic that amplifies the mystery.
Escape Room-Style Puzzles – Seamlessly integrated riddles and codes that unlock deeper layers of the story.
Inspired by a Real-Life Mystery – Based on a Manhattan apartment, hiding secrets within its walls.
A Prequel to UNMEMORY – A standalone mystery that lays the foundation for our acclaimed debut game.
Do you dare to step inside YOUR HOUSE?
The house remembers. The house waits. The truth is calling you.
Download now and uncover the mystery.

bluejetty:00041733:ios.description:
Cook with a cat chef in restaurants of various sizes, from small shops to large restaurants!
A restaurant tycoon cooking game visited by a variety of customers has appeared.
There are restaurants that are open from sunrise until late at night.
There are cute guests and lots of food they want.
The store's business hours are until all the food customers want is sold out!!
The bigger the store, the more customers there are and the more food you can sell.
Open restaurants in different countries and sell local menu items to your customers.
Serve delicious coffee to more customers by opening a restaurant that serves hot pancakes, crunchy hot dogs, and other delicious foods!
Run a restaurant with a constant stream of customers, upgrade your restaurant, and expand its space.
Learn new dishes and serve delicious food to the table to keep your guests happy.
 Introducing how to play 
1. Receiving customer orders!!
Take orders for the food you want from customers who appear in various costumes, cook it, and
The staff will move the food to the table and serve the customers.
2. Upgrade the store!!
You need to upgrade your store to make more food and welcome more customers!
Upgrading adds food to the store and increases the number of tables for customers to sit.
Fighting for a bigger and better store! 
3. Decorate the chef and guests with costumes!
Dress up the animals in costumes such as hats, clothes, and accessories that you couldn't wear yourself!
Cuteness +1! Satisfaction of chefs and guests also increases by +1!
4. Open a store in various countries!
Once you've created a lovely and warm store, open a store in other countries and attract more customers!
Run a good store anywhere in the world!
5. Participate in various events held each season and run your store more easily and quickly!
Seasonal events make it very easy to run the store.
During seasonal events, you can invite special guests to your store.
Special guests have a greater impact on the store, so be sure to participate in the event!
I recommend it to these people!!
 Anyone who loves animal games!
 Anyone who loves food, cooking, and making coffee!
 Anyone who is serious about the restaurant cooking tycoon game genre!
 People who like healing games, idle games, and simulation games!
 For those who like single games and free games!
Are you looking for a game where you run a restaurant with cute animals?
If so, download this heartwarming free game and heal yourself~

bluejetty:00037928:ios.description:
Unlock the World of Stories with English Story Books!
Hey there, story lovers! Get ready to dive into a treasure trove of tales that entertain, educate, and inspire. With English Story Books, you can explore a vast collection of stories that cater to every mood and age. Whether you’re looking for a cozy bedtime read or an exciting adventure to spark your imagination, we’ve got you covered!
What’s Inside?
Extensive Library: Browse through our huge selection of stories that includes love tales, moral lessons, animal adventures, comics, fairy tales, and short stories for kids. There’s something here for everyone—trust us!
Read & Listen: Not in the mood to read? No problem! You can listen to stories narrated in delightful voices and accompanied by charming tunes. Perfect for relaxing or winding down before bed!
Scan & Convert: Have a favorite book? Simply scan it and watch it transform into an audiobook! Enjoy the story with different voices and melodies that bring the characters to life.
Bookmark Favorites: Found a story you can’t get enough of? Bookmark it so you can easily return whenever the mood strikes!
Why You'll Love It:
Perfect for All Ages: From little ones to grown-ups, everyone will find something to love in our app. Spark a love for reading in kids, or revisit your own cherished childhood tales.
Engaging Content: Each story is thoughtfully crafted to captivate and teach valuable lessons. Whether it’s a moral story or a whimsical fairy tale, you’re in for a treat!
User-Friendly Interface: We’ve made it super easy to navigate through our extensive library. Finding your next favorite story is a breeze!
Customizable Experience: Tailor your reading or listening experience just the way you like it. With different voice options and tunes, you can make each story feel unique!
So, what are you waiting for? Download English Story Books today and embark on a magical journey through stories that will entertain, educate, and enrich your life! Whether you’re cuddled up with your kids or enjoying some quiet time alone, there’s a world of adventure waiting for you!
Enjoy an Ad-Free Experience!
Upgrade your journey with English Story Books and unlock a world of uninterrupted storytelling. Choose the plan that suits you best and immerse yourself in captivating tales without any distractions!
1. Remove Ads
One-Time Purchase: Say goodbye to interruptions! This option removes all ads, allowing you to fully enjoy reading and listening to your favorite stories.
2. Weekly Subscription
Try It Free for 3 Days! This plan gives you a week of ad-free reading and listening. Cancel anytime during the trial!
3. Monthly Subscription
Try It Free for 3 Days! Experience the joy of reading and listening without ads! Cancel anytime during the trial.

bluejetty:00174419:ios.description:
HMA VPN helps protect your personal identity, keep snooping eyes off your online activity, and protect you on public Wi-Fi. Join hundreds of thousands of other people who trust HMA to keep their data more private and secure. 
HMA VPN is easy to set up, and in no time you’ll enjoy more secure web browsing and the ability to protect sensitive information on your iPhone or iPad. 
Benefits of HMA VPN: 
* Surf more privately 
* Access to the multiple VPN servers network around the world - giving you fast and reliable VPN connection 
* Help function built into the app 
* Multi-device compatible - a VPN for iPhone and iPad 
* In-app account registration and purchase 
Look what else you get: 
* 24/7 customer support via email
* The "Favourite Server" feature allows you to mark preferred VPN server or country as "favourite" - saving you time searching for your often-used servers 
* IPSec is the default VPN protocol, and the app manages the VPN connection for you 
About our subscriptions*:
If you’ve already subscribed, you can use HMA VPN for iPhone and iPad at no extra cost. If you’re not a subscriber, you can easily create an account and purchase one of the following subscriptions within the app: 
What is a VPN? 
A VPN (Virtual Private Network) is like having a PO box on the Internet – an address that is not publicly available. Instead of giving out its personal IP address when you click on a website, your iPhone or iPad gives one of ours. The result? You are more securely connected wherever our VPN server is located! Plus, your communications are secured and encrypted, even when using untrusted public networks. 
Why do you need a VPN? 
Anytime you connect to a public Wi-Fi hotspot with your device you are putting your security and privacy at risk. HMA offers you an extra level of professional security when surfing the Internet – wherever you are. 
Support available by: 
* Handy in-app help feature 
* Expert customer service team via email
* Online tutorials at https://support.hidemyass.com/hc/en-us/sections/200996608-HMA-iOS-App 
To read about our Privacy Policy, please visit https://www.hidemyass.com/legal/privacy 
To read about our Terms of Use, please visit https://www.hidemyass.com/legal/vpn-terms 
*Note about subscriptions: 
- Payment will be charged to your App Store account at confirmation of purchase 
- Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period 
- You will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, for the same duration and at the current subscription rate 
- You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase 
- No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period 
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription 
**HMA VPN is not available for use within India as a result of governmental regulations requiring the logging and saving of user data, but you can still use your HMA VPN when traveling outside of India."

Get revenge on your boss!
It's another day at the office, and your boss is making you work overtime again. What a jerk! It's time to square your accounts. But before you whack your boss in real life, try Crazy Office—the smash-hit office game. 
You think you’ve seen enough crazy games, huh? This office game will prove to be crazier than all the other work games you’ve ever played. 
Today, your office is your wreck room, so let all your rage out. Turn off your brain and start wreaking havoc: fight your colleagues, kick your buddies, crash furniture, smash computers, and unleash complete anarchy on the entire office floor. bluejetty:00037311:ios.summary:
Welcome to a brand-new twist on the classic hidden object genre!
Where Is? is no longer just a game of searching for items—it’s now a smart and addictive fusion of seek & find mechanics and triple merge puzzles. 
Whether you love sharp-eye
bluejetty:00037311:ios.description:
Welcome to a brand-new twist on the classic hidden object genre!
Where Is? is no longer just a game of searching for items—it’s now a smart and addictive fusion of seek & find mechanics and triple merge puzzles. 
Whether you love sharp-eyed scavenger hunts or the strategic satisfaction of matching, this game is built to captivate your attention and challenge your brain!
A New Kind of Hidden Object Challenge
In Where Is?, your mission is more than simply finding hidden items in beautifully illustrated scenes. Now, you must spot three of the same item, collect them, and merge them on your tray to unlock progress. It’s not just about what you see—it’s about what you remember, how you plan, and how well you manage space!
Each level presents you with an exciting challenge:
Search for identical objects scattered throughout immersive scenes like bustling playgrounds, underwater cities, cozy cafés, and dreamy gardens. 
Tap to collect, merge on your rack, and clear the scene before your tray fills up. Be quick, be precise, and don’t forget to zoom in—you never know where objects might be hiding!
Game Features
Hidden Object Fun with a Twist
Search vibrant and detailed environments to find small, cleverly placed items. Spotting them is just the beginning—
finding three of the same and merging them takes the challenge to the next level.
Strategic Puzzle Merging
Your merge rack has limited slots. Every object you collect adds to the tray, and if it overflows—game over! 
Think ahead, manage space, and merge quickly to keep playing.
Simple Yet Satisfying Controls
Use intuitive zoom and swipe gestures to explore each scene. Tap to collect items and drag them into your merge tray. It’s smooth, satisfying, and endlessly playable.
Timed & Relaxed Modes
Challenge yourself with fast-paced timed levels, or kick back and enjoy the game at your own rhythm in casual mode. 
Whether you want adrenaline or calm, Where Is? fits your mood.
Boosters & Power-Ups
Feeling stuck? Use hints to reveal tricky objects, shuffle the tray, or gain extra slots with helpful boosters. 
Perfect for solving those more challenging levels.
Explore a World of Hidden Wonders
From train stations to pirate bays, theme parks to Viking villages—each location features a different visual theme, unique items to find, and plenty of surprises.
Play Offline or On the Go
No Wi-Fi? No problem! Enjoy the game online or offline—perfect for playing anywhere, anytime.
Fun for All Ages
With intuitive controls, beautiful visuals, and balanced challenge, Where Is? is the ideal game for both kids and adults. Play together or solo—it's always rewarding.
How to Play
Search the scene for hidden objects and find matching items
Collect 3 identical objects to create a match and clear them
Manage your merge tray carefully—don't let it fill up!
Use boosters to help solve trickier levels
Advance through maps and unlock new worlds, scenes, and collectibles
Why You’ll Love Where Is?
It’s a brain-teasing challenge with relaxing visuals
Combines the best of hidden object and triple match gameplay
Delivers a fresh, modern puzzle experience unlike anything else
Designed for both quick play sessions and long puzzle marathons
Constant updates mean there’s always something new to find!
Ready to search, merge, and master every scene?
Download Where Is? Find Hidden Objects now and discover a smarter way to play your favorite hidden object puzzles.
Start your merging adventure today—can you find them all?

Make the most of this time with this amazing Unblock Car game. Designed to develop sequential-thinking for impulsive brains, we offered more than 3,000 puzzles for you to clash. However the cars and trucks obstruct the path which makes the puzzle harder.

You need to get the Red Car out the Exit Gate. To accomplish, just move the blocking vehicles out of the way.
Game Features:
- 4 difficulty levels with 3,000 puzzles and more to come
- 4 different visually striking ice board themes
- Hint/Reset/Undo buttons to help you figure out each puzzle
- Keep track of all the puzzles you've cleared
- Quick and easy Tutorial

bluejetty:00041540:ios.summary:
Gambly is the AI that turns any bet into a one-tap slip.
See a bet you like - in a group chat, on X, in a screenshot from a buddy? Send it to Gambly. It reads the image, figures out the legs, and builds a betslip you can load straight into
bluejetty:00041540:ios.description:
Gambly is the AI that turns any bet into a one-tap slip.
See a bet you like - in a group chat, on X, in a screenshot from a buddy? Send it to Gambly. It reads the image, figures out the legs, and builds a betslip you can load straight into your sportsbook. No retyping, no hunting for the market, no rebuilding someone else's parlay by hand.
Don't have a bet in mind yet? Just ask.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
Screenshot to betslip
Share a screenshot from anywhere. Gambly reads it, identifies the legs, and builds the slip for you to review.
Ask for anything
Props, parlays, same game parlays, first-basket markets, NRFI, alt lines, ladders - ask in plain English and Gambly finds it.
Browse the feed
Scroll trending slips, popular parlays, and what other bettors are loading right now. Filter by sport, player, or bet type.
Shop the line
Compare live odds across supported sportsbooks so you can see where a bet is available before you place it.
One tap to your book
Pick your sportsbook and jump straight to the bet, ready to load. Gambly works alongside the books you already use.
WHY GAMBLY
Gambly isn't a sportsbook and it isn't a picks service. We don't take your action and we don't sell you locks. We're the layer that makes finding a bet and acting on it fast - whether it came from a creator you follow, your group chat, or your own gut.
The more you use it, the better it gets at surfacing the bets you actually care about.
Free to use. Just bring your own sportsbook.
Must be 21+ and located in a jurisdiction where sports betting is legal. If gambling stops being fun, help is available. Call 1-800-GAMBLER.

In a world of playlists and algorithms, sometimes you just want to press play and listen.
Prog Radio is a fully licensed, 100% commercial-free progressive rock station streaming the greatest classic prog legends and today’s cutting-edge innovators — all in stunning 320kbps HD audio.
THREE CHANNELS. ONE APP
One tap/swipe switching between channels:
• The Crimson Hall – Modern & Classic Prog
• The Wizard’s Forest – Classic Prog Focus
• The Dragon’s Tower – Heavy & Progressive Metal
FEATURES:
• 24/7 commercial-free progressive rock radio
• 320kbps HD audio streaming
• Three channels (modern, classic, metal)
• Swipe or one-tap channel switching
• 1,500+ progressive rock bands in rotation
• CarPlay support
• AirPlay & Chromecast support
• Siri integrated voice control 
• “Peek” feature to see what’s playing on other channels
• Live song details: artist, album, year, country & trivia
• Real-time Like / Dislike interaction
• One-tap song requests
• Song history with full artist details
• Progress bar with accurate runtime tracking
• Optional DJ commentary after each song
MORE THAN JUST A STREAM:
• Daily shows from prog voices like Scot Lade (The Prog Corner)
• Echo Chamber – on-demand show replays with enhanced playlists
• Listener’s Lounge live chat community
• Charts, reviews, and artist bios
• “Prog Adjacent” discoveries to expand your taste

Yes • Genesis • King Crimson • Pink Floyd • Rush • ELP • Jethro Tull • Gentle Giant • Dream Theater • Marillion • Porcupine Tree
Steven Wilson • Neal Morse • Riverside • The Dear Hunter • Lifesigns • Pattern-Seeking Animals • Spock’s Beard • and hundreds more
OUR NON-PROFIT COMMUNITY MISSION:
To grow and sustain the global progressive rock community — Honoring the Past, Spotlighting the Present, and Inspiring the Future.
Fully licensed. Supporting artists and rights holders.
Whether you’re a lifelong prog devotee or discovering the genre for the first time, Prog Radio is your home.
Download now and press play.

bluejetty:00129293:ios.name: レシピー - パーソナルレシピ型英語学習でバイリンガルに！
bluejetty:00129293:ios.summary:
英語学習アプリ「レシピー（ポリグロッツ）」は、単語学習、文法、リーディング、リスニング、スピーキング、ライティング、英語レッスンが全て、このアプリ一つで学べるAll In One型のアプリです。AIにより自動生成される学習カリキュラムと、先生によるレッスンの組合せで最短で最高の成果を出します。
TOEIC/TOEFLのスコアをあなたの好きなジャンルの英語ニュースを使って伸ばしましょう！
パーソナライズされた英単語帳を使った英単語学習はもちろん、リスニング学習、英会話・英文法
bluejetty:00129293:ios.description:
英語学習アプリ「レシピー（ポリグロッツ）」は、単語学習、文法、リーディング、リスニング、スピーキング、ライティング、英語レッスンが全て、このアプリ一つで学べるAll In One型のアプリです。AIにより自動生成される学習カリキュラムと、先生によるレッスンの組合せで最短で最高の成果を出します。
TOEIC/TOEFLのスコアをあなたの好きなジャンルの英語ニュースを使って伸ばしましょう！
パーソナライズされた英単語帳を使った英単語学習はもちろん、リスニング学習、英会話・英文法学習！
続く英語学習を可能にします。続かない英語学習は終わりにしましょう
■こんな方におすすめ
　○英語学習を継続したい方
　　・色々な英語学習法を試したけど長続きしなかった方
　　・英語力を伸ばすためにどのように学習すればいいかが、分からない方
　　・TOEIC/TOEFLの英語教材を使った勉強ではなく、英語学習アプリを使って英語の勉強を継続させたい
　　・英文の多読やリスニングの学習を楽しみながら英単語・英文法の習得をして、TOEIC/TOEFLのテストに活かしたい
　　・前に英語リスニングアプリを使っていたが挫折してしまったので英語教材と英語学習アプリを並行し、
　　　リスニング・英単語・英文法の勉強をしたい
　　・毎日触れるスマホアプリを利用して効果的な英語学習方法で英文法・英単語の学習がしたい
　　・ニュースや自分の興味のあるコンテンツ（ニュース、洋楽、日常英会話等）を利用して英語を勉強したい方
　　・「アプリでの自習」と「先生とのオンライン英語レッスン」をどちらも利用したい方
　　・英語を勉強するための時間が取れない方、通勤時間等のスキマ時間を有効に使いたい方
　○ビジネスで使う英語力を伸ばしたい方
　　・英会話のリスニング学習として、発音や音読機能のある英語学習アプリが欲しい
　　・ビジネス英語でよく使う英単語・英文法・リスニングに苦手意識があるので、よく使うフレーズを中心に学習したい
　　・ビジネス英語に役立つ英会話・ライティング・リスニング・日常英会話のスキルを伸ばせる英語学習アプリが欲しい
　○TOEIC/TOEFL対策の学習アプリを探している
　　・TOEIC/TOEFLに出題される英文法や英単語の勉強をして、TOEIC/TOEFLのスコアを伸ばしたい
　　・TOEIC/TOEFLの英語教材を使って勉強をしていたが継続できなかったので、英語学習アプリでTOEIC/TOEFL対策したい
　　・TOEIC/TOEFLのリスニングに出てくる英会話のリスニング力を高めるためにネイティブな発音でリスニング勉強したい
　　・海外留学で英会話はある程度できるがTOEIC/TOEFLに出る発音やきちんとした英単語・英文法には自信がない方
　　・ネイティブなリスニングに苦手意識があるので、TOEIC/TOEFLのリスニングスコアを伸ばせる英語学習アプリを探している
　　・TOEIC/TOEFLに出る英単語・英文法・英会話をスキマ時間に英語学習できるアプリで、コツコツTOEIC/TOEFLのスコアを伸ばしていきたい
　　・以前に英語学習アプリでTOEIC/TOEFLの英単語・英文法の対策を始めたが継続できなかったので、英語学習を継続してTOEIC/TOEFLのスコアを伸ばしたい
■アプリの特徴
　○All In One型
　　・インプット学習として、単語学習、文法、リーディング、リスニング、スピーキング、ライティング
　　　アウトプット学習として、英語レッスンが全てこのアプリできます。
　○英語初級者向けのステップ学習機能
　　・１つの英文に対して６つのステップに分けて英語学習を一気通貫で行います。
　　　英語を聞く能力、部分翻訳（スラッシュリーディング）、文章を見ながら発話、
　　　聞き取ったままの英文を発話（シャドーイング学習）、復習となります。
　　　ステップ学習で段階を踏みながら学ぶ事で、ネイティブと会話を楽しめるレベルまで向上することが可能です。
　○あなたの英語スキルに最適化された学習法を提供（AIによる自動生成カリキュラム）
　　・あなたの現在の英語レベルの診断結果を元にAIがあなただけの学習カリキュラムを自動で生成します。
　　　完全にあなただけに最適化された学習カリキュラムです。
　○英語ニュースが学習コンテンツとなり、とにかく学習が続きます
　　・英語の勉強は三日坊主という方でも興味のあるニュースなら続けられます
　　・リーディングしながら、ネイティブが読み上げるナレーションでリスニング学習もできます。
　　　自分にあった速度(WPM)に調節可能です。
　　・以下のメディアの記事も翻訳文付き、リスニング機能付きで勉強できます
　　・TechCrunch、LifeHacker、BBC World、The Japan Times、AsahiWeekly、JIJI Press その他多数
　○調べた英単語は学習できる
　　・英単語の学習機能が装備されています
　　・アプリ起動時に英単語クイズが起動し、自分の苦手な英単語を中心に出題されます
　○英会話スキルの鍵は「リーディング」
　　・英語と日本語の最大の違いは語順、つまり英語の語順に応じた「英語脳」を鍛える必要があります。
　　　英文を日本語に訳さず英文のまま理解する「英語脳」をつくる上でも効果的な英語学習方法が英文多読なのです。
　　　また、英文に触れると英単語の使い方を覚えやすいという研究成果も出ています
　○先生とのオンライン英語レッスン
　　・日本語が通じる講師陣がそろっているので、初級者でも安心です。
　　　単に英語で話すだけでなく、45分間でみっちり学べます。
　　・文法、リーディング、リスニング、スピーキング、ライティング対策に必要なレッスンが揃っています。
　　　テレカンやプレゼンのビジネスパーソン向けのレッスンも豊富です。
　○基本機能（単語学習、リーディング学習）は無料ですが、プレミアムメンバーへのご加入で有料機能が利用可能です。
■有料機能について
1. プレミアムメンバーについて
 　レシピー（ポリグロッツ）は無料でもご利用いただけますが、プレミアムメンバーになることで、
　 様々な機能が利用いただけます。
　○料金体系
　　- Entryプラン：¥480/月
　　　・リスニング学習、ラダーシリーズ/AudioBook
　　- Basic：¥3,600/3ヶ月、¥6,600/6ヶ月、¥12,000/1年
　　　・Entryプランの機能に加えて、スピーキング学習（英会話フレーズ・文法学習) 、記事の理解度テスト、
　　　　発音矯正（単語学習＋スピーキング学習）、文法基礎学習コンテンツ (スピーキング・英文法)
　　- Standard：¥7,500//3ヶ月、¥13,800/6ヶ月、¥24,800/1年
　　　・Basicプランの機能に加えて、My Recipe（AIによる自動生成カリキュラム）、ステップ学習
　　　　My Recipe TOEIC® L/Rモード、TOEIC® Part1模擬問題集、TOEIC® Part2模擬問題集、
　　　　TOEIC® Part5模擬問題集、TOEIC® Part7模擬問題集
　　- Advanced：¥14,800//3ヶ月、¥26,800/6ヶ月、¥48,800/1年
　　　・Standardプランの機能に加えて、ライティング添削、Teacherに質問、
　　　　ファイナンス・会計・ビジネス英会話コンテンツ・専門用語単語帳
　◯自動継続課金について
　　・お支払いはご利用のAppleIDに請求されます
　　・購読期間終了の24時間以内に自動課金されます
　　・購読期間終了の24時間以上前に自動課金をOFFにしない場合、自動更新されます
　　・購読内容の変更・解除は、AppleID管理画面よりご自身で行って頂くようお願い致します
　　・アプリを削除するだけでは購読は解除されませんので、ご注意ください
　　・Apple社ヘルプページ: https://support.apple.com/ja-jp/HT202039
2. 旺文社TOEFL®テスト英単語3800について
　・各ランクを個別に購入する場合、730円
　・ランク1〜4をまとめて購入する場合、2,580円
3. 「英英英単語帳」について
　・各Stageを個別に購入する場合、610円
　・Stage1〜10をまとめて購入する場合、2,680円
4.「アプリ内レッスン」について
　・１レッスン2800円になります。
　・「回数券」（4回：5,620円、12回：16,000円、24回：30,400円）も利用できます。
■プライバシーポリシー
　https://www.polyglots.net/privacypolicy/
■利用規約
　https://www.polyglots.net/use_term/
■有料サービス利用規約
　https://www.polyglots.net/premium_use_term/
■よくあるお問合せ
　プレミアム購読状況、購読解除の方法は以下ページでご確認お願い致します
　https://support.apple.com/ja-jp/HT202039

bluejetty:00082561:ios.description:
Focus To-Do combines Pomodoro Timer with Task Management, it is a science-based app that will motivate you to stay focused and get things done. 
It brings Pomodoro Technique and To Do List into one place, you can capture and organize tasks into your todo lists, start focus timer and focus on work & study, set reminders for important tasks and errands, check the time spent at work. 
It's the ultimate app for managing Tasks, Reminders, Lists, Calendar events, Grocery lists, checklist, helping you focus on work & study and tracking your working hours.
Focus To-Do syncs between your phone and computer, so you can access your lists from anywhere.
How it works:
 1. Pick a task you need to accomplish.
 2. Set a timer for 25 minutes, keep focused and start working.
 3. When the pomodoro timer rings, take a 5 minute break.
Key Features:
- Pomodoro Timer：Stay focused and get more things done.
 Pause and resume Pomodoro
 Customizable pomodoro/breaks lengths
 Notification before the end of a Pomodoro
 Support for short and long breaks
 Skip a break after the end of a Pomodoro
 Continuous Mode
- Tasks Management: Task Organizer, Schedule Planner, Reminder, Habit Tracker, Time Tracker
 Tasks and projects: Organise your day with Focus To-Do and complete your to do, study, work, homework or housework you need to get done.
 Recurring tasks: Build lasting habits with powerful recurring due dates like "Every Monday".
 Reminders: Setting a Reminder ensures you never forget important things ever again, you can set up recurring due dates to remind you each and every time. 
 Sub-tasks: Break down your task into smaller, actionable items or add a checklist .
 Task Priority: Highlight your day’s most important To-Do with color-coded priority levels.
 Estimated Pomodoro Number: Estimate the workload or set a goal.
 Note: Record more detailed about the task.
- Report: Detailed statistics of your time distribution, tasks completed.
 Support the calculation of the total time of Focus Time.
 Gantt Chart of the Focus Time.
 Statistics on completed To Do. 
 Statistics on time distribution of project.
 Trend chart of the completed To Do and the focus time.
- All-Platform synchronization: View and manage your goals wherever you are for better goal achieving.
 Support seamless synchronization within iPhone、Mac、iPad、Apple Watch and other major platforms.
- Various Reminding:
 Focus Timer finished alarm, vibration reminding.
 Various white noise to help you focus on work & study.
- Daily/Weekly/Monthly Report
 View all of your tracked time in a calendar view.
- Support prevention of screen lock:
 Check the pomodoro time left by keeping the screen on.
Contact Us: support@focustodo.net, reply within 24 hours.
Website: http://www.focustodo.cn
Pomodoro ™ and Pomodoro Technique ® are registered trademarks of Francesco Cirillo. This app is not affiliated with Francesco Cirillo.
Users have been focused on our app for 200 million hours, join us and we help you to be focused and increase your productivity, reduce procrastination and anxiety.

bluejetty:00070864:ios.description:
Turn your photos and videos into timeless oil paintings — art with the rich texture and depth of a gallery masterpiece.
Oilbrush transforms your images into stunning oil paintings — right on your iPhone, iPad, or Mac. Whether you're capturing a portrait, a vacation memory, or even your favorite pet, Oilbrush brings the classic beauty of traditional oil art to your fingertips. Your images stay 100% private. Everything is processed directly on your device for instant results and complete peace of mind. No internet required.
◆ Photos and Videos — Both Transformed
Export up to 4K resolution at 60 FPS for stunning video productions, or go for an artistic stop-motion look. For photos, export up to 64 megapixels — perfect for large-format prints, canvas art, journal covers, or even T-shirt designs.
◆ 29 Curated Oil Painting Styles
Every style captures the essence of traditional oil painting — from soft sfumato techniques to bold impasto textures. Find the perfect look for portraits, landscapes, travel photos, or daily snapshots — then make it your own. With Custom Styles, personalize and save your own presets — synced across all your devices.
◆ Precise Editing Tools
Take full control of your artwork. Fine-tune every detail with pixel-level accuracy — using your finger or Apple Pencil — directly in real time. Adjust stroke length, relief, brush size, and more. Remove imperfections with the Magic Eraser, or add your personal signature or logo to mark your creations as truly yours.
◆ Projects — Your Creative Work, Always Saved
Never lose a creative idea in progress. Save your edits as a project and return at any time — right where you left off. Explore variations, experiment freely, and share your projects with others.
◆ Color, Canvas & Finish
Complete your artwork with authentic finishing touches:
• 44 color palettes to set the perfect mood
• 17 canvas textures for a realistic, tactile feel
• 22 vignettes to frame your art
Every detail contributes to a finished piece that looks and feels like traditional oil art.
◆ Print & Share Your Creations
Bring your oil paintings into the real world:
• Postcards via MyPostcard — worldwide delivery
• Canvas prints and posters via CanvasPop with a 100% "Love It" guarantee
• Large-format prints, made possible by Oilbrush's ultra-high-resolution output
Share your finished pieces on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and Facebook.
Download Oilbrush for free and start creating oil paintings that feel truly yours.
◆ Key Features
• Transform photos into high-resolution* oil paintings (up to 64 MP)
• Transform videos into stunning oil painting animations (up to 4K)
• 29 hand-curated oil painting styles
• Fully adjustable effects—fine-tune every detail*
• Pixel-precise retouch tools with finger or Apple Pencil*
• Magic Eraser to remove unwanted elements*
• Canvas textures for authentic finishes*
• Color filters and custom vignettes*
• Add your personal signature or logo to your artwork*
• Personalize and save your own Custom Styles
• Projects — save your work, explore variations and share with others
• Real-time, on-device processing—no uploads, no waiting, no internet needed. 100% privacy assured
• Integrated postcard and canvas printing services
• Full RAW support for iPhone and DSLR images
• Optimized for iOS 27 and the iPhone 18 family
* Subscribe to unlock all features.
◆ Oilbrush Premium
To unlock Oilbrush's full creative power, we offer weekly, monthly, and yearly Premium auto-renewing subscriptions.
Payment is charged to your credit card through your Apple account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription renews automatically unless you turn off auto-renewal in Apple account settings or cancel your subscription at least 24 hours prior to the end of the subscription period.
◆ Support
Questions or feedback? We're here 24/7.
Contact us at: support@digitalmasterpieces.com
Terms of Use: https://www.digitalmasterpieces.com/app-terms-of-use/

Do you enjoy creating your perfect dream house over and over? Are you seeking a casual mobile game that offers an enjoyable experience and allows you to bring your interior design dreams to life in a fun, relaxing environment? Then Art Assemble - Home Makeover is the ideal game for you.
EXPERIENCE A VARIETY OF DESIGNS
Art Assemble offers a vast range of designs, each with its own unique interior furniture and theme. Dive into the exciting world of house design where you can organize your dream house just the way you like it.
IMMERSE YOURSELF IN 3D VISION
You'll be challenged to complete a variety of projects by placing items in a playful 3D environment. Art Assemble offers endless possibilities for you to decorate and assemble your own unique design masterpieces.
CREATE YOUR OWN TOWN 
In Art Assemble, your design journey doesn't end with individual projects. Once you've completed a design, you have the opportunity to create your own town using the completed projects as building blocks. Imagine having your dream home and many other unique designs all in one captivating town.
RELAXING AND SIMPLE-TO-PLAY
Art Assemble offers a stress-free and user-friendly experience, making it the perfect choice for anyone seeking a calming escape into the world of decor life and interior design.
Join us on this creative journey where your dream house and pocket world await your personal touch. Start designing your ideal home in your very own pocket world with Art Assemble today!

Looking for an easier way to grocery shop, save money and manage your weekly grocery list? The Foods Co. app makes grocery shopping simple with Delivery and In-store options, digital coupons, weekly ads and personalized savings.
Download the Foods Co. grocery app to shop groceries online and find the best deals all in one place.
Shop Groceries Your Way
 • Order groceries with Delivery
 • Scan a recipe to quickly find ingredients and add them to your cart
 • Shop thousands of additional grocery and household items
Save More on Groceries
 • Browse weekly ads and sales
 • Clip digital coupons and apply them at checkout
 • Discover personalized deals, bonus rewards and Cash Back offers
 • Track and redeem fuel points for gas savings
Fast, Convenient Checkout
 • Use Kroger Pay for fast checkout in-store
 • Add your Shopper's Card to Apple Wallet
 • View purchase history and quickly reorder favorite items
Helpful Everyday Tools
 • Use the store locator to find the nearest Foods Co. store or fuel center
Improving Your Experience
To provide and personalize our offerings, make recommendations, detect and prevent fraud, and improve our services, we use tools that collect and record your data, which may include your searches for and purchases of health and wellness products. We also may share non-sensitive data with third parties, such as advertising and analytics vendors, social networks, technology providers, and research providers. By continuing to use our websites and apps and shop our store, this means you consent to these practices and accept our Terms (https://www.foodsco.net/i/terms/website-and-app) and our Privacy Policy (https://www.foodsco.net/i/privacy-policy).
To use the Foods Co app, you need a Foods Co digital account. You can create a digital account and link your Foods Co Rewards ID through the app. Don't have a Rewards ID? You'll get one when you create your digital account and enroll in Foods Co's Rewards Program. You must be 18 to register for an account or join our rewards program (to obtain a Rewards ID). Terms apply: https://www.foodsco.net/i/terms/website-and-app.

You will collect birdie , feed them to level them up ! If you always wanted to adopt a pet, play with birds, were interested in pet rescue then this is one of the best pet games for you. *Magic breeding
To make it even more exciting you can breed magical new birds by spinning the breeding wheel and getting new, unique birds with different new colors. this will help you have aviaries filled with exotic and colorful birds unlike anybody else’s.
*Beautiful aviaries 
Decorate your aviaries with various decoration and themes that range from waterfalls and amazonian forests to volcanoes and mountains. make your aviaries suitable for every chick and fill it with amazing items and decorations. 
*Connect with friends
To make it even better you can connect with your friends and take care of your birdies and aviaries together! Leave gifts for each
