bluejetty:00166760:ios.description:
Welcome to the Air India app – Winner of the 2024 Gold Stevie Award
Easily book flights, manage trips, receive timely check-in reminders and gate notifications – the new and improved Air India app is designed to make your journeys simpler and enjoyable. With just a few swipes, you can instantly access your flight details, complete web check-ins, do flight upgrades and much more. Download the app now and start enjoying a faster and seamless flight booking experience!
You can make use of our updated app to complete quick flight searches, flight bookings and stay informed about the latest updates concerning your travel from anywhere. Our app is designed to work on mobile phones of all resolutions and has been awarded with a Gold Stevie Award at the 2024 Asia-Pacific Stevie Awards, for its excellence in innovation and customer service. 
Easy flight bookings:
Now you can book domestic and international flights to more than 450 destinations all over the world with just a few taps. Discover the best places to visit, the right prices and even the perfect schedule by narrowing down your options based on your preferences and needs. 
Stay updated on the go:
Stay current with all the major updates related to your domestic and international flights on the go. Whether there is a change in gate number or departure time, your digital boarding pass will be automatically updated to display the change in boarding details or departure time.
AEYE VISION™:
Use the new scan function to add details of your journeys to the My Trips section, complete web check-in, track flight status and even monitor the status of your checked-in luggage right from drop off to pick up at the baggage claim.
Baggage tracker:
This handy feature makes it easy to keep tabs on the status of your baggage and its location in case of delays, allowing you to minimise your worries and focus more on enjoying the travel experience.
Flight status:
Track the status of your scheduled flights easily with this handy feature, allowing you stay organised and ready for your next big adventure.
Maharaja Club programme:
Members of our Maharaja Club programme can use the app to access and manage their loyalty accounts, allowing them to redeem points for flight bookings and cabin class upgrades.
Digital boarding pass:
Go paperless by completing your check-in online and downloading your boarding pass to your device. You can store your boarding pass in your digital wallet for easy retrieval.
Inflight experience:
Use the app to explore our assorted inflight dining menu, offering everything from the classics to delicious gourmet creations. Also, don't forget to have a look at what we have in store from the world of cinema, television, and music to keep you entertained.
Book flights on Airbus A350-900:
Search and book domestic or international flights on an Airbus A350-900 personalised with an elegant and luxurious interior. 
AI.g:
Our app allows you to connect with our virtual agent AI.g, available round the clock to offer expert assistance. From checking flight status and confirming baggage allowance to rebooking and refunds, our AI virtual assistant can answer all your queries about flying with Air India.
Trip planner:
Our virtual agent's trip planner feature helps you create customised itineraries for your dream destinations, highlighting places to visit, shopping spots, and local culinary delights. 
About Air India:
Founded by the legendary JRD Tata, Air India pioneered India’s aviation sector and is one of the leading global airlines. We are the proud flag carrier of India, and a member of the Star Alliance. Air India’s direct and nonstop international flights connect India with destinations in Asia, Africa, Australia, Europe, the Middle East, and North America.

bluejetty:00000552:ios.name: Five-O Deluxe
bluejetty:00000552:ios.summary:
Five-O puts a numerical twist on the classic crossword board game!
Instead of letters, you place number tiles, forming sequences that must add up to multiples of five, with no more than five tiles per sequence. Think strategically, maximiz
bluejetty:00000552:ios.description:
Five-O puts a numerical twist on the classic crossword board game!
Instead of letters, you place number tiles, forming sequences that must add up to multiples of five, with no more than five tiles per sequence. Think strategically, maximize your bonuses, and outscore your opponent!
"This is a great must have iPad game. And I love the fact that it really works your mind muscles. It is a very simple game but it will get you hooked." - tcgeeks.com
"The price is right, and the game is fun as well as educational. I’d very much recommend it, especially if you’re looking for something the whole family can enjoy or even just for the kids." - ipadboardgames.org
Features:
Easy to learn rules
Online Multiplayer, take turns at your leisure
Pass-and-Play mode for up to 4 local players
Single player mode with challenging computer opponents
Hints for when you get stuck
Simple controls, just touch and drag the tiles to the board
How to play:
Players take turns placing intersecting sequences of numbers on the board which add up to multiples of five. For example, 7-3-8-7 would be a valid sequence because it adds up to 25. The sequence 3-9-5 is not valid because it adds up to 17 which is not a multiple of five.
On each turn, players may play tiles in one straight line sequence, horizontally or vertically. The first sequence must be played on the center square, and all sequences after that must intersect with tiles already in play.
The score for each play is the sum of all the number tiles in sequences completed on that turn. Colored bonus squares award extra points and multipliers.
At the end of each turn, players draw new tiles to replace the ones played. The game ends when a player plays all of their remaining tiles and there are no more tiles left to draw.

bluejetty:00146535:ios.summary: Store your unique credentials on a hardware-backed security key and take it wherever you go from mobile to desktop. No more storing sensitive secrets on your mobile phone, leaving your account vulnerable to takeovers. With the Yubico Authen
bluejetty:00146535:ios.description:
Store your unique credentials on a hardware-backed security key and take it wherever you go from mobile to desktop. No more storing sensitive secrets on your mobile phone, leaving your account vulnerable to takeovers. With the Yubico Authenticator you can raise the bar for security.
* The Yubico Authenticator will work with any USB, Lightning, or NFC-enabled YubiKeys.
* As iPads do not have NFC, they will only work through a Lightning or USB connection.
The Yubico Authenticator generates a code used to verify your identity as you are logging into various services. No connectivity needed!
Features include:
Touch or NFC Authentication - Touch the YubiKey sensor or simply tap a YubiKey with NFC to a mobile phone that is NFC-enabled to store your credential on the YubiKey
USB-C support - Connect the YubiKey 5Ci or any USB-C type YubiKey. When prompted, depending on the key, touch the contacts on the sides of the key or the golden ring on the top
Biometric support - Experience greater convenience by unlocking your YubiKey with FaceID or TouchID
Easy Setup - QR codes available from the services you wish to protect with strong authentication
User Presence - New codes generated with just a touch or NFC tap of the YubiKey
Compatible - Secure all the services currently compatible with other Authenticator apps
Secure - Hardware-backed strong two-factor authentication with secret stored on the YubiKey, not on the mobile device
Versatile - Support for multiple work and personal accounts
Portable - Get the same set of codes across our other Yubico Authenticator apps for desktops as well as for all leading mobile platforms
Flexible - Support for time-based and counter-based code generation
Smart Card - Support for Apple's CryptoTokenKit Extension making it possible to use certificates stored on your YubiKey to authenticate with other apps and sites
Experience security the modern way with the Yubico Authenticator. Visit yubico.com to learn more.

bluejetty:00075567:ios.summary: They call them, "Heroes" in this realm. They defend the last bastions of humanity, battle monstrous hordes, and leave their mark on countless battlefields. Together with your companions, you'll traverse the war-torn lands of Terenos, follow
bluejetty:00075567:ios.description:
They call them, "Heroes" in this realm. They defend the last bastions of humanity, battle monstrous hordes, and leave their mark on countless battlefields. Together with your companions, you'll traverse the war-torn lands of Terenos, following the path once tread by legendary heroes.
You will explore ancient ruins, recruit powerful allies, and begin new adventures among countless perilous landscapes.
All the answers you seek will be uncovered in the shadows. Well, what're you waiting for? Are you ready to begin this tactical journey?
Grimguard Tactics is a new Outerdawn Tactical RPG.
Command your squad and experience the dark fantasy world filled with strategic battles and thrilling adventures. Players will meet new allies across various regions and maybe even face some familiar foes. Overcome the challenges together and unravel the hidden truths behind the Primorvan invasion!
Explore Distinct Regions — Discover the war-torn lands filled with danger
3, 2, 1, fight! A fortress under siege, a cursed forest, a village overrun by the horrors... Every mission of this battle is a never-before-seen challenge! Explore perilous landscapes and ancient ruins, uncover mysteries beyond imagination, and set out on a journey of survival and strategy!
Riveting RPG Experience — A best-in-class immersive adventure in a dark fantasy world
Embark on a tactical adventure where you shape the story. Experience high-quality turn-based battles, with innovative character designs, and our original score setting the stage. Join us now and journey through a world of conflict and collaboration, where your choices define the outcome!
Fateful Encounters Await — Cross paths with characters intertwined by destiny
Prepare your squad and embark on this perilous journey together! A fierce and taciturn mercenary, a cunning mayoress, a wise and powerful guildmaster, and even a mysterious and enigmatic wanderer... Confront the darkness together and weave your past, present, and future with courage and sacrifice.
Turn-based Combat Reimagined — Exhilarating Battles Fueled by Strategy and Skill
Get ready for intense battles with a satisfying rhythm! Use a brand-new tactical combat system that enables simple yet strategic controls, employ talents, perks and exploit enemy weaknesses, then finish the fight with style via a powerful abilities.
Customer Service Email: gg-support@outerdawn.com
Official Website: https://www.outerdawn.com/games/grimguard

bluejetty:00039868:ios.description:
Nitro PDF Pro is the modern PDF solution with everything you need to edit, annotate, manage, and secure documents on the go. Built for professionals who need powerful PDF tools anywhere, anytime.
Create, edit, and manage PDFs seamlessly across iPhone and iPad. Nitro PDF Pro integrates with Apple's Files app and your favorite cloud services—iCloud Drive, OneDrive, Box, Dropbox, Google Drive and more—so your documents are always within reach. Work with Apple Pencil or Bluetooth styluses for freehand drawing, writing, and annotating, and use mobile scanning to turn receipts and documents into PDFs.
GET MORE DONE WITH NITRO'S POWERFUL PDF FEATURES
EDIT AND ANNOTATE
Highlight, underline, draw, add text, and leave comments on any PDF with precision tools designed for touch and Apple Pencil.
• Edit text and images with full-page paragraph reflow
• Add sticky notes, text edits, and freehand drawings
• Highlight and underline key passages
• Mark documents with stamps such as Approved or Draft
PAGE MANAGEMENT
Organize your documents your way.
• Add, delete, reorder, and rotate pages
• Extract specific pages into a new document
• Merge multiple PDFs and documents into a single file
MOBILE SCANNING
Turn paper into searchable PDFs instantly.
• Scan documents, receipts, and business cards directly on your device
• Automatic edge detection and perspective correction
• Turn scanned documents into searchable, editable PDFs with OCR
• Batch scan multiple pages in one session
SECURE AND PROTECT
Keep every document, and everything inside it, safe with password protection, encryption, and permission controls.
• Password-protect files and restrict copying or editing
• Permanently redact sensitive information
AI-POWERED PRODUCTIVITY
Get AI tools built for privacy and control, so you can boost productivity without compromising security.
• Automatically extract structured data from tables and forms
SEAMLESS INTEGRATION
Work where you work, with the tools you trust.
• Open PDFs directly from the Files app, OneDrive, and SharePoint
• Share via AirDrop, Mail, or third-party apps
• Access your documents across iPad and iPhone with iCloud sync
Try Nitro PDF Pro for free with a 14-day trial and see why it's the PDF editor for professionals who need to create, edit, and collaborate on PDFs with confidence—from the office to anywhere.
Questions about Nitro PDF Pro? User Guides give you step-by-step instructions for editing, annotating, scanning, securing, and managing documents. Get instant support via our in-app Knowledge Assistant or connect directly with our expert team.

My Town Park game is for kids aged 4-12.

bluejetty:00157456:ios.description:
Welcome to Unique, your comprehensive solution for ADHD and mental health management. Our app helps you improve focus, reduce procrastination, relieve stress, and enhance your overall mental well-being. 
Through guided meditation, mindfulness practices, and cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT) techniques, Unique offers the tools you need for effective ADHD management.
Unique was honored as "Product of the Day" on Product Hunt for its innovative approach to managing ADHD and stress relief.
What Our Users Say: “This app is fantastic for building new habits and managing ADHD! It offers techniques that help someone with ADHD in their daily work and personal life.” – Helena 
"The guided meditation is cool, and the tips provided are helpful. They help me reduce procrastination and relieve stress.” – Melinda
- "Thanks to this app, I've managed to reduce my ADHD symptoms. I love the lessons and the AI-generated guided meditation feature!” – Deniz 
Core Features:
- Focused Lessons: Unique provides practical tips to help you manage your to-do list, enhance focus, reduce procrastination, relieve stress, and use a task manager effectively. Learn how to utilize a planner and calendar to organize your day, improve concentration, and achieve stress relief. 
- Guided Meditation: Experience guided meditation sessions designed for ADHD and ADD. These meditations help reduce stress, enhance focus and concentration, and improve mental health. Meditation is a key component in managing symptoms. 
- Mindfulness Courses: Unique offers beginner-friendly mindfulness courses tailored for managing ADHD, focusing on CBT techniques and executive functioning to improve concentration and reduce stress. 
- Mood Tracker: You can monitor your stress symptoms and emotional states. Understand how different therapies and stress management techniques impact your mental health and provide stress relief. 
- ADHD Tracker: Gain insights into your symptoms and neurodiversity profile. Understand your condition better with Unique and tailor your approach to therapy.
Why Unique:
1. Specific Content: Unique’s content and CBT tools are designed for ADHD, addressing unique challenges and enhancing focus. 
2. Personalized Meditation: Offers a peaceful escape from stress, boosts concentration, and reduces procrastination. Experience personalized meditation with Unique. 
3. Procrastination and Focus Management:
With Unique, you can procrastinate less and improve your focus. Our practical tools and strategies help you stay on task, manage your time effectively, and enhance productivity. 
Benefits of Using Unique:
- Improved Focus and Concentration: Our tailored meditation and CBT techniques enhance mental clarity and productivity. Stay focused and manage your symptoms effectively. 
- Stress Relief and Anxiety Management: Guided meditation sessions help you relax, reduce anxiety, and improve overall mental health. Find stress relief with Unique's comprehensive mental wellness tools. 
- Better Emotional Understanding: Mood and ADHD tracking help you understand your emotional patterns and track your progress. Gain emotional insight with Unique and stay on top of your mental health. 
- Productivity and Organization: Manage tasks efficiently with features like task manager, to-do list, calendar, planner, and reminders. 
- Focus and Concentration: Enhance your concentration using our focus app, Pomodoro technique, guided meditation, mindfulness practices, and white noise. 
- Mental Health and Wellness: Track your symptoms with ADHD tracker, mood tracker, and find relief with therapy, anxiety relief, and stress management techniques. 
Join Unique today and take the first step towards better management, enhanced focus & reduced procrastination.
This app offers support for managing ADHD but should not be seen as a replacement for professional healthcare treatment. For any medical advice or treatment plans, we strongly recommend consulting with a qualified healthcare professional.

bluejetty:00017304:ios.description:
Tower Conquest – the ultimate multiplayer tower defense game that will keep you on the edge of your seat! In this thrilling defense castle game, play against incoming enemies while creating powerful strategies to conquer and dominate your opponents.
Over 70+ different units to choose from when crafting a tower defense strategy. With each victory, you will evolve the perfect army to clash royale troops and dominate the TD league. As you rush royale armies to your opponent's towers, you will feel the kingdom rush to dominate the TD league & become the ultimate tower defense champion! Additionally, you will have a variety of powerful tower defenses at your disposal, each with its unique abilities and strengths. 
Key Features:
Multiplayer tower defense is an objective-based strategic combat system that will challenge your skills in tower defense & speed. You'll need to use your strategic powers to create effective tower defense & take down your enemies before they reach your base.
The Defend Castle game has a vibrant 2D art style that is sure to delight all multiplayer tower defense gamers. With custom animations & over 50 faction-specific arenas, you'll be immersed in a colorful world full of character & Tower + Defense life. Rush royale armies to your opponent’s towers & show them who's boss in this epic multiplayer tower defense game!
One of the most exciting aspects of Tower+Defense Conquest is the ability to collect cards to unlock, merge, & evolve your units. As you progress through the game, you'll be able to unlock new units & upgrade your existing ones.
Tower Defense Conquest's generative map system provides endless opportunities for exploration & rewards. As you meet objectives & travel to new worlds of tower defense & arenas, you'll be able to uncover hidden treasures & discover new challenges to overcome.
To keep the game fresh & exciting, Tower Conquest features tower defense robust daily quests & merchant offerings. With new challenges & rewards every day, embark on your quest for the ultimate kingdom rush. 
Multiplayer tower defense unique squad slots allow you to mix & merge thousands of character combinations to find your perfect TD team. With 5 separate squad slots, you'll be able to experiment with different combinations of units to find the perfect balance of offense & defense.
Tower defense game features challenging player vs. player combat that allows you to battle against your Facebook friends. With the ability to share gifts & compete against each other, test your TD skills against some of the leading players in the game.
Why Choose Us?
With over 10 million downloads & a high rating, many people enjoy playing this TD game. There are several reasons why someone may choose to play Tower Conquest.
Multiplayer tower defense is a highly engaging & entertaining game. The objective of the game is to utilize defense castle strategies to protect your base from incoming waves of enemies by building towers & deploying troops. The game has a wide variety of tower defense & TD game troop types to choose from, each with it's unique abilities & strengths.
It is a challenging TD game that requires strategic thinking and planning to master. As you progress, you unlock new towers and troops, and the difficulty of the waves increases.
Tower Defense can be downloaded & played without incurring any cost, making it accessible to everyone with a smartphone or tablet. It also doesn't require a high-end device to run smoothly.
The multiplayer tower defense offers a variety of in-game purchases to enhance the gameplay experience. Players can purchase in-game currency or gems to unlock new towers & troops or to upgrade existing ones. 
Reach Out To Us:
Our customer support team is always ready to help you & solve any issues instantly. Contact us at our email ID: tcsupport@supergaming.com 
So why wait? Download Tower Conquest today & start defending your towers!

• to export and share the transcription results in various formats including PDF (via the Print option),
• to export the audio of the text read using your chosen voice and speech rate.
And much more:
- See phonetic transcription of the whole text, not just the dictionary forms of separate words.
- Choose between British and American* pronunciation. When British dialect is selected the [r] sound at the end of the word is only voiced if followed by a vowel, which follows British phonetic convention.
- International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA) symbols used.
- The structure of the text and sentences in it (line breaks, punctuation marks, etc.) is preserved in phonetic transcription output making it easier to read.
- You can output the text and its phonetic transcription along each other line-by-line to make back-reference to the original text easier.
- An option to vary pronunciation depending on whether words are in stressed or weak position in the sentence, as in connected speech. Weak forms are italicized in the output.
- Words in CAPS are interpreted as acronyms if the word is not found in the database. Acronym transcriptions will be shown with hyphens between letters.
- In addition to commonly used vocabulary the database contains a very substantial amount of place names (including names of countries, their capitals, US states, UK counties), nationalities and popular names.
- Where a word has a number of possible pronunciations (highlighted in blue in the output) you can select the one that agrees with the context by tapping on it.
- Print out the output results, share via email or copy to pasteboard.
- Let the built-in speech synthesiser read your text out loud. Control the playback and follow IPA transcription of the current word with a highlight. Speech audio can be exported as a file.
- Custom URL scheme to open toPhonetics from 3rd-party apps.
Gestures (IPA transcription screen):
1. Single tap
 - Tap a word to set the cursor to it and speak it (you can mute/un-mute it with the button at your bottom-right).
 - Tap in a blank space to stop speech and hide the cursor.
2. Double-tap
 - Double-tap a word to open it in the built-in dictionary; if the word has multiple pronunciations you'll see the list of them first.
 - Double-tap in a blank space to reset the font to the size set in iOS preferences.
3. Pinch in or out to make the text smaller or larger.
4. Start to slide horizontally to select a part of your text. The Speak button respects current selection.
*) American transcriptions are based on the open Carnegie Mellon University Pronouncing Dictionary.

bluejetty:00132246:ios.description:
New on CalTopo: the CalTopo app is now satellite ready, allowing you to use many features of the app offline with satellite data!
Take the best mapping app with you wherever you go with the CalTopo app for iOS. Trusted by professional mountain guides, avalanche educators, and search and rescue teams, CalTopo has all the features you need to plan your next off-grid pursuit. Seamless integration between CalTopo online and your mobile device allows you to access and update your maps no matter where you are. Any changes you make will automatically sync across all devices, making exporting and importing your latest map a thing of the past.
The CalTopo app allows you to easily take your planning and navigation to the next level. Real time decision making in backcountry terrain is made easy with the ability to download maps and layers like slope angle shading to your device for offline use. Plan for conditions on your route with sun exposure, wind, precipitation and avalanche forecasts. View and track your location on the map using GPS, even if you are offline. Share maps with your teams or travel partners to plan collaboratively, and to ensure everyone has the necessary data. Monitor real time updates from the field, like your friends progress on a long outing with live tracking on shared maps. 
Plan and navigate your next adventure with the CalTopo App today!
Map layers include:
• MapBuilder Topo, Hybrid and Overlay
• Forest Service Maps
• Scanned Topos
• Global Imagery
• Shaded Relief
• Slope Angle Shading (including high resolution elevation data where available)
• Parcel data
• Public Lands
• Weekly Satellite Imagery
• NAIP Satellite Imagery
• Sun Exposure
• Marine Charts
• Weather Forecasting (including wind, precipitation, and temperatures)
• Snow and Water Gauge Data
• Fire History/Activity
• And many more
Support and Feature Requests:
Email us at help@caltopo.com.

bluejetty:00163899:ios.name: Delicious Island: Cooking game
bluejetty:00163899:ios.summary: The cooking game has attracted a lot of players of all ages with its unique combination of creativity, strategy, and time management. This game often simulates the cooking experience in a famous restaurant, allowing players to explore many
bluejetty:00163899:ios.description:
The cooking game has attracted a lot of players of all ages with its unique combination of creativity, strategy, and time management. This game often simulates the cooking experience in a famous restaurant, allowing players to explore many recipes, manage restaurants. 
Cooking games include cooking simulations, restaurant management, and culinary adventures. Players get a variety of experiences from accurate reproductions of real-life dishes to the excitement of running a reimagined vibrant restaurant kitchen.
Delicious Island focuses on the practical aspects of preparation and cooking. The cooking games offer players a wide range of kitchen tools and ingredients, challenge people to follow recipes and create dishes correctly.
Delicious Island consists of a step-by-step process, barbecuing and baking, that simulates the actions a chef would perform in real life. The level of detail and realism can vary, but the idea is to provide an immersive cooking experience.
Restaurant management games add an extra layer of complexity by combining cooking with business management. Delicious Island requires players to not only prepare dishes but also manage restaurant operations. This can include taking customer orders, serving food, upgrading kitchen equipment, and expanding the restaurant. 
The challenge lies in balancing the quick nature of cooking with the strategic elements of running a restaurant. This game often features many world-famous levels and locations, each with increasing difficulty and a new recipe for mastering restaurant chains around the world.
With Delicious Island, players can follow a character's journey from novice chef to world-famous chef, overcome obstacles and unlock new recipes. The adventure aspect adds depth to gameplay, making it engaging and rewarding for players who love storytelling.
Players can experiment with different ingredients and cooking techniques. This creativity helps players learn about many culinary backgrounds and cooking methods.
Become chefs and house managers all over the world with luxurious restaurant chains and interesting guests. 
Download Delicious island, a cooking game to experience new features in the game.

bluejetty:00120257:ios.summary:
Harness the power of a scientifically proven 4-in-1 speech therapy app that boosts reading, writing, speaking, and listening in people with aphasia. Whether you’re recovering from a stroke or brain injury, Language Therapy can help.
STUDIE
bluejetty:00120257:ios.description:
Harness the power of a scientifically proven 4-in-1 speech therapy app that boosts reading, writing, speaking, and listening in people with aphasia. Whether you’re recovering from a stroke or brain injury, Language Therapy can help.
STUDIES SHOW… IT WORKS!
Struggling with language can feel like being trapped in your own mind. But there’s an answer. Research at the University of Cambridge showed improvement in every single participant with chronic aphasia who used this app for 20 minutes a day over 4 weeks. Get real results that last.*
- Overcome aphasia and boost language skills with a proven app designed by experts
- Save big with 4 apps in one – a 25% discount over buying them individually
- Enhance speech therapy with countless activities that are perfect for clinical and home use 
- Learn in 5 languages: US or UK English, Spanish, German, French
- Get a toolkit that’s faster and more adaptable than photo cards, letter tiles, and other therapy aids
- Use score reports and adjustable options to seamlessly fit the app into your therapy program
- Fully customize your activities by adding your own words, pictures, prompts, or sounds
- No subscriptions, ever – our best-selling app will always be there when you need it
** THERE’S NO BETTER TIME TO START. Try it now for FREE with Language Therapy Lite! **
HERE’S WHAT YOU GET IN ONE EASY PACKAGE:
COMPREHENSION THERAPY – IMPROVE YOUR UNDERSTANDING 
Build listening and reading comprehension skills for nouns, verbs, and adjectives. Take the first step in your aphasia recovery with an app that automatically adjusts difficulty based on performance. 
3 ACTIVITIES: Listen | Read | Listen & Read
NAMING THERAPY – FIND THE RIGHT WORDS 
Practice naming and improve word-finding skills. In 4 activities, you do everything from naming the things you see to describing their features, all with cues and hints to guide you. Build independence by learning strategies to communicate your thoughts and needs.
4 ACTIVITIES: Naming Practice | Describe | Naming Test | Flashcards
READING THERAPY – TAKE YOUR READING TO THE NEXT LEVEL 
Strengthen literacy with phrase and sentence exercises in an app that’s perfect for independent practice. Improve attention to detail, practice oral reading, and build on the single words of Comprehension Therapy as you move toward the more advanced reading skills needed for independent living.
4 ACTIVITIES: Phrase Matching | Phrase Completion | Sentence Matching | Sentence Completion
WRITING THERAPY – BOOST YOUR SPELLING SKILLS 
Improve spelling ability by practicing completing and building the words you hear and see. Pick letters from a limited choice or full alphabet, then place and rearrange them at will for an intuitive and challenging experience. The perfect spelling practice is waiting.
4 ACTIVITIES: Fill in the Blank | Copy | Spell What You See | Spell What You Hear
IN ALL 4 OF LANGUAGE THERAPY’S APPS, YOU GET:
- 700+ core nouns, verbs, and adjectives that run throughout all 4 apps
- Thousands of exercises for countless hours of practice
- Recommendations on what to do next based on your score
- Activities for people struggling with aphasia after stroke or brain injury, autism, or just learning a new language
- Simple, distraction-free interfaces that are easy to use for all ages and abilities
- No subscriptions, no monthly bills, no Wi-Fi needed
WHY WASTE YOUR TIME ON APPS THAT DON’T WORK? Download Language Therapy and watch the improvement begin.
** DOWNLOAD IT NOW, or try it for free with Language Therapy Lite! **
Looking for something different in a speech therapy app, or only interested in one of the apps in Language Therapy? Find the right apps for you at tactustherapy.com/find
*Every person and every brain is different. Your results may vary.

bluejetty:00160995:ios.description:
Track your steps, level up and earn cash by entering monthly step challenges personalized to your step history. Winners split the cash pot. You can walk and run indoors on a treadmill or outdoors. 
Here are some ways you can make money with PaidToGo:
Earn by the mile 
Earn for hitting daily step targets
Level up to increase coins per mile
Challenges - Bet real money split the pot with other winners
Play Games 
Invite Friends
Share your Daily Steps
Earn by the mile/step for Pro Members:
1 Coin = 1 Cent USD
Coins per Mile/2000 Steps: 5 Coins
Daily Step Target Reward: 20 Coins
Referrals: 1000 Coins
Share Daily Steps: 1 Coin
Watch ads - 1 Coin per ad
How You Get Paid:
Payouts are made via Paypal
Note: You must be a Pro member to cash and and still have an active Pro subscription on the date of your payout as listed in the app.
Fitness Tracker Features:
Apple Health Sync
Community Challenges
Pedometer/step counter
Track miles
Calorie Tracker
Fitness Analytics - Track your progress over time
Paidtogo utilizes data from Apple Health for step tracking functionality. Please make sure you have approved Paidtogo in your Apple Health data authorizations.
*What people are saying*
"I just got paid! At first, I was a tad skeptical about this app. You have to really commit to using it long-term to see the benefits. I just got paid my June earnings, for both the Free and Pro Pools, and can say I definitely made a profit over what I spent on the Pro subscription! If you’re moderately active, it’s well worth it. Just make sure you check-in each day to sync your steps and update your standing on the leaderboard, and you can expect to get paid down the line! Super simple to use."
"Great app and responsive developer! Paidtogo is a great idea and an amazing motivator. I recently had an issue with the app. The developer responded personally and had an update pushed out with a fix within 1 day! Amazing! I highly recommend. Update - I just received my first payout! What an awesome app!"
Give us your feedback about how we can make the platform better at:
Email: support@paidtogo.com
Website: www.Paidtogo.com
Terms and Conditions: https://www.paidtogo.com/how_it_works
Privacy Policy: https://www.paidtogo.com/privacy_policy

bluejetty:00019394:ios.description:
Did you ever think to drive the gigantic School Bus or Coach? Are you afraid to drive something GREAT like school bus coach or something Big? This game app will allow you to sit tight at the driver’s seat and go around the attractive city locations and have fun. You are not supposed to have a distinctive driving test or license to drive the heavy buses all around the magnificent city. Let’s play and try, who can be a successful driver.
Go ahead towards front seat as the school bus driver, and pick up passenger kids and drop them ahead to their destinations in your school bus. Consider yourself as the crazy school bus driver; in charge of the public bus transport, all you have to do is to give your school kids a safe and sound drive round the city, pick and drop them to their destinations in this bus driver simulator game. You have to avoid the collisions with the traffic vehicles in order to pick and drop the school students safe and sound. Use you controls to stay clear of dangers on the road; these controls include signals, dippers, different camera views and much more. And maybe you like this game so much that you might start applying bus driver license for real. School bus driving simulator is a game for everyone that would like to keep those driving skills up to date, you need to practice everything from parking, reversing and use your mental skills to keep calm.
Are you ready for an enjoyable adventure? Your mission is to safely pick and drop the kids by driving your school bus!!!!
Features of School bus simulator 
• It’s absolutely FREE on ios app store !
• 3D city environment with realistic graphics 
• Realistic bus driving physics
• Smooth controls and fun gameplay
• Digital and analog speedometer
• Cash Animation
• Realistic intelligent traffic 
• Experience the smooth gameplay of this free driving simulator game
• Detailed 3d graphics optimized to run smooth on your mobile phone or tablet device
• iOS Optimization: runs perfectly on anything from the original iPad 1 to the latest 5th Generation widescreen devices.

bluejetty:00123782:ios.description:
Xiangqi (Chinese Chess) is a traditional strategy board game widely enjoyed in China, Vietnam, and many other countries. This app allows players from around the world to enjoy Xiangqi online in a friendly and skill-based environment.
Play Xiangqi anytime, anywhere, and connect with other players through online matches and live game viewing. The app supports both portrait and landscape modes for a comfortable playing experience.
Download Xiangqi Online for free.
Features:
• Play as a guest or sign in with Game Center to track your progress.
• Online matchmaking with players of similar skill levels.
• Join private rooms using a room ID to play with friends or family.
• View ongoing matches in real time and review completed games to learn and improve.
• Create custom game rooms with adjustable time settings.
• In-game chat during matches.
• Practice mode to play against yourself with a timer to analyze moves and improve strategy.

The Power of Leading CPA, CMA, and CIA Exam Prep In Your Pocket
When you partner with UWorld, you partner with a team of certified accounting experts who have been where you are, understand what it takes to pass high-stakes exams, and are dedicated to making the hard stuff easy to understand. 
Get everything you need to study on the go with our exclusive UWorld Accounting mobile app, including your industry-leading QBank with thousands of exam-level practice questions, your study guide in digital format, and more. Want to review lecture videos while commuting or hitting the gym? Download your favorite video lectures for later viewing offline. Features: 
• Comprehensive QBank with detailed answer explanations that highlight the why for every question 
• Customizable Study Planner that develops your personalized lesson deadlines in seconds 
• Downloadable Video Lectures by expert CPA, CMA, and CIA instructors 
• Easy-to-access ReadyDeck pre-built flashcards–plus the power to build your own

Benefits: 
• Enjoy the same tools and content you study with at home while on the go 
• Sync across devices for a customizable study experience 
• Focus on exam content with an easy-to-use, tool-packed interface 
• Access exclusive UWorld study content monitored and updated daily 
• Prepare for exam-day success with a recognized leader in the learning technology space

bluejetty:00029931:ios.summary:
Get ready for the ultimate word adventure! An exciting blend of turn-based strategy and crossword role-playing game, World of Words pits you against up to 3 other players for a globe-trotting word experience like no other.
EVERYONE LOVES W
bluejetty:00029931:ios.description:
Get ready for the ultimate word adventure! An exciting blend of turn-based strategy and crossword role-playing game, World of Words pits you against up to 3 other players for a globe-trotting word experience like no other.
EVERYONE LOVES WORLD OF WORDS!
"In comparison to World of Words, [those other word games] are so innocent." —TiPb
"World of Words adds a welcome cut-throat edge to more classic word games... and is damn fun to play as a result." —What's On iPhone
"This game threw all my prejudices about crossword puzzles out the window!" —AppMyWorld
"If you like crossword battle games and the letters on your board have worn away with use, then I suggest you give this game a try and see if the aggressive gameplay helps to refresh a classic board game." —Smokin' Apps
"Thankfully a spelling game where the favor tends to lean on my [aggressive] side." —App Store Arcade
THE MOST ACTION-PACKED WORD GAME EVER DEVISED
World of Words takes your standard online crossword game and amplifies it with Bombs, Whirlwinds, Snowstorms, and more! Level your character up, unlocking new action tiles and boards. Experience epic four player games, customize your character with unique titles and avatars, or try out Nightmare Mode for an extra challenge! Grab an extra boost anytime by calling in the Reserves!
BETTER THAN LETTERS — WORLD OF WORDS INTRODUCES ACTION TILES
- Multiplier Tiles multiply scoring of letters and words
- Star Tiles let players play a word anywhere
- Bomb Tiles destroy letter tiles in a square
- Shield Tiles protect areas from opponents
- Extra Turn Tiles allow players to play two turns in a row
- Nuclear Bomb Tiles destroy the entire board
- Plus MANY more!
EXPLORE THE MANY WORLDS OF WORDS
- The Call to Adventure takes you through the countryside and into the busy city streets, where a nuclear bomb decimates everything you know.
- Jungle of the Elements brings you into the sweltering jungle, where the elements (and pirates) seek to bring your doom!
- The Sands of Time is a vast desert filled with ancient mysteries, ruins and treasures.
- The Depths of Winter is a trek to the North Pole in the face of glaciers, blizzards and Yetis.
- The Fear of Darkness takes you to the depths of the Abyss, featuring spooky Ghosts, Bats, and more.
- The Great Beyond is a journey into space!
TONS OF OTHER FEATURES
- Adventure through 8 worlds, discovering over 200 beautiful boards
- Utilize 23 incredible action tiles
- Unearth secret treasures
- Defeat difficult hazards
- Unlock hundreds of achievements
- Customize your character with unique titles and avatars
- Use Talents to modify your gameplay
- Compete on the global leaderboards
- Support for up to four players in a single match
- Play online with up to 120 friends at once, or play at home with friends using Pass and Play
- Online chat
REQUIREMENTS
- Devices supported: iPhone 5S and up, iPod Touch 6th Generation and up, iPad Mini 2 and up
- Requires iOS 12 or higher
- A Game Center account is required to play with friends
- Requires an Internet connection
SUBSCRIPTION INFO
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period
- Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to Account Settings after purchase
Support: support@wolf-studios.com
Terms of Service: http://www.jeremythomasfuller.com/privacy/
Privacy Policy: https://www.termsfeed.com/terms-use/01e87def9cf813ef34059e15e9602cb9

bluejetty:00168055:ios.description:
Discover the power of AI-driven home design with RoomGPT, the ultimate app for transforming your living space. Simply take a picture of any room in your house, choose from a wide array of stylish options, and watch as your room is reimagined before your eyes. Whether you prefer the serene beauty of Scandinavian design, the sleek look of Minimalist Dark, or the boldness of Industrial style, RoomGPT has something for everyone.
Key Features:

Choose from an extensive library of design styles to completely transform your room. From the tranquility of Sea Scandinavian to the opulence of Luxurious, RoomGPT offers a variety of styles to suit your taste.
2. Custom Prompts:
Elevate your redesign by adjusting the style of specific elements in your room. Want your vintage armchair to have a modern twist or your bookshelf to match a different aesthetic? Just describe your vision, and Reecor AI will seamlessly transform the actual elements in your picture to reflect the new style.
3. Brush Tool:
Focus on specific areas of your room with the Brush tool. Highlight an object, like a couch or a bookshelf, and transform it individually using your chosen prompt. It's perfect for making detailed adjustments and ensuring every part of your room is just right.
Why Choose RoomGPT?
User-Friendly Interface: Intuitive and easy to use, RoomGPT makes home design accessible to everyone.
High-Quality Transformations: Powered by advanced AI, RoomGPT ensures realistic and high-quality visual transformations.
Endless Possibilities: With a wide range of styles and customization options, the design possibilities are endless.
Whether you're looking to redecorate or just make a few tweaks completely, RoomGPT is your go-to app for all things interior design. Download now and start transforming your home today!

bluejetty:00081919:ios.description:
jetAudio is a music player with 10/20 bands graphic equalizer, visualization, network/cloud streaming and various sound effects.
-- Sound Effects & Visualization plugins --
* Crystalizer
* AM3D Audio Enhancer (http://www.am3d.com)
* Bongiovi DPS (http://www.bongioviacoustics.com)
* Visualizations
(Sound effect & Visualization plugins will be sold separately through in-app purchase.)
jetAudio is the highest rated and most downloaded media player on CNET.COM and now you can listen to same high-quality sound on your iOS devices using jetAudio.
It plays almost any type of digital music files* you have (wav, mp3, ogg, flac, m4a, dsd, dsf, mpc, tta, wv, ape and more) and it provides a very high quality sound with various effects and enhancements such as Wide, Reverb, X-Bass.
It comes with 16 equalizer presets that will provide a wide array of listening experience. 
For those who would like to customize their own sound experience, it also allows 10/20 bands graphic equalizer and other advanced playback functions including playback speed control, crossfading, AGC and much more.
It can stream music from shared folders on local home network or WebDAV servers. It works with shared folders from Windows, USB drive attached to router, Network drives (NAS) or WebDAV servers.
It also can stream music files in the cloud such as Google Drive, Dropbox, Box, OneDrive.
Free version provides same features with Plus version except advertisements and some features.
To enjoy full features of jetAudio, please purchase Plus Unlocker through In-App purchases. 
-- Features for Plus version only --
* 20-Bands Graphic Equalizer
* Light Gray/White/Black Theme for Browser/Player
* Album Art Size for Browser
* Album Art Background for Player
* Accent Color
* No Ads
-- Features for Basic/Plus version --
* Play music via Wi-Fi from shared folders on local home network (SMB)
* Browse Artists/Albums/Songs/Folder/Playlists/Album Artists/Genres/Compilation category
* 10-Bands Graphic Equalizer
* X-Wide, Reverb, X-Bass Sound Effects
* AGC (automatic gain control) to avoid volume fluctuations between tracks
* Speed Control from 50% to 200% (pitch adjusted)
* Pitch Shifter
* Crossfading, Gap-less playback
* Display Lyrics
* Fade-in/Fade-out 
* Repeat A-B
* Balance
* Sleep Timer up to 24 hours
* Flick up to show Now Playing
* Flick left/right to play next/previous
* Web Server to Transfer Files using any Web Browser (for Folder Browser)
(*) FLAC, OGG, DSD, DSF, MPC, TTA, WV, APE, OPUS formats are supported in Folder Browser mode only.
Use iTunes File Sharing or WiFi Transfer to copy files to jetAudio folder.
(If you want to localize jetAudio for your language, please contact jetaudio@jetappfactory.com for more information)

bluejetty:00068082:ios.name: Dinolingo Kids Learn Languages
bluejetty:00068082:ios.summary:
Help your child learn Spanish, French, English, and 47 more languages through stories, songs, videos, books, and interactive games. Dinolingo is a language learning app built specifically for kids ages 2 to 12.
40,000+ Activities. 50 Langu
bluejetty:00068082:ios.description:
Help your child learn Spanish, French, English, and 47 more languages through stories, songs, videos, books, and interactive games. Dinolingo is a language learning app built specifically for kids ages 2 to 12.
40,000+ Activities. 50 Languages. One Family Subscription.
With over 40,000 activities spanning videos, interactive games, storybooks, songs, audiobooks, flashcards, and printable worksheets, there is always something new for your child to explore. A single subscription unlocks all 50 languages, so
kids can start learning any language at any time. Whether your goal is to raise bilingual kids or simply give them a head start, one family plan covers up to 6 children, each learning at their own pace and level.
How Kids Learn with Dinolingo
Dinolingo uses total immersion, the same way children learn their first language. No translations. No grammar drills. Kids watch, listen, and start speaking naturally through videos, learning games, books, songs, and flashcards.
Dinolingo grows with your child, supporting toddler language learning, preschool learners, elementary students, and children up to age 12.
Built for Kids. Loved by Parents.
- Earn dinosaurs and rewards with every lesson
- Learning games for kids at every age
- Stories, songs, audiobooks and worksheets
- Parent dashboard to track every child's progress
- Switch between 50 languages anytime
One Subscription. Up to 6 children.
Every Dinolingo plan covers your whole family. All 50 languages and all 40,000+ activities for every child at every level, from preschool to middle school.
Dinolingo is SOC2 compliant, meaning your family's data is protected with industry-standard security practices.
Languages include:
Spanish, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Chinese, Arabic, Korean, Russian, Portuguese, Dutch, Greek, Hebrew, Turkish, Polish, Hindi, Ukrainian, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish, Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian, Irish, Welsh, Latin,Swahili, Hawaiian, and 21 more.
Kids can learn Spanish, French, Japanese, and dozens more through the same natural immersion method trusted by parents and educators worldwide.
You can cancel the subscription at any time, with access continuing until the current billing period ends.
A subscription is required to access Dinolingo's full language curriculum. Your subscription renews automatically based on your chosen plan (monthly or yearly) and can be cancelled at any time.
You can check our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy from the following links:
Terms of Use: https://www.dinolingo.com/terms-and-conditions/
Privacy Policy: https://dinolingo.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00172607:ios.name: Moneybox: Savings Goal Tracker
bluejetty:00172607:ios.summary: Turn your dreams into a plan with Moneybox — your personal savings manager and digital piggy bank. Whether you're saving for a new car, a dream vacation, a home, education or a rainy day, Moneybox makes putting money aside simple, visual an
bluejetty:00172607:ios.description:
Turn your dreams into a plan with Moneybox — your personal savings manager and digital piggy bank. Whether you're saving for a new car, a dream vacation, a home, education or a rainy day, Moneybox makes putting money aside simple, visual and genuinely motivating.
Create as many money boxes as you have goals, give each one a name, color and icon, set a target, and watch your progress bar fill as your savings grow. Add a deposit whenever it suits you, week by week or month by month, and feel the quiet satisfaction of getting closer to what you want.
WHY YOU'LL LOVE MONEYBOX
• Unlimited money boxes — one for every goal, big or small.
• Personalized — name each box and choose its color and icon.
• Goal tracker — set a target and follow your progress visually.
• Starting balance — begin a box with the savings you already have.
• Deposit or withdraw — manage your money flexibly, anytime.
• Progress bar — see at a glance how close you are to each goal.
• Detailed history — review every deposit and spot your saving trends.
• Educational content — handy tips to grow your financial know-how.
• Works offline — light & dark themes — available in 70+ languages.
WHY A MONEYBOX WORKS
Saving is hard when it's abstract. By giving every goal its own box, a clear target and a progress bar you can actually see, Moneybox makes the habit stick. Small, regular deposits feel effortless — and watching the bar inch forward is exactly the encouragement you need to keep going.
ONE APP, EVERY GOAL
Keep your holiday fund separate from your emergency fund, and your gadget savings apart from your gift budget. With unlimited, fully customizable boxes, you always know precisely how much you've set aside and what it's for — no spreadsheets, no guesswork.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Create a money box and set your goal.
2. Add deposits whenever you can.
3. Watch the progress bar grow until you reach your target.
PERFECT FOR
• Saving for a car, home, trip, wedding or gadget.
• Building an emergency or rainy-day fund.
• Teaching kids the habit of saving.
• Anyone who wants to reach their financial goals faster.
Every big goal starts with a single deposit. With Moneybox as your savings companion, you'll build better money habits, stay motivated, and finally turn "someday" into a real date on the calendar.
SAVING, MADE SATISFYING
Money goals fail when they feel like sacrifice. Moneybox flips that feeling: every deposit is a small, visible win, and every progress bar a little hit of motivation. Instead of vaguely "trying to save", you watch real momentum build — and that momentum is what carries you all the way to the goal.
BUILT FOR REAL LIFE
Save at your own pace, on your own schedule. Pop in spare change after payday, add a lump sum when you can, or set steady weekly amounts — Moneybox adapts to however you like to save. And because everything works offline and stays on your device, your plans are always private and always with you.
SET GOALS YOU'LL ACTUALLY REACH
• Break a big target into small, manageable deposits.
• Give every goal a deadline and a clear finish line.
• Celebrate as each box fills up and your savings grow.
Moneybox savings tracker and piggy bank: create unlimited money boxes, set financial goals, deposit and withdraw, track progress with a visual bar and history, and save for a car, vacation, home or emergency fund.
Download Moneybox today and start saving for what matters most.
Privacy Policy: https://www.shpavda.com/products/moneybox/privacy/
Terms & Conditions: https://www.shpavda.com/products/moneybox/terms/ios/

bluejetty:00159666:ios.name: Prospre - Meal Planner
bluejetty:00159666:ios.summary:
Create the perfect diet in seconds. Using your goals and favorite foods, Prospre will automatically plan your meals for the week and tell you exactly what to buy in the grocery store.
Prospre can create a meal plan that contains any amount
bluejetty:00159666:ios.description:
Create the perfect diet in seconds. Using your goals and favorite foods, Prospre will automatically plan your meals for the week and tell you exactly what to buy in the grocery store.
Prospre can create a meal plan that contains any amount of calories, protein, fat, and carbs. We make meal planning and meal prep simple, so you no longer have to worry about whether you will get enough protein or stay under your fat goal. We are more than a food diary or diet tracker. Why track macros or count calories when you can create a plan to hit your goals every time?
Follow our easy recipes and prep your food in advance; Prospre is the easiest way to stick to your diet and achieve your fitness goals. Our meal plans are packed with micronutrients and are designed to be as healthy as possible. They are usually low sugar, high fiber, and low sodium. Whether you are looking to slim down, get shredded, bulk up, or increase energy, our meal plans can help you get there.
Features:
MEAL PLAN GENERATION
• Tell us what recipes you like using the thumbs up/down option
• Set your calorie and macronutrient goals
• Create an instant custom meal plan with one click
• Regenerate days, or swap out meals to get the perfect plan!
MACRO TRACKER AND FOOD DIARY
• Log foods as you eat them and keep track of your intake
• Get detailed daily totals of nutritional information (macronutrients and micronutrients)
• Search our database or use our barcode scanner to track your food.
AUTOMATIC GROCERY LISTS
• Get a complete grocery list with the amounts you need to follow your plan
• Buy all your groceries on Amazon Fresh with one click
FIT IN TREATS
• Track a treat, and your plan will automatically adjust to make sure you still hit your macro goals
AI COACH
• Reach your fitness goals with the help of our AI Coach
• Get suggestions for your macronutrient goals that change with your progress
Check out what Prospre can help you do:
- Get The Results You Want
Whether you are a bodybuilder looking to get jacked, or a new parent who wants to stay healthy, there are macronutrient targets that will help you achieve your goal. 
Prospre doesn’t rely on fad diets. We just make good nutrition easy. Because Prospre can make a meal plan for any calorie and macronutrient combination, we can make the perfect diet for any goal.
- Eat the Foods You Like
Create a meal plan that you actually want to follow. Prospre tailors your plan to suit your tastes.
Only your “liked” recipes will be used in your plan. If you aren’t in the mood for something in your plan, regenerate that meal. If a whole day isn’t to your liking, regenerate that day. If you are craving a piece of pizza that isn’t in your plan, use the “fit into plan” feature. The rest of your day will automatically adjust to fit that pizza into your goals.
- Save Time, Money, and Reduce Your Food Waste
Prospre’s automatic grocery lists will help you buy the right amount of food on your next grocery run.
Select the date range you want to buy groceries for, and we will tell you the exact amount of each ingredient that you will need to follow your meal plan. No more throwing out food because you bought too much or forgot to eat it before its expiration date.
Follow us:
Instagram - @prospre_app
Facebook - @ProspreApp
Twitter - @ProspreApp
Reddit - r/Prospre
Prospre is here to help you meet your fitness goals, but the information in this app is not intended as medical advice. Always seek the help of a medical professional before making any decisions about your health.
Terms of Service: prospre.io/terms-of-service

- Beautiful east style

- Challenge and help your friends
- Collect coins for your Arab Prince

bluejetty:00062685:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00062685:ios.description:
SkyView® Lite brings stargazing to everyone! Simply point your iPhone, iPad, or iPod at the sky to identify stars, constellations, satellites, and more!
Downloaded over 40 million times.
If you like our lite version of SkyView then you'll love our full version! It includes: a convenient Apple Watch app, a Today Widget displaying tonight's brightest objects, ALL in-app purchases offered in this version, thousands more objects to discover, and more!
App Store Best of 2012
App Store Rewind 2011 -- Best Education App
“If you've ever wanted to know what you're looking at in the night sky, this app is the perfect stargazer's companion.” 
– CNET 
"If you’ve ever been looking for a stargazing app for your iPhone, then this [is] definitely the one to get." 
– AppAdvice 
“SkyView is an Augmented Reality app that lets you see just what delights the sky has to offer.” 
– 148Apps Editor’s Choice
You don't need to be an astronomer to find stars or constellations in the sky, just open SkyView® Lite and let it guide you to their location and identify them. SkyView® Lite is a beautiful and intuitive stargazing app that uses your camera to precisely spot and identify celestial objects in sky, day or night. Find your favorite constellations as they fade in and out while you scan across the sky, locate the Moon, discover distant galaxies, and witness satellite fly-bys.
Features: 
• Simple: Point your device at the sky to identify galaxies, stars, constellations and satellites (including the ISS and Hubble) passing overhead at your location.
• Sightings: set reminders for celestial events and plan an evening stargazing & spotting satellites.
• Augmented Reality (AR): Use your camera to spot objects in the sky, day or night.
• Sky Paths: Follow the daily sky tracks for the Sun and Moon to see their exact locations in the sky on any date & time.
• Time Travel: Jump to the future or the past and see the sky on different dates and times.
• Social: Capture and share beautiful images with friends and family on social networks. 
• Mobile: WiFi is NOT required (does not require a data signal or GPS to function). Take it camping, boating, or even flying!
• Supports Space Navigator™ binoculars, spotting scope, and telescopes.
What a fun way to teach yourself, your children, your students, or your friends about our wonderful universe!

bluejetty:00166603:ios.name: Gold Rush: Frozen Farm
bluejetty:00166603:ios.summary:
► STRIKE IT RICH
There’s gold in them hills! Join in on this thrilling gold rush adventure as you build bustling settlements, stake your claim on land, and mine for gold deep in the treacherous mountains. Face the harsh realities of surviv
bluejetty:00166603:ios.description:
► STRIKE IT RICH
There’s gold in them hills! Join in on this thrilling gold rush adventure as you build bustling settlements, stake your claim on land, and mine for gold deep in the treacherous mountains. Face the harsh realities of survival as you brave freezing winter temperatures and scarce resources, all while trying to strike it rich and earn enough money to save your sick father.
It’s a race against time and nature, but fortune favors the brave. So what are you waiting for, partner? Grab your snow shovel, and let’s start mining for gold! The adventure of a lifetime awaits!
► MINE YOUR OWN BUSINESS!
Your adventure begins in the dead of winter during a whiteout, so you’ll need to focus on clearing snow from the settlement and mine after they were hit by an avalanche in order to ensure your survival before you can even begin to think of earning money. Once you’ve gotten things in the town under control, you can move on to the mines where you’ll pan for gold to send back home to your family. Enjoy exploring and while also earning resources in this frozen idle adventure game where there’s always something new to do, be it build a town, thaw survivors, or explore all the fun locations!
- Snowy settlements – Following an avalanche and a whiteout, the town is completely snowed under! Use your trusty snowplow to clear it and uncover a wealth of resources underneath, including a few frozen friends…
- Frozen survivors – thaw them out by the fire and soon you’ll have helpers in your quest to get the settlement up and running again. Your new friends will be happy to stay back and work idly on tasks for you, increasing the town’s production rate and keeping you all fueled while you’re off on adventure.
- Great resources and buildings – it’s survival of the fittest out there, so collect all manner of resources from under the snow and in the mines that can be either used as they are or combined to make something special! Build structures and improve on other items, all with what you can find under the snow.
- Harvesting – If you want to mine gold, you’re going to need energy! Uncover crop land and plant seeds to both feed your growing town and earn you coins.
- Expeditions – your survival depends on your ability to keep finding resources, so once you have your base up and running, start pushing North in search of more gold, resources, and adventure. Remember, the more you can find and mine, the more you can send back home to your family to help your father!
► THE WORLD IS YOUR (GOLDEN) OYSTER
Set out on the adventure of a lifetime to earn money to pay for your father’s treatment, and along the way uncover frozen friends, rebuild towns, mine gold, and so much more. With lots of great locations to uncover and resources to collect and use there’s always something happening in this frozen adventure!
If you’re looking for a fun idle survival game that is chock full of hours of fun, Gold Rush: Frozen Adventures is the game for you so download it today to get to playing!
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00024485:ios.description:
First, you saved the girl. Now you must save the guy in your next level scenario puzzler! The other tricky and relaxing puzzle game you’ve been seeing all this time is also now a reality! The man is trapped in a complex funny scene that only the smartest will be able to solve. Pull the pins in the right order to save him. However, if you fail it will be doom for our hero! Each level is unique with different results whether you solve them correctly or fail. 
Feel the satisfaction whether you win or lose. Feel the gratification of solving funny and difficult problems and protecting the man from harm's way. Use that big brain of yours and start pulling him out of trouble!
 Game Features:
1. Don’t get fooled!
Each level presents you with multiple choices - pull the correct pins to proceed. Wrong answers will result in painful but funny outcomes for our man!
2. So many levels to play
Each level is unique. So many different challenges for you to solve.
3. Simple and Addicting Gameplay
Once you start pulling him out of danger, you’ll never want to stop. You’ll want to keep solving the upcoming puzzles. This is the best puzzler out there!
4. It is that other game from those ads
Yes, it actually is.
Whether you are a fan of puzzlers, word games, trivia games, quiz games, brain teasers, or you are just curious what those ads are all about, then Pull Him Out is the game for you! Will you pull the right ones out?

bluejetty:00013631:ios.name: Bank Audi
bluejetty:00013631:ios.summary: The Bank Audi mobile app offers you ultimate flexibility while managing your finances and performing round-the-clock transactions from the palm of your hand. Through a new interactive and dynamic layout, this highly safe and responsive app
bluejetty:00013631:ios.description:
The Bank Audi mobile app offers you ultimate flexibility while managing your finances and performing round-the-clock transactions from the palm of your hand. Through a new interactive and dynamic layout, this highly safe and responsive app allows you, before logging in, to: 
- View Bank Audi products and services. 
- Simulate a loan. 
- Locate branches and ATMs. 
- Convert currencies. 
- Enroll directly through the mobile app, using your Debit Card info. You will receive your online username and password instantly by SMS and Email.
- Reset your password, if you are an existing user, using your Debit Card info. You will receive your new password by SMS.
and much more.
You can log in with your fingerprint, your User ID and Password, a pattern or a PIN to:
- Get your accounts’ and cards’ full details and activities. 
- Transfer money between your accounts, between other Bank Audi accounts, and non-Bank Audi accounts, locally and internationally. 
- Settle your credit card bills. 
- Request a chequebook.
- Make International Transfers from your External Account.
- Send “Vouchers” to your loved ones.
among other transactions. 
The Bank Audi mobile app gives you all the banking tools you need on a single user-friendly platform. 
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00070461:ios.name: Holy Places of the Lord
bluejetty:00070461:ios.summary: An engaging reference and visit tracking tool with pictures, info, maps, and links to information on holy places of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. Create your personal history of our sacred Temples, Historical Sites, and V
bluejetty:00070461:ios.description:
An engaging reference and visit tracking tool with pictures, info, maps, and links to information on holy places of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. Create your personal history of our sacred Temples, Historical Sites, and Visitors' Centers by tracking visits with notes, photos, and the ordinances performed.
Designed for iPhone, iPad, and the foldable iPhone Duo, with the list beside the details on larger screens. On iOS 27, you can even record a visit just by asking Siri.
Explore
 • Full-screen interactive map with a Timeline mode — watch temples spread across the world from the Restoration Era to today, starting with Kirtland Temple (1836) and the original Nauvoo Temple (1846). Step through dedication years, see the era and temple count as you go, or tap Play for an animated journey through history
 • Tap a map pin to see the place photo, then open the place or get directions without losing your spot
 • Continent outlines keep the map usable with little or no service
 • Filter the map and list by category, visited, or not-visited
 • Sort by Alphabetical, Nearest, Country, Dedication Date, Announced Date, or Size (temples)
 • Place Details with quick links to map the location, navigate, call, or view the website
 • Historical names and photos — places that have been renamed show the name and image from the time of your visit
 • Regular updates including the latest progress on temples under construction
Track
 • Record visits with notes, photos, and ordinances performed
 • Edit a visit later, including changing the place
 • Optional profiles to track visits separately for family members — record one visit for several people at once, or copy visits to another profile
 • Filter visits by place type, ordinance type, or favorites
 • Set annual goals for temple visits and each ordinance, and track your progress
 • Optional reminder notifications to record a visit after leaving a holy place
 • Back up your visits and photos to a file you can import on another device
Ask Siri (iOS 27)
 • Record a visit by voice — at an active temple Siri asks which ordinances you did, and for any place it offers to add notes
 • Get directions to the nearest holy place
 • Hear your goal progress and how many temples you've visited
 • Open a place or visit, or search places and visit notes
Celebrate
 • Summary page showing total places visited and ordinances performed by year and overall
 • Motivational achievement system tracking significant milestones and where you reached them
 • Share completed achievements as an image
 • Optionally post eligible milestones to the public Celebration Board with your name and location
 • Temple-themed inspirational quotes
Share
 • Send an App Store or Google Play link to friends and family
 • Display or share a QR code for either store
 • View, print, and share a full promotional PDF
Personalize
 • Choose the Home background: the default photo, a random photo from your visits, or one of your own, cropped to fill or shown in full
 • Color themes, including Mono for easier reading, and optional place-type symbols on the lists
More
 • Companion Apple Watch app with a celestial-themed timer and gentle wrist taps — ideal for staying attentive during a temple session
 • Widgets for a featured visit, achievement and goal progress, and a daily quote
 • Home Screen Quick Actions: Nearest Places, Random Place, and Record Visit or Navigate To for the closest place
The Holy Places logo, created by my daughter, features The Morning Star from the stained glass windows of the Nauvoo Temple — representing both the Historical and Temple aspects of the app.
* Holy Places of the Lord is an independent, unofficial app created by Derek S. Cordon. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.

bluejetty:00137825:ios.name: Mini World: Color by Number
bluejetty:00137825:ios.summary: Step into Mini World: Color by Number, a captivating digital coloring app designed for both adults and teens who seek calm, creativity, and relaxation. Explore tiny, detailed scenes that spark your imagination and soothe your mind. Every ta
bluejetty:00137825:ios.description:
Step into Mini World: Color by Number, a captivating digital coloring app designed for both adults and teens who seek calm, creativity, and relaxation. Explore tiny, detailed scenes that spark your imagination and soothe your mind. Every tap brings your artwork to life, offering a peaceful escape from the stresses of everyday life. Relax, unwind, and create beautiful masterpieces effortlessly—no drawing skills required.
Whether you’re searching for a mindful pastime, a creative outlet, or simply a fun way to relax, Mini World delivers thousands of charming coloring pages—from miniature landscapes and delicate mandalas to cozy scenes and enchanting worlds. This is your go-to app for daily art therapy and stress relief.
Why You’ll Love Mini World:
1. Simple and Addictive Paint by Number Gameplay
Dive into an intuitive coloring experience where you tap numbers to apply colors—no brushes, no mess. Watch your tiny world unfold one color at a time as you complete each intricate scene with satisfying precision.
2. Fresh Content Added Daily
Discover new miniature-themed coloring pages every day. From enchanted gardens and fairy cottages to peaceful ocean views and celestial skies, there’s always a fresh scene waiting for your artistic touch.
3. Beautiful Miniature-Themed Artwork
Unleash your creativity with tiny, highly detailed illustrations inspired by nature, fantasy, and calming patterns. Color intricate mandalas, delicate floral designs, magical creatures, cozy interiors, and more. Each scene is designed to engage and delight artists of all skill levels.
4. Stress Relief and Mindfulness
Coloring has been shown to reduce anxiety, improve focus, and promote mindfulness. Mini World transforms your screen into a soothing creative space where stress melts away with every tap. Immerse yourself in a meditative experience that refreshes your mind and spirit.
5. Offline Mode — Color Anywhere, Anytime
No Wi-Fi? No problem. Download your favorite scenes and enjoy painting your mini worlds wherever you go. Perfect for commutes, travel, or simply relaxing without distractions.
Save, Share, and Celebrate Your Art
Take pride in your creations by saving finished pieces to your personal gallery. Share your masterpieces with friends and family to inspire creativity and spread joy.
6. Satisfying Animations and Visual Effects
Experience smooth, responsive color fills and delightful visual feedback that make every tap a pleasure. Mini World isn’t just about coloring; it’s a visual journey that brings your tiny worlds to life.
More Than Just a Coloring App
Mini World: Color by Number is more than a hobby—it’s a daily ritual for calm, creativity, and connection. Whether you love art therapy, mindfulness, or simply want a peaceful break from your busy day, Mini World helps you slow down and reconnect with yourself through the joy of coloring.
Our dedicated team is passionate about delivering a beautifully curated experience filled with relaxing visuals, smooth interaction, and meaningful art that speaks to your soul.
How to Get Started
Browse our extensive library of tiny scenes and select your favorite.
Match the numbered colors and tap to fill each section.
Watch your masterpiece come to life with vibrant hues and animations.
Save your artwork or share it with loved ones.
Repeat daily for a calming, creative escape.
Connect with Us: For any advice or feedback, contact us at colorify.feedback@gmail.com
Read our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy here: https://colorize-art.colorifystudios.com/PP_TS.html 
Download Mini World: Color by Number today and begin your journey into a peaceful, imaginative world—one tiny scene at a time.

bluejetty:00138647:ios.summary: Step into the magical world of Castle Duels! In this card strategy game, every tower defense is a battle of wits, as the gameplay is centered around mechanics full of unexpected twists and endless possibilities. From deck building to castle
bluejetty:00138647:ios.description:
Step into the magical world of Castle Duels! In this card strategy game, every tower defense is a battle of wits, as the gameplay is centered around mechanics full of unexpected twists and endless possibilities. From deck building to castle defense - it is a strategy game where the smart and bold are destined to win! 
This game is focused on PvP - epic battles await you in this multiplayer strategy. Real-time PvP mode allows you to fight other players, each with their own experience. This is a real challenge at deck building, strategic thinking and tactical mastery, where only the best may ascend to the heights of glory. Conquer new Arenas to advance and reap valuable rewards!
Assemble an army of mighty warriors to destroy enemies and claim victory! Summon units who appear in random tiles on the battlefield. There are many awesome fighters at your disposal, from cute but dangerous Shiba to the Pirate, Tinker and even Hungry Truffle! Each unit belongs to a certain type which determines their role in battle - for example, Defense units can take a lot of damage and help you survive enemy attacks. Use different unit types to assemble a strong deck. Accumulate Battle Bonuses and merge units to make them stronger, eventually gaining the Star Rank!
With the unique Battle Boost mechanic, it is more than a TD game! After the second round, players are given the choice of several random Battle Boosts. Choose the power that will help you meet the challenge of combat at hand and deal with challenges that await you in the castle defense. Thus you have unlimited tactical capabilities in every card battle!
Many special events await you, such as Hero Tavern, Card Foretelling, Energetic Trials and more! Join them, play by new rules and win awesome prizes! And don't forget than you're never alone - join Clans to gain new friends, chat, fight together and participate in the Clan Tournament! 
It is a world of adventure, might and magic! Let mystical creatures and brave soldiers join you in tower defense! Assemble your unique team and join the battle to conquer the arena! Become the undisputed champion of card strategy!
Follow us on Facebook:
https://www.facebook.com/CastleDuels
Join our Discord:
https://discord.com/invite/srUm6Xgqpm
PLEASE NOTE! Castle Duels is free to download and play, however, some game items can also be purchased for real money. In-App purchases may include random items.
Contains ads.
