bluejetty:00133155:ios.name: Runna: Running Plans & Coach
bluejetty:00133155:ios.summary:
Reach your pinnacle as a runner with Runna: Running Training Plans, your quintessential guide to the world of running. With tailored training plans built by world-class coaches to help you achieve your goals. 
Embark on an unparalleled run
bluejetty:00133155:ios.description:
Reach your pinnacle as a runner with Runna: Running Training Plans, your quintessential guide to the world of running. With tailored training plans built by world-class coaches to help you achieve your goals. 
Embark on an unparalleled running journey with Runna. More than just a pocket-sized running coach, Runna is your comprehensive running companion. From beginners embarking on their first park run to seasoned athletes gearing up for challenging marathons, our app is crafted to cater to all. Our offering includes training for 5k, 10k, half-marathons, marathons, and ultra marathons. This is probably why we boast a stellar 4.9/5 rating on Trustpilot.
WHY YOU'LL BE THRILLED WITH RUNNA:
1) Customized Training Just For You:
Our esteemed training programs are rooted in solid scientific programming. Whether you’re setting out to complete your 5k or preparing for the famed Chicago marathon, we have a program tailored to ensure you race past the finish line.
2) Seamless Syncing of Your Runs:
Live-track your runs on compatible devices* and maintain the perfect pace. Moreover, seamlessly integrate your runs with platforms like Strava.
3) All-encompassing Support:
We adopt a holistic stance to running. From optimizing your running form to advice on nutrition and injury management, our support is unparalleled. After all, every runner is distinct and deserves specialized attention.
4) Strength Amplification:
Alongside run training, we offer curated strength and conditioning routines that meld perfectly with your running program. Because when it comes to racing, stamina and strength form the perfect duo.
WELCOME TO THE RUNNA CLUB:
1) Dive into Our Vibrant Community:
Be part of the Runna club, an international community of runners. From beginners to pros, the encouragement here is infectious, and the friendships, invaluable.
2) Access Exclusive Perks:
Members enjoy exclusive offers from top-tier nutrition, apparel, event, and supplement brands.
3) Engaging Events and Classes Aplenty:
Register for in-person events, including trail runs or time-trials. And if that's not your thing, our live yoga and pilates classes await you. Mark your progress, lace up your Nikes, and feel the thrill of the run!
4) Always Here for You:
Our amicable team of coaches and support staff is ever-ready. Any query, any time, we're right beside you in this exhilarating journey.
EXPLORE OUR VAST ARRAY OF PLANS:
From Couch to 5k plans for novices or those returning post hiatus, to intricate marathon and ultra marathon programs, our range is vast. We also offer:
- Functional fitness routines for holistic strength.
- Recovery blueprints post-race or post-injury.
- Tailored plans for triathlon running across varying distances.
- And myriad other programs to keep your stamina top-notch.
COMPATIBLE DEVICES:
Runna is compatible with a wide range of devices including Apple Watch, Garmin, and COROS. This ensures you can track your runs, regardless of your preferred device.
RUNNA PREMIUM:
For the ultimate running experience, subscribe to Runna Premium for monthly or annual plans. Track your progress, monitor your pace, and burn those calories with personalised workout plans and support. 
Payments and renewal:
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
- You can manage or turn off auto-renew in your Account settings at any time after purchase
- No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active period.
APPLE HEALTH USAGE:
Runna uses your health data to provide accurate heart rate, distance and pace information during your runs and workouts on Apple Watch. 
Terms of use: https://www.runna.com/terms-and-conditions
Privacy policy: https://www.runna.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00158008:ios.description:
The Big Daddy – The Pregnancy App for Dads
Becoming a dad? You’ve got this.
The Big Daddy is the definitive modern pregnancy app built specifically to help fathers-to-be feel confident, help their partner and prepare for their baby. Get high quality, clear, practical, real-doctor guidance so you can support your partner, understand your baby’s development, and feel confident from week 1 to birth day. We don't need your email address so we don't ask for it; everything is private and secure, and stays on your phone. 
We're introducing the Bumpie(TM) - take weekly photos of your partner with our custom photo app that allows you to align and overlay previous photos for pro-level timelapse videos showing the baby growing - the ultimate pregnancy keepsake! Add in our home screen widget, contraction timer, baby decoder and our own name dictionary, this is pre-Dadding at the next level. 
Research shows that dads who are involved during pregnancy strengthen family bonds and reduce stress for their partner. This app helps you show up — informed, prepared, and ready.
Created in 2019 by a real dad and medical doctor, The Big Daddy is your weekly guide to fatherhood. 
Track Your Baby’s Development
• Weekly pregnancy updates from conception to birth
• Understand what’s happening with your baby and your partner
• Clear, no-nonsense explanations without overwhelming medical jargon
Visual Size Comparisons
• Fun, bold size comparisons each week
• Memorable visuals designed with dads in mind
• Shareable and easy to understand
Practical Advice for Real Life
• 40+ doctor-reviewed pregnancy articles
• Signs of labour, food safety, hospital prep, and more
• Straightforward advice on how to support your partner
 Be Ready for Birth Day
• Built-in contraction timer
• Hospital bag and birth prep checklists
• Custom baby name shortlist
Personalised Experience
• Add your partner’s name
• Custom due date tracking
• Clean, distraction-free design
Free Features
• Full weekly development tracking
• Size comparisons
• Selected guidance articles
• Completely ad-free
• Private and secure - everything stays on your phone. 
Premium Upgrade
Unlock the full experience with pro membership:
• All 40+ expert articles
• Contraction timer
• Complete checklists and name dictionary
• Bumpies
Legal Information:
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.thebigdaddyapp.com/privacyandterms/
The information in this app is general educational content and is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional for personalised guidance during pregnancy.

bluejetty:00119978:ios.description:
Choiceworks is a visual support app that helps make the day easier to understand. It is designed for children, teens, adults, and families who benefit from visual structure, clear routines, and support with transitions, waiting, choices, and feelings.
Families, caregivers, educators, and therapists can create customized visual boards using pictures, text, video, and recorded audio. Boards can be used at home, in therapy, during appointments, while traveling, or anywhere a visual plan helps.
Choiceworks includes four board types:
• Schedule boards show what is happening now and what comes next
• Waiting boards make waiting more concrete with a visual timer and activity choices
• Feelings boards support communication about emotions, choices, and next steps
• Feelings Scale boards help show how big a feeling is and what can help at each level
Features include:
• Visual schedule, waiting, feelings, and Feelings Scale boards
• Visual timers for schedules and waiting
• Custom pictures, video, text, and recorded audio
• Multiple profiles
• Import and export of Choiceworks board files
• Send a copy of a board by AirDrop, Files, or email
• Optional iCloud Sync & Backup across your own devices signed into the same Apple ID
• App menus, included board labels, included card text, and spoken card words in English, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, German, French, and Portuguese
• VoiceOver support
Choiceworks has no ads, no tracking, and no accounts to create. Your boards, photos, videos, and recordings stay on your device and in your own iCloud.
One purchase includes everything. No subscriptions.

bluejetty:00082977:ios.name: Utiful: Move & Organize Photos
bluejetty:00082977:ios.summary:

Are you frustrated that the Apple Photos app mixes everything—and won't let you create real order?
Unlike Apple Photos and other photo apps,
bluejetty:00082977:ios.description:
Utiful is the photo organizer that Apple forgot to build. As featured in The Wall Street Journal.
Are you frustrated that the Apple Photos app mixes everything—and won't let you create real order?
Unlike Apple Photos and other photo apps, Utiful lets you:
• Move photos out of your camera roll and outside of the main gallery—finally!
• Sort your photos into separate categories—work, hobbies, personal, and more.
• Keep utility photos like documents, receipts, and IDs out of your main gallery.
• Keep your main gallery clean and tidy.
How Utiful Works:
• Use Utiful to move photos out of your camera roll and save them to Utiful folders.
• The photos are removed from the camera roll but kept in your Utiful folders.
• Your Utiful folders are automatically backed up to your iCloud Backup.
• The Utiful sync feature lets you access your folders across all your iOS devices.
Utiful’s further unique features include:
• Save photos to Utiful folders straight from the Photos app.
• Take photos with the folder camera that save directly to the folder.
• Manually rearrange photos in a folder—just the way you like.
• Protect your Utiful folders with a passcode lock (Touch ID and Face ID supported).
• Import/export photo folders from/to computer, cloud storage, external hard drives, also wirelessly via AirDrop.
Who Uses Utiful:
• Professionals & freelancers keeping work photos separate from personal ones
• Contractors & service providers managing before/after project pictures
• Doctors & lawyers organizing reference photos, evidence, and case documentation
• Hobbyists & creatives storing inspiration, artwork, and craft ideas
• Everyday users organizing screenshots, receipts, IDs, and notes by category as well as reference pictures such as haircuts, clothes, fitness tracking, songs identified with Shazam etc.
Quick Start Guide:
1. Open Utiful, tap "Add Photos", select photos from the camera roll and tap "Move".
2. Or, while in the Photos app, select photos, tap Share and choose "Save to Utiful".
All photo, video, GIF, and RAW formats are supported. Original image quality & metadata are preserved.
The full feature list, User’s Manual, and tutorial videos are available anytime in the app’s settings.
Download Utiful today and take control of your photo library!
Subscription & Free Trial
New users get a free trial before the subscription begins. After the free trial, your subscription automatically renews annually unless canceled at least 24 hours before the billing period ends. You can manage your subscription in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.
Terms of Use: utifulapp.com/terms.html
Privacy Policy: utifulapp.com/privacy.html

bluejetty:00128156:ios.description:
World War II has begun, and you will join the important historical battles from 1939 to1945.
More than 100 famous generals including Patton, Zhukov, MacArthur, Guderian, Montgomery, Eisenhower and Manstein will be on the stage in turn.
Take advantage of the generals, find out the enemy's weaknesses and defeat them.
Recruit special force from the Axis and Allies and cooperate to gain victory.
More than 60 kinds of special force are waiting for you to recruit, including German Tiger tank, Mortar Karl, Soviet Katyusha rocket, KV Tank, US Army 82nd airborne regiment, and British Royal SAS regiment.
*** New engine production allows to experience real and rich terrain on the battlefield!
The jungle beach in the west, the desert in North Africa, and the ice and snow on the east line cannot stop you towards victory.
*** New special force system allows you to incorporate special force into your own troops.
It has a variety of units of special air defense functions such as air defense, airborne, and building.
*** More realistic weather system. Diversified weather will affect the morale of air force and army units.
*** Original reinforcement system can supplement the military strength, scout the enemy's situation, and develop your regiment!
*** New changes in naval warfare allow you to feel the range and volume of real naval warships!
*** Military units from over 200 countries, more than 100 generals and more than 60 special force will join your battlefield.
[Campaign]
*** There are more than 120 historical scripts in six war zones, and you can experience these real historical battles respectively from the Axis and Allies.
*** Achieve the mission goals in the campaign: capture the target areas, rescue the friendly forces, break the encirclement, defend the position, and annihilate the enemy on a large scale etc.
*** Every decision you make will determine the outcome of the campaign, including recruiting units, air strikes, airborne landing, dispatching special force and generals, and hiring reinforcements.
[Group Army]
*** Deploy group army. Each country has its own unique technology card which can be used to speed up the process of conquering the world.
*** A flexible diplomatic system and a rapidly changing situation of conquest. An enemy or a friend? It all depends on your diplomatic strategy.
*** Use the least rounds to eliminate hostile forces, conquer the most territories, and obtain higher scores.
[United Front]
*** Every battle is a war of attrition. Use our limited forces and maximize combat effectiveness!
*** Develop reasonable tactics, use terrain effectively, and allow your troops to survive in difficult battlefields.
*** Achieve the goals as soon as possible, eliminate enemy and reduce casualties so as to obtain high scores.

Fast, clear, and beautifully simple — it’s your all-day companion for authentic Puerto Rican sound.

Trending & Popular Stations
Explore the stations listeners love the most. From energetic FM hits to calm late-night streams, the Popular section keeps you connected to what’s buzzing across the island.
Personal Favorites Shelf
Save your go-to stations so you can return with a single tap. Build your own radio lineup tailored to your mood.
Recently Played Tracking
Missed something you heard earlier? Your Recent list brings back all stations you listened to, ready to replay instantly.
Seamless Background Listening
Continue streaming even when using other apps. Perfect for workouts, studying, driving, or relaxing.

Pause, play, or switch without reopening the app — all from your device’s notification panel.

Choose when the audio should stop automatically. Great for nighttime listening, meditation, or slow music sessions.
Smart Search Bar
Find stations by name, genre, or city in seconds. No scrolling — just tap, type, and tune in.
Stay close to the island’s heartbeat — download Puerto Rico FM – Live Radio and experience Puerto Rico’s sound anytime, anywhere!

The Raging Lightning Princess charges for the throne!

But one day, the lightning god disappeared!?
Now is the time! Charge for the empty throne!

- Auto hunt and rage modes for convenient battles!

- Become more powerful with shiny accessories and relics

- Black Stones and abilities that add to the princess' rage!

- Tower of Darkness: Defeat the powerful enemy within the time limit to obtain Awakening Stones!

bluejetty:00041070:ios.description:
Meet Microgram - the next generation nutrient tracker.
Track calories and over 50+ nutrients, including macros, fiber, vitamins, minerals, amino acids, omega-3/6, and more. Powered by reliable USDA-sourced data, Microgram makes it easy to log meals by snapping a photo, using voice commands, texting, barcode scanning, or searching manually.
REACH YOUR UNIQUE GOALS
Whether you want to lose weight, build muscle, gain weight, or maintain your current physique, Microgram personalizes your daily targets to help you get there efficiently.
No fitness goal in mind? Microgram also helps you focus on longevity and overall health, supporting sleep, digestion, skin and hair, energy levels, inflammation, brain function, and more by ensuring you meet your essential nutrient needs.
WHY TRACK MORE THAN JUST CALORIES?
TRACK MACROS: 
Manage proteins, carbohydrates, and fats to reach weight goals, maintain energy levels, and build muscle.
TRACK FIBER: 
Boost your digestive health and support balanced blood sugar levels and weight management by monitoring your daily fiber intake.
TRACK SUGAR: 
Monitor your sugar intake to maintain steady energy, manage cravings, and support healthy weight management.
TRACK VITAMINS & MINERALS:
Invest in long-term health and achieve peak performance by preventing deficiencies and supporting vital functions like immune health, bone strength, and energy production.
TRACK AMINO ACIDS:
Promote muscle repair and growth by tracking essential amino acids in your diet.
TRACK OMEGA-3 & 6: 
Reduce inflammation, maintain heart and brain health by balancing essential fatty acids.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Enter your details for a personalized plan
2. Log your meals via photo, voice, text, barcode, or manual search*
3. Track over 50 nutrients to achieve fitness goals and optimize long-term health*
PREGNANCY & LACTATION-FRIENDLY
Microgram also supports pregnant and breastfeeding women with tailored nutrient targets designed for both mom and baby, including folate, choline, iron, calcium, omega-3, vitamin D, and other key nutrients critical for development and recovery.
If you have any questions or feature requests, please email us at team@microgramapp.com.
*A subscription is required for certain features.
NOTE: We do not provide medical advice. Always consult a professional before making changes to your nutrition.

PERFORM — Create Setlists with count-offs, performance no
bluejetty:00069053:ios.description:
LEARN — Loop and slow down songs, program rudiments and difficult rhythms, and add counting.
PRACTICE — Test your speed, automate tempo changes, chart live tempo, and track progress.
PERFORM — Create Setlists with count-offs, performance notes, and PDF charts. 
Basic includes the metronome, programming for virtually any rhythm, tempo automation, polyrhythms, and standard Speed Tests.
Premium adds Playlists, Media Tracks, Cue Tracks, Live Tempo, advanced Practice Log features, and more via In-App Purchase. Try Premium free for one month if eligible.
Premium supports ongoing development, bringing new features and regular improvements.
Designed by a musician, for musicians. Used by Vinnie Colaiuta, Peter Erskine, Virgil Donati, Dennis Chambers & more.
◆ THE BASICS
▶ Sample-accurate metronome for any time signature, with automatic or randomized tempo changes, subdivision faders, tap tempo, Big Numbers, and a pendulum.
▶ Choose from hundreds of sounds, including voice counting. With Premium, import or record samples.
▶ Use the repeat counter and timer to track your work or stop automatically at your target.
▶ Build clicks and rhythms fast in Simple Mode, with accents, subdivisions, and swing.
▶ Layer two independent rhythms or time signatures.
▶ Built-in tuner, plus hands-free Siri or Bluetooth/MIDI control.
◆ LEARN
› Learn songs faster with Media Tracks
▶ Works with Apple Music, YouTube, or your own audio and video files.
▶ Add bar and section markers, then jump anywhere with a tap—no scrubbing.
▶ Loop and slow down passages, add chords, and print a Lead Sheet with just the information you need to get through the track.
▶ Transpose local recordings without changing speed.
› Learn with interactive resources
▶ Explore interactive rhythms, videos, scores, and notes, or create your own resources.
› Hear, see, and understand complex rhythms
▶ Program virtually any rhythm—even irrational meters such as 4/5—with precise accents, flams, drags, rolls, and ties.
▶ Add spoken and written counting and rudiment Stroke Guides. Print notation or export editable MusicXML scores.
▶ Explore two- and three-way polyrhythms with animated visualizations.
◆ PRACTICE
› Plan ahead. Then just play
▶ Use Goals to choose what to work on, when, and for how long—with targets that tell you when to move on.
▶ Build routines with Playlists, automations, repeats, and voice cues. Keep timers, charts, scores, videos, and notes one tap away.
▶ Chart live BPM on a tempo graph, record rehearsals, or analyze an audio file. Review tempo changes and turn recordings into Media Tracks.
▶ Speed Test counts strokes on your practice pad. Save personal bests and share results.
› See the work add up
▶ Automatically log every exercise, tempo, duration, and date. Follow streaks, spot neglected tempos, and compare practice periods.
▶ Add event notes and see how much practice led to each milestone.
▶ Print PDF reports or export CSV. Teachers can review what students practiced and read notes made while difficulties were fresh.
◆ PERFORM — Everything you need to organize and play a gig.
▶ Build a Setlist with clicks, Cue Tracks, and Media Tracks. Attach text notes, PDF charts, or forScore links so the right information appears with each track.
▶ Build Cue Tracks with sections, changing tempos and meters, count-ins, and spoken cues. Follow each bar on stage or export the click as audio.
▶ Print a professional Setlist in a couple of taps.
▶ Use Tap To Start to join at another player’s tempo, or haptics for a silent click.
◆ ORGANIZE, DISCOVER & SHARE
▶ Organize Rhythms, Clicks, Media, Playlists, Setlists, and Shortcuts with search, labels, sorting, and filtering.
▶ Discover examples from Home, explore the free Public Library, or join the Practice Room for live Q&As, support, and courses.
▶ Share with PolyNome users or export MIDI and audio files.
▶ Supports VoiceOver.
▶ Send audio to other apps with Audiobus or Inter-App Audio.

bluejetty:00028426:ios.description:
Cette application est l’ancienne application du Journal du Dimanche. Elle permet de lire les parutions en format PDF du JDD, du JDD Magazine et de Version Femina en version numérique. Si vous avez un abonnement en cours ou qui a été renouvelé automatiquement sur cette ancienne application, nous vous invitions à la télécharger afin de retrouver votre abonnement au Journal du Dimanche en format PDF.
Elle ne permet pas d’accéder à l’intégralité des contenus proposés par nos journalistes et disponibles sur notre site.
Vous ne pourrez donc pas vous abonner au Journal du Dimanche ou accéder à l'ensemble des articles du site du Journal du Dimanche sur celle-ci.
RDV sur la nouvelle application : Le JDD : actualités, pour découvrir vos contenus gratuits et vous abonner.
----
Depuis plus de 70 ans, le quotidien du septième jour, fondé par la grande figure de la presse française Pierre Lazareff, est la référence dominicale. Politique, international, société, économie, sport, médias, culture, plaisirs… Ses scoops, ses grandes interviews, ses enquêtes, ses sondages, ses débats et ses récits lancent la semaine qui s’ouvre. Souvent repris par d’autres médias, ils font l’actualité. En résumé : Vous allez en entendre parler, le JDD vous informe en premier
Anticiper, expliquer, surprendre : voilà en effet la promesse faite par la rédaction aux lecteurs sur les différents supports du Journal du Dimanche.
Aide et contact :
https://abonnement.lejdd.fr/aide-et-contact

bluejetty:00087522:ios.name: Transcriber for WhatsApp
bluejetty:00087522:ios.summary: Transform the way you manage Voice to Text on WhatsApp! Whether you’re on the go, in a quiet environment, or prefer reading over listening, Transcriber for WhatsApp is your go-to tool. With the ability to quickly and accurately convert voic
bluejetty:00087522:ios.description:
Transform the way you manage Voice to Text on WhatsApp! Whether you’re on the go, in a quiet environment, or prefer reading over listening, Transcriber for WhatsApp is your go-to tool. With the ability to quickly and accurately convert voice messages into text, this app enhances convenience and accessibility, ensuring you never miss a detail in any conversation.
Key Features of Transcriber:
Voice Message-to-Text Conversion: Easily convert any voice note shared via any Messenger app into clear, readable text. The app handles various audio qualities, providing accurate results even with background noise or low-quality recordings.
Transcriber for Voice Messages features AI-driven transcriptions for over 50 languages with a user-friendly interface for easy navigation.
Share and Save: Once your voice message has been converted to text, the app allows you to save it for future reference or share it with others. This feature is ideal for archiving critical voice communications or sending text versions of audio notes to those who prefer written communication.
Why Use Audio to Text for WhatsApp?
The hustle and bustle of daily life often make it challenging to listen to lengthy voice messages. With Transcriber, you can convert audio message to text, allowing you to view the content of a voice message discreetly without needing to play it out loud.
Advanced AI for Superior Accuracy
What sets Transcriber apart from other voice transcription apps is the integration of OpenAI's advanced artificial intelligence. This AI technology delivers unmatched accuracy in converting speech to text and works seamlessly with various accents, dialects, and speaking styles. Whether it's a casual voice note or a complex professional message, you can rely on the AI to interpret and transcribe audio message.
With every update, the AI continues to evolve, refining its algorithms to ensure even greater accuracy and efficiency in transcription. This means your experience using Transcriber for WhatsApp will only improve over time as the app adapts to new challenges and evolving user needs.
Multiple Language Support
Living in a global society means communicating across various languages and cultures. Transcribe for WhatsApp caters to this diversity with support for over 50 languages, allowing users worldwide to benefit from its transcription capabilities. Whether you need to transcribe a message in Italian, Japanese, Russian, or Hindi, the app can handle it, delivering text that is easy to understand and highly accurate.
This feature makes it the perfect app for international business communication, travel, or simply staying connected with friends and family worldwide.
We take privacy seriously, and while our app leverages AI technology to deliver better results, rest assured that your data is handled with the utmost care. None of your voice messages or transcriptions are stored or shared without your consent. We ensure your communication remains private and secure, giving you peace of mind while using the app.
Disclaimer:
Transcriber is an independent app designed to help users convert voice messages into text. This app is not affiliated with, endorsed, or approved by WhatsApp LLC or its subsidiaries. WhatsApp and the WhatsApp logo are trademarks of WhatsApp LLC, and WhatsApp LLC reserves all rights. This app is intended to enhance the user experience and provide additional functionality to WhatsApp users.
PRICING AND TERMS
Transcriber for WhatsApp offers 3 subscription types:
Auto-renewing weekly subscription
Auto-renewing monthly subscription
Auto-renewing yearly subscription
Your subscription will automatically renew at the end of each term, and you will be charged through your iTunes account. You can turn off auto-renew from your iTunes account settings, but refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term.
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://owlly.cc/privacy

bluejetty:00126604:ios.summary:
1stDibs puts the world’s most beautiful things within reach. Shop highly coveted sellers and makers in vintage, antique and contemporary furniture, home décor, art, fine jewelry, watches and fashion.
Whether you’re searching for an authen
bluejetty:00126604:ios.description:
1stDibs puts the world’s most beautiful things within reach. Shop highly coveted sellers and makers in vintage, antique and contemporary furniture, home décor, art, fine jewelry, watches and fashion.
Whether you’re searching for an authentic Eames chair, a Cartier Love bracelet, a Louis Poulsen Artichoke Lamp or an original Warhol, 1stDibs is a leading online marketplace for extraordinary design.
The 1stDibs app was designed to facilitate an easy shopping experience, especially for on-the-go discovery. We invite you to explore, set alerts for new arrivals, bookmark your favorites, send direct messages to sellers and check out from your iPhone or iPad with Apple Pay—wherever and whenever is most convenient for you.
THE 1STDIBS APP – THOUGHTFULLY DESIGNED TO SHOWCASE BEAUTIFUL THINGS
AN EXPERTLY CURATED MARKETPLACE – Shop a wide range of furniture, decor, fine art, jewelry and fashion, all hand-selected by the world’s most prestigious sellers and galleries.
DISCOVER AND FIND INSPIRATION – With over a million beautiful pieces in a single place, choosing is your only challenge. Discover new pieces weekly when you follow a search or favorite dealer and create a personal collection of your favorite pieces.
SHOP WITH EASE AND CONFIDENCE – We offer secure checkout with convenient payment options, including Apple Pay, PayPal, credit card or wire transfer. We also provide the best global shipping options, thanks to our scale. Whether you’re at home, on-the-go or in one of the thousands of 1stdibs sellers’ retail locations, all purchases made via our secure checkout are eligible for the benefits of our Buyer Protection program.
EXPLORE 1STDIBS AUCTIONS – 1stDibs' exciting online auctions offer you the chance to bid on, and win, extraordinary designs at an outstanding price. You'll find an ever-changing assortment of pieces by vetted sellers from our worldwide community — shop furniture, home decor, collectibles, fine art, jewelry, watches, handbags and clothing. Look for items tagged “auction.”'
Additional 1stDibs Offerings:
INTERIOR DESIGN AND PROCUREMENT SERVICES – Try our Designer Connection Service for help finding the right interior designer or leverage our Client Services Team to source specific pieces for you.
PROFESSIONAL CONSULTING – The experts in our Art + Design Research team can provide guidance and a detailed review, appraisal and authentication of any piece you're interested in.
INSPIRATION AND EDUCATION – Read and learn about the best in design, fine art, fashion and more in our Introspective Magazine and blog, The Study.
We welcome your feedback:
Please send your thoughts to appfeedback@1stdibs.com or click “Contact 1stDibs” in your settings.
1stDibs is the ultimate destination for the world’s most beautiful things, but we didn’t get where we are without input from our customers. That’s why we’d love it if you could take a moment to rate us in the App Store.
About 1stDibs
1stDibs is the world’s leading marketplace for extraordinary design. Since 2001, we have captured the magic of the Paris flea markets online and continue to set the standard for those seeking the most beautiful things on earth. By bringing together the best sellers and makers in vintage, antique and contemporary furniture, home décor, fine jewelry, watches, art, fashion and more from 600 cities around the globe, 1stDibs offers a curated inventory that is not available anywhere else.

Classic FreeCell gameplay you love!

The Integrated App is the best and newest resource from the CatholicPsych Institute. The app that integrates solid psychologically based practices with the Christian faith is finally available! 
After 12 years of CPI's mission to share services and resources with the world that integrate the Christian faith with solid Psychology, Dr. Greg Bottaro and his team have created an app to put these resources directly in your hand. 
You can now access Dr. Greg’s Catholic Mindfulness exercises from the convenience of your own phone.
Those who have signed up for the Catholic Mindfulness Virtual Retreat can also access all the videos, exercises, and journal prompts inside, along with an updated section for comments and questions!
Integrated Life members can access their full library of content, including all live calls, and brand new community chat thread, and new courses updated regularly.
Bonus videos help clarify the differences between Buddhist and Christian Mindfulness, the difference between Mindfulness and Prayer, and answers once and for all the important nuances that confuse so many people about the proper practice of Christian Mindfulness.

bluejetty:00021190:ios.name: Baby Piano: Fun Music Games
bluejetty:00021190:ios.summary:
You can play piano, guitar, drums, flute, xylophone, saxophone, and other instruments. You can also play animal sounds, Interactive Games, Educational Games, and the Most popular Nursery Rhymes.
You can have fun and enjoy this lively music
bluejetty:00021190:ios.description:
You can play piano, guitar, drums, flute, xylophone, saxophone, and other instruments. You can also play animal sounds, Interactive Games, Educational Games, and the Most popular Nursery Rhymes.
You can have fun and enjoy this lively music instrument game. There are lots of baby piano music instruments with fun sounds to have fun with your child.
Play a number of different music instruments, sing your favorite nursery rhymes, and learn how to make animal sounds all in one place. Tap the screen of a mobile device to play a kids piano keyboard, kids drums, kids flute, kids guitar, and kids xylophone. Toddlers can now easily learn how to play the piano.
The game features Four distinct modes:
1. Piano Kids Music Instruments:
- Piano Kids Keyboard: lively baby piano with 5 different sounds. 
- Baby Xylophone: a colorful instrument with cool sound and light effects
- Kids Drum: Perfect drum for kids to have fun like rock stars.
- Kids saxophone: Children can develop better listening skills.
- Harp: Learn to play the harp and be the best kid who can do it.
- Flute: Tap the colorful flute holes to enjoy the sweet sound of the flute.
- Play jazzy panpipes with different music.
2. Learning sounds for kids:
- Farm Animal Sounds
- Wild Animal Sounds
- Pet Animal Sounds
- Water Animal Sounds
- Birds Sound
- Vehicle Sounds
- Funny Sounds
3. Interactive and Educational Games for Kids
- Learn to trace ABC and 123.
- Learn the vocabulary of ABC, 123, Countries Name with Flag, Color Name, and Shape Name.
- Play the Magic Touch Firework Game.
- Learn to recognize the size of the object
- Match the shape of the object.
4. There are more than 15 famous nursery rhymes to play for kids.
Music games are good for kids to grow because:
It facilitates the development of their intellect and intelligence, aids in the improvement of their memory and social skills, boosts their self-esteem and focus, encourages the growth of their creative and imaginative capacities, teaches them self-control and patience, and improves their pronunciation and speaking.
Baby Piano has the best sound games and music, an interactive user interface (UI/UX) for kids, and is easy for kids to navigate within the app. The app has different sounds to help kids remember things, musical instruments to learn how to play music, and a lot of nursery rhymes. It's the best app for helping toddlers learn to recognize sounds, and it lets your kids learn baby music songs on instruments. 
With just one app, kids can learn how to play different music instruments. Kids can learn how to speak numbers, colors, letters, and country names with fun themes that make them easy to remember.
Baby Piano Kids is a great kids game that combines learning with fun and music. It's perfect for kids of all ages. Rate the app, share it, and enjoy it.

bluejetty:00021194:ios.description:
Korean vocabulary app, TOPIK Words (Korean words study app)
Features
- Provides a daily memorization of enough Korean vocabulary to memorize.
- Tests allow you to review the Korean vocabulary you memorized that day.
- Audio pronunciation of Korean vocabulary.
- Example sentences using vocabulary.
- Review functions for parts, units, and the entire Korean language.
- Favorites: Press the star button to add words you're having trouble memorizing to your favorites.
- Copy function: Press and hold a word in the vocabulary list to copy it. You can search for the copied word online for deeper study.
- Setting/resetting learning progress: Press and hold a part or unit to set or reset learning progress.
- Various test functions: Provides tests for filling in the blanks in example sentences, matching the meaning by looking at the word, matching the meaning by looking at the word, and matching the pronunciation by looking at the word.
- Word search function.
- Dark theme support.
- iPad support.
TOPIK words provides Korean vocabulary.
TOPIK words provide Korean vocabulary divided to memorize per day, so everyone can study easily.
In addition, you can check the TOPIK Korean vocabulary studied that day through the review feature.
Have you just started to learn Korean? Don't you know how to read Korean yet?
Do not worry. TOPIK words will support Korean voice, so you can learn how to read.
You can study Korean vocabulary by listening and watching, even if you do not have any prior knowledge of Korean.
It is important to study words every day! You can review the studied Korean vocabulary by part, unit, or whole words.
Words that you incorrect in the review feature are shown more often. The more you use the app, the more customized the vocabulary is for you.
All words are installed with the app when you download the app. So you can study Korean vocabulary anytime and anywhere.
Let's study Korean TOPIK vocabulary via TOPIK words.

bluejetty:00148632:ios.name: CrossWord Code
bluejetty:00148632:ios.summary: Crossword Code is an exciting new game where players solve crosswords with a twist: every word is a cryptogram, and each letter corresponds to a unique number. This word game is the ultimate fusion of cryptograms and crosswords, offering a
bluejetty:00148632:ios.description:
Crossword Code is an exciting new game where players solve crosswords with a twist: every word is a cryptogram, and each letter corresponds to a unique number. This word game is the ultimate fusion of cryptograms and crosswords, offering a fresh and exciting take on classic word puzzles.
In Crossword Code your mission is to solve crosswords by using your knowledge and logical thinking. Start with the clues provided in the cross word grid, and use your detective skills to crack the cryptogram codes! Once you solve a word, use the uncovered letters to fill in other parts of the grid and uncover new words.
For example, if the word CAT is solved, you’ll know that C corresponds to 12, A to 7, and T to 9. These codes can then be applied to other cells with these numbers, helping you further decipher more words. This game is a perfect mix of word puzzle fun and brain-teasing strategy, ideal for fans of word games for adults.
What you get:
- Innovative gameplay. Combines cryptogram mechanics with classic crossword puzzles, delivering a fresh and engaging experience with word puzzle games.
- Wide variety of free puzzles. Solve plenty of crosswords with cryptograms of different difficulty levels to train your brain.
- Tons of new words. Expand your vocabulary by discovering new words and their definitions while playing.
- Intuitive interface and smooth graphics. No complications, everything is done so that you can enjoy playing and solving crosswords.
- Useful hints. If you get stuck, use the hint that will help you solve a new word and continue playing.
- Auto-save. This feature allows you to pick up any unfinished crossword at any time without losing your progress.
- No time limit. Play at your own pace with no time limits, making Word Code the perfect game for relaxation and mental exercise.
- High quality. We have already developed more than a dozen puzzle games that are played by millions of users around the world, so you can be sure of the high quality of our new product.

bluejetty:00089702:ios.description:
TS is the transgender dating app that’s great at one thing: catering to the desires of transgenders, crossdressers and the admires of trans people. Trans dating is the best way for individuals in transgendered community (such as MTF & FTM transsexuals, transvestites (TV's)/ crossdresser (CD's), drag queens, drag kings, female impersonators, male impersonators & everyone else who loves the 'Trans' community) to find the casual dating or long term relationships, even the marriage. As we all know, most of the major online dating networks are very unfriendly when it comes to transgender dating. Just as the real world does not often accept trans people, the mainstream dating sites or apps are quite similar. Most of the mainstream dating networks do not even include the specific features for trans people. We understand that it’s very hard for transgender people to find friends, romance or love in real world or online dating. So we developed this TS dating app that only caters to trans people and their admirers. 
TS dating is a private and safe place where you can get involved with the transgender dating scene without having to worry about being misunderstood, criticized, prejudged. Grindr is for gay, TS is the specific dating app for trans people. We hope that TS will be another grindr in Trans community. There is an increasing number of trans singles around the world who are looking to meet and date MTF and FTM. If you are one of them and seeking like-minded people, this is the right trans dating app for you. 
What are you waiting for? There is nothing to lose on a transgender dating app. Join us now!

bluejetty:00018534:ios.name: eBudde™ App
bluejetty:00018534:ios.summary:
The must-have app for volunteers in the Girl Scout Cookie Program® now has a new name and added functionality. The eBudde™ App makes your life simpler by meeting you wherever you are in the cookie season.
Built into the app are all the bes
bluejetty:00018534:ios.description:
The must-have app for volunteers in the Girl Scout Cookie Program® now has a new name and added functionality. The eBudde™ App makes your life simpler by meeting you wherever you are in the cookie season.
Built into the app are all the best parts of the eBudde cookie management system for desktop users. If you’re a troop or service unit volunteer*, you’ll love the power and simplicity of this free mobile app from Little Brownie Bakers®.
IMPROVED SCHEDULING & PICKUP
No matter which approach your council is taking to the Girl Scout Cookie Season — virtual, in-person or both — the eBudde App offers you powerful support the whole way.
From picking up your initial order at a contactless delivery station to restocking at a cookie cupboard, the eBudde App is ready to support your transactions all season long. Schedule your pick-up day and choose the best available time slot with just a touch. You’ll be able to see if your local cupboard has the Girl Scout Cookies® you need even before you place your order.
INTEGRATION WITH DIGITAL COOKIE® PLATFORM
Because the eBudde App has been developed to work with Girl Scouts’ Digital Cookie® platform, families stay in the know about their Girl Scouts’ initial orders. If you have a virtual booth set up in Digital Cookie, you can monitor its sales just as you would for any girl in your troop.
As an added convenience, all records and sales will automatically follow girls who change troops.
FRIENDLY DESIGN & SUPPORT FOR VOLUNTEERS
A streamlined dashboard with simple button icons offers quick access to everything from calendar dates to historic data. With just a touch, you can*:
Stay in touch
• View important messages from your council 
• Add or edit contacts
Keep an eye on key dates
• Use calendar to manage dates and deadlines
• Review your troop checklist to stay on track all season long
Manage orders and rewards
• Track and place Girl Scout Cookie™ orders for traditional and digital sales
• Track amounts due and paid
• Submit your final initial order to your council 
• Place orders for girl rewards and never miss a deadline
Manage inventory
• Find troops that have extra cookies 
• View cookies ordered from cupboards
Manage deliveries, plus edit and compare data
• Select when and where you pick up your Girl Scout Cookie™ order
• Take electronic signatures for deliveries
• Add or edit each girl’s information and payments
• Compare current sales data against the previous season 
Sign up for booth sales
• See what booth locations are open and sign up for the site of your choice 
Get help any time
• Watch training videos and get assistance from within the app
*Cupboard manager and delivery user roles can also be set up by councils; capabilities vary based on user type

bluejetty:00023098:ios.description:
Santa Claus is coming to town! Play this brilliant Christmas game with charming levels of match 3 fun, filled with lots of new challenges! Light the candles, clear the snow to find the gifts, crush chocolate cookie, fill the gift bags, blast gift box, clear out donut blocks and break the frozen ice. Drop Santa down the chimney, ignite the firecrackers and fill the big sock. Join the story of Mr. and Mrs. Santa, Rudolph and Christmas elf adventure!
Christmas Sweeper 4 won’t let your heart be frozen until long after Christmas!
With fantastic new graphics, music, it will give you mindless experience of real winter holidays. New features, numerous boosters, and combos will help you to solve puzzles This game will fill the long winter evenings with lots of pleasure in a family atmosphere!
Swap, drag and sweep the cute Christmas pieces, like the Christmas tree, Santa's hat, Christmas bells and baubles, gingerbread man and ice crystals. Make matches of 4 or 5 to create powerful blast bombs and power-ups. And use Santa's mitten to collect a single piece. Try a new type of cubic match, that will make paper plane. That gift will help you to blast occupied targets and will give you unbelievable experience. You'll be rewarded with cookies and soda, lives and sweets. Snowman, frozen ice sculpture and many more are waiting for you!
If you like holiday themed match 3 puzzle games, click and match, swap and match or any type of casual match 3 puzzle game then Christmas Sweeper 4 is just for you!

The King James Version (KJV) of the Bible is included with the app,
bluejetty:00061213:ios.description:
The Holy Bible - King James Version is a beautiful, easy to use, full featured Tecarta Bible app designed for quick navigation, easy note taking and powerful Bible study.
The King James Version (KJV) of the Bible is included with the app, and all the other popular translations (NKJV, NIV, NLT, ESV, NASB, MSG, etc.) can be affordably purchased in the app. Also available for purchase in the app are a large selection of Study Bibles, Commentaries and Devotionals -- with all of their extra content integrated beautifully in the app so it is easy to navigate, search and study.
The app does contain a single ad in the verse of the day screen. For customers who have made an in-app purchase the app remains ad free. As our user base expands, we have made this change In order to continue our efforts.
All Bible translations, Study Bibles, Commentaries and Devotionals can be downloaded to your device so you can use them off-line (without an Internet connection). Tecarta Bible makes it easy to navigate, search, highlight verses, bookmark, make margin notes, and copy and paste into your notes.
FEATURES 
- Fast and easy to use 
- Flip back and forth from your Bible to note-taking during lessons with one touch and not miss a thing 
- No internet connection needed for downloaded Bibles, Study Bibles, Commentaries and Devotionals
- Use either Study mode, Parallel mode or Reading mode (pages turn like in a book)
- Select, copy and paste multiple verses easily and quickly 
- Quick navigation either by using predictive entry or table of contents 
- Margin notes allow you to write notes for a specific passage 
- Night mode for low light reading 
- Both word and verse selection for highlights 
- Facebook and Twitter sharing 
- Highlighting allows readers to easily emphasize verses or passages 
- Full-text search by OT, NT or current book allows users to quickly find words and study topics 
- Bookmark your favorite passages for quick future reference or make your own personal studies 
- Powerful folder system allows users to organize notes and bookmarks 
- History folder and back button 
- Portrait / Landscape mode 
- Font sizes can be easily changed 
- Easily e-mail notes to yourself, friends or family 
- NIV, ESV, NKJV, KJV, and NASB are red-letter editions, which can be optionally disabled 
- Users can expand Bible translations library easily and affordably through in-app purchase 
- Split-screen capability for parallel translations or for seeing Bible study with personal or study notes at the same time 
- Autoscroll with adjustable speed 
- Synchronize all your notes, bookmarks, margin notes and highlights across all iPhone, iPad and iPod Touch devices 
- AirPrint enabled 
ENGLISH TRANSLATIONS:
- NIV (New International Version - 2011)
- NIrV (New International Reader's Version)
- NLT (New Living Translation)
- ESV (English Standard Version)
- NASB (New American Standard Bible)
- MSG (The Message Bible)
- CEV (Contemporary English Version)
- NKJV (New King James Version)
- AMP (Amplified Bible)
- NCV (New Century Version)
OTHER LANGUAGES:
- NVI (Spanish NIV Bible)
- LBLA (La Biblia de las Américas)
- CUV (Chinese Union Version)
- CUVS (Chinese Union Simplified Version)
- Korean Bible
STUDY BIBLES:
- NIV Study Bible 2011 version
- NIV Quest Study Bible
- NIV Women's Devotional Bible
- NIV Women's Study Bible
- NIV Men's Devotional Bible
- NIV Student Bible
- NIV Teen Study Bible
- MacArthur's Daily Bible
- Couples Devotional Bible
- Mom's Devotional Bible
- Real Life Devotional Bible for Women
Try all of the above Bibles, Study Bibles, Devotionals, and commentaries for free using our in-app trial feature. Or if you would like to use these Bibles offline, you can do so by purchasing the license from inside the app. Purchasing any Bible license will also remove ads from the app.
Are we missing any translations you would like to see? Do you have any suggestions? Email us at biblesupport@tecarta.com

bluejetty:00087980:ios.description:
We've returned to the Store with an enhanced version of the highly acclaimed 'Skin Editor for Minecraft' - the most popular skin editor available. This new iteration boasts a wide range of additional features to elevate your skin editing experience.
Notably, the application now supports both 64x32 (old version) and 64x64 (new version) skins, providing greater flexibility and creative possibilities.
Welcome to 3D Skin Editor For MCPE, the top-rated skin editor for Minecraft Pocket Edition (MCPE). Our app offers a wide range of features to help you create and edit skins easily and efficiently.
With 3D Skin Editor For MCPE, you can create new 3D skins using the new Steve skin or browse through more than 10,000 skins available in our online library. You can even copy your favorite online player's skin by searching their name, or generate a random amazing skin from our library. You can also import skins directly from MCPE into 3D Skin Editor For MCPE, or browse through our gallery.
Our app also offers powerful tools to help you edit and improve your skins, including paintbrush and paint bucket (fill) tools, a color grid selector, a color gradient selector, an eye dropper tool to read colors, zoom in/out tools, and rotating tools. You can also adjust the visibility of each body part of the skins of your character with ease.
Finally, with 3D Skin Editor For MCPE, you can export your skins to your gallery and save them for future use. Download 3D Skin Editor For MCPE today and start creating amazing skins for MCPE!
3D Skin Editor For MCPE is not developed by Mojang. Minecraft is a trademark of Mojang AB. Please note that we are not affiliated with Mojang AB but we adhere to the terms set out by Mojang AB at https://www.minecraft.net/terms

bluejetty:00086385:ios.description:
Sent on impact, seen on mobile!
When an incident happens, the dash cam will automatically save the file to the event folder and send footage to the MiVue™ Pro app via WIFI in real-time (WIFI video backup function won’t consume your 3G/4G data, it uses point-to-point transmission technology).
Live View and video organizer
Click “Live View” to adjust horizontal level of the camera before installation. Videos will be categorized by date and type (Normal, Event or Parking mode folders). 
Set up your dash cam through the MiVue™ Pro app
Change the settings and format the memory card of the dash cam directly through your smartphone.
WIFI OTA (Over-the-Air) update
Use your smartphone to download and update the firmware, speed camera data and voice versions without having to withdraw the memory card. (Downloading data will consume your 3G/4G data, the update settings may vary depending on the different dash cam models).
* APP function may vary depending on different dash cam models.
If you have any issue when you connect to app, please refer the FAQ below
https://service.mio.com/M0100/F0110_DownLoad_Faq.aspx?bullid=AllBull&faqid=131685
for trouble shooting. If the problem couldn't be solved, please provide your smartphone model, OS version, and the device model. Also, please describe your problem and scenario for us, our service team will reply you asap.

bluejetty:00068323:ios.developer: Coptic Orthodox Diocese of the Southern USA
bluejetty:00068323:ios.summary: Coptic Reader is a mobile application that contains the liturgical texts, rites, psalmodies, hymns, melodies, services, and sacraments of the Coptic Orthodox Church. It is not simply a static reader; it dynamically assembles each service ac
bluejetty:00068323:ios.description:
Coptic Reader is a mobile application that contains the liturgical texts, rites, psalmodies, hymns, melodies, services, and sacraments of the Coptic Orthodox Church. It is not simply a static reader; it dynamically assembles each service according to the rites of the current day or any selected feast or date. Each document is generated on the fly with the appropriate hymns, rubrics, and instructions, removing uncertainty in the order of services.
Coptic Reader supports English, Arabic, and Coptic, and allows flexible combinations of languages within the same document. The interface is available in both English and Arabic. The application is highly customizable, enabling you to show or hide liturgical roles (Priest, Deacon, Congregation), inaudible prayers, rubrics, and language layers according to your needs.
The application has been rebuilt from the ground up using modern technology, enabling improved performance, maintainability, and future expansion. In addition to mobile platforms, Coptic Reader is now available on Windows, Mac OS, and the web at copticreader.org.
A presentation mode allows projection of content for use in church services. Additional customization options include themes, text scaling, and control over commemorations for saints and archangels in doxologies, hymns, responses, and prayers.
Navigation throughout the app is calendar-aware, allowing seamless movement between readings, commemorations, and service documents while maintaining context.
Key Features
-Dynamic Service Generation
-Bookmarks: Organize frequently used documents for quick access
-Advanced Search: Search across Bible text, liturgical documents, Synaxarion, Antiphonary, and seasonal content with categorized results
-Synaxarion Calendar: Browse the full liturgical year, search by saint name, and jump directly to entries
-Presets: Save and switch between complete configuration profiles for different churches or services
-Bible Navigation: Quickly move between chapters using an expandable navigation control without disrupting layout
-Copy passages from Bible chapters and Katameros readings for sharing or reference
-Auto Rotate Support: Interface adapts to device orientation where supported
Content List
-Complete Bible including Coptic New Testament and Deuterocanonical books
-Book of Hours (Agpeya)
-Holy Psalmody including Midnight Praises, Vesper Praises, Morning Praises (Standard, Koiahk, Nativity, Theophany, Great Fast, Pentecostal, including all festal and saint psalies)
-Antiphonary (Difnar)
-Divine Liturgies with integrated Service of the Deacons (St. Basil, St. Gregory, and St. Cyril, including Vespers and Matins)
-Katameros (Sundays, weekdays, Great Fast, Pentecostal period, and feasts)
-Synaxarion
-Distribution Melodies
-Unction of the Sick
-Baptism Prayers
-Crowning and Engagement Prayers
-Pascha Prayers
-Prostration Prayers
-Liturgy of the Waters (Lakkan)
-Veneration services
-Funeral services (Men, Women, Boys, Girls, Monks, Memorials, Prayer at the Tomb)
-Consecration services (Church, Vessels, Censers, Icons, Baptistery, -Ordinations, Reception of a New Priest, Home Blessing)
For more information or to submit feedback, visit copticreader.org.

bluejetty:00152105:ios.description:
Sleep better, live healthier.
Track your sleep automatically, gain meaningful insights, and unwind with soothing sounds and guided meditations.
Track Your Sleep Automatically
- Start tracking with a single tap, or let the app monitor your nights while charging near your bed.
- Detect sleep duration, bedtime, wake-up time, and awakenings.
- Receive a detailed sleep score and stage breakdown every morning.
Sleep Cycle & Analysis
- Advanced sleep stage detection: deep, light, REM, and awake.
- Visual charts and metrics help you understand your patterns.
- Weekly and monthly reports guide you toward healthier sleep habits.
Smart Audio Recordings
- Automatically capture night sounds such as snoring, coughing, or sleep talking.
- Review categorized clips with timestamps and playback.
- On-device analysis keeps your recordings private and secure.
Relaxing Sounds & Sleep Aid
- Explore curated categories: white noise, sleep music, soft melodies, meditation, and bedtime stories.
- Build your own playlist or enjoy daily recommendations.
- Play directly from the app with a sleek, built-in player.
Personal Insights & Tips
- Get personalized suggestions based on your sleep score and habits.
- Track progress with a daily streak counter.
- Develop lasting routines for better, deeper sleep.
Privacy & Control
- All recordings and sleep data remain securely stored on your device.
- Customize reminders and notifications with ease.
- Export reports to review your sleep journey anytime.
Join thousands who are discovering the life-changing benefits of better sleep with My Sleep: Health Tracker.
Choose from the following plans for unlimited access to all MySleep features:
• Weekly Subscription
• Yearly Subscription
• Lifetime Access
You can cancel your subscription at any time.
Free Trial
Enjoy unlimited access to all features with a 3-day free trial.
Your account will be automatically charged for renewal based on the annual plan within 24 hours before the trial ends.
If you do not wish to continue, please cancel at least 24 hours before the trial ends to avoid being charged.
Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited if a subscription is purchased before the trial period ends.
Manage Your Subscription
You can manage or cancel your subscription directly from your iPhone:
1. Open the Settings app.
2. Tap your name.
3. Tap Subscriptions.
4. Select the subscription you want to manage.
Support & Contact
For support or additional information, please contact us at:

Privacy Policy:
https://tend5du.com/privacy.html

bluejetty:00042118:ios.summary: Jammcard is the Music Professionals Network. The Jammcard app is a social marketplace for music professionals. With the new Jammcard Booking feature, any level of musician, from top level pro to aspiring pro and hobbyist, is able to book th
bluejetty:00042118:ios.description:
Jammcard is the Music Professionals Network. The Jammcard app is a social marketplace for music professionals. With the new Jammcard Booking feature, any level of musician, from top level pro to aspiring pro and hobbyist, is able to book the best music professionals to record, produce, mix, arrange, teach, mentor and/or consult you. Our members are vetted and hand picked pros by Jammcard. 
Anyone can now install the app and send a booking request to our members, but only our members can list their services and get booked. 
If you’re a music professional, you can apply to join as a member. Members can create and share a Jammcard profile to be booked and build their creative portfolio highlighting their skills, experiences, videos, photos, tracks, tour dates, media, gear, etc. Whether you’re a musician, producer, singer, songwriter, music director, creative director, manager, live/studio engineer, crew, etc., Jammcard provides a vetted network of members for you to connect with to accomplish your professional needs. 
Currently our members are in the US, with the majority residing in Los Angeles, New York, Nashville and Atlanta. We vet each member carefully to ensure everyone in the app is an active professional. To become a member, you can apply to join on the welcome screen of the app, or you can get an Invite Code from a member with invite privileges.
With Jammcard Booking, you now have the ability to connect your talents to the world with ease. Once you set up Booking in the Jammcard app, you can share your profile to not only fellow Jammcard members, but to any potential buyer aka Booker around the US. Jammcard Booking keeps your business safe, secure and simple. And the best part, we make sure you get paid immediately. Never chase money owed to you again! We handle it for you, so you -- can just do you. 
Add your Jammcard link to your social media bio, website, or send it out in an email blast. 
Let potential Bookers know you’re available to be booked for gigs, lessons, sessions and consultations. Once you’re set up on Booking, it will display the Book button on your Card so other members can book you for opportunities as well. 
Jammcard doesn’t collect revenue from you when you are booked. There is a 3% processing fee that covers the credit card fees. We charge the Booker a fee for procuring your services which allows Jammcard to continue to build the community so we can bring all of our members more value and opportunities.

bluejetty:00139317:ios.description:
Welcome to Heart Points: Walk Rewards
WHAT ARE HEART POINTS?
Heart Points are a simple way to track your health. Our app helps you follow the World Health Organization (WHO) and American Heart Association guidelines to keep your heart strong.
WHY YOU NEED THIS:
 To stay healthy, experts recommend reaching weekly goals based on how hard your heart works:
 - Moderate Activity: 150 minutes per week (like a brisk walk where your heart pumps a bit faster).
 - Vigorous Activity: 75 minutes per week (like running where your heart pumps much faster).
HOW IT WORKS:
 The app automatically turns your effort into rewards based on your heart intensity:
- Brisk Walk: Your heart pumps faster, and you earn 1 Heart Point every minute.
- Running: Your heart pumps even faster, and you earn 2 Heart Points every minute.
Start moving today to reach your goals and keep your heart healthy!r 75 minutes of vigorous activity (like running) per week.
WHAT IS INSIDE THE APP
Heart points, Steps, Workouts, Calories burned, Distance, Floors climbed, Heart rate, Blood oxygen, Breathing, Weight tracker, Water tracker, Sleep, HRV, Store Medical files, and Blood glucose.   
WIDGETS:
25 Health-focused Colorful Home Screen widgets.
20 Health-focused Lock Screen widgets.
25+ Health-focused Apple Watch complications/widgets.
Live activity tracking: See real-time updates directly on your widgets.
These activities reduce the risk of heart disease, improve sleep, and boost mental well-being. Heart Points make it easy and fun to monitor your progress and maintain a healthy lifestyle.
MAIN APP
Track steps, workouts, calories burned, distance, and floors climbed.
Stay motivated with Heart Points, heart rate, and HRV (heart rate variability).
Start a walking/running session with a built-in speedometer.
Monitor sleep quality, blood oxygen levels, and overall health.
Keep track of your weight and stay hydrated with the water tracker and reminder.
Practice mindfulness with regular breathing exercises.
Visualize progress with the Activity Rings: Move, Stand, and Exercise.
Safely store medical files and vaccination certificates for easy access.
Apple Watch Integration
Track steps, Heart Points, sleep, heart rate, distance, and floors climbed directly on your Apple Watch.
Start and monitor workout sessions or check your speedometer in real-time.
Seamless syncing with your iPhone and Apple Watch.
WHY CHOOSE THIS APP?

bluejetty:00115972:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00115972:ios.description:
Welcome to Cooking Blast a relaxing casual puzzle game that mixes cooking fun with hex tile challenges.
Play simple yet satisfying color puzzle levels where every move feels smooth and rewarding. If you love cooking games or sorting puzzles this game gives you a fresh way to relax and play anywhere.
Cooking Blast is a casual merge and connect puzzle game designed for players who enjoy relaxing color matches and brain challenges. You will drag and drop hex shaped blocks onto a cooking themed board. When blocks of the same color connect they merge into stacks and disappear helping you reach your level goals.
Each level has a clear cooking goal such as collecting cupcakes jelly molds or kitchen items. When you are running out of moves the counter flashes red to remind you to think carefully. You can use boosters to get extra moves or clear difficult tiles.
How to Play
- Drag and drop the hex blocks onto the board
- Match colors to form stacks of similar tiles
- When stacks reach the required size they merge and disappear
- Complete all level goals before your moves run out
- Use boosters like plus moves to continue your cooking mission
- Simple to learn and relaxing to master Cooking Blast is made for short play sessions that still feel rewarding.
Game Features
- Cooking theme each puzzle level looks like a cute kitchen filled with colorful desserts
- Hex tile board a creative design that adds depth to traditional match and connect gameplay
- Drag and drop control smooth and easy for all players
- Limited moves system makes every action meaningful and strategic
- Boosters and power ups such as plus moves help you in tough stages
- Friendly visuals and soft sound effects to help you relax after a busy day
- Progressive difficulty early levels teach basic mechanics and later ones bring new goals
- Cooking goals collect sweets and bakery items by merging hex tiles
- Optimized for casual puzzle fans intuitive and satisfying gameplay loop. 
Why Players Enjoy Cooking Blast
- Cooking Blast keeps your mind active and calm at the same time. You can play for a few minutes or spend an evening clearing new levels. The gentle cooking theme and clear match mechanics make it easy to focus relax and enjoy progress. Each completed goal feels like finishing a small recipe.
- The drag control is simple enough for beginners yet deep enough for puzzle lovers. Every tile placement changes the board and opens new merge opportunities. Watching tiles combine and vanish gives a satisfying sense of order like cleaning up a kitchen perfectly.
Who Will Enjoy It
- Puzzle fans who love merge match or connect gameplay
- Casual players who want a relaxing and colorful experience
- Cooking lovers who enjoy games with cute food and dessert themes
- Brain puzzle players looking for soft challenges without pressure.
What Makes Cooking Blast Different
- Cooking Blast brings together color sorting mechanics and a hex grid layout creating unique ways to merge and match tiles. Instead of square boards you play on a honeycomb pattern that feels dynamic and flexible. Each move can create chain reactions and new strategies.
- The game combines cooking visuals with puzzle satisfaction in a single relaxing experience. It does not rush you and there is no timer only your moves and your brain. You play at your own pace enjoy clean design and feel small rewards with each merge.
Cooking Blast is free to play easy to understand and enjoyable for everyone. Whether you play for a quick break or a longer relaxing session you will always find something fun to complete. Drag tiles match colors collect your goals and clear the board.
Download Cooking Blast: Merge Hex Puzzle now and enjoy the relaxing mix of cooking and puzzle fun.

bluejetty:00068978:ios.name: Kahoot! Algebra by DragonBox
bluejetty:00068978:ios.summary:
Kahoot! Algebra by DragonBox - The game that secretly teaches algebra 
Kahoot! Algebra by DragonBox, an app inluded in a Kahoot! Kids subscription, is perfect for giving young learners a head start in math and algebra. Children as young a
bluejetty:00068978:ios.description:
Kahoot! Algebra by DragonBox - The game that secretly teaches algebra 
Kahoot! Algebra by DragonBox, an app inluded in a Kahoot! Kids subscription, is perfect for giving young learners a head start in math and algebra. Children as young as five can begin to grasp basic processes involved in solving linear equations in an easy and fun way, without even realizing that they are learning. The game is intuitive, engaging and fun, allowing anyone to learn the basics of algebra at their own pace.
**REQUIRES A SUBSCRIPTION**
Access to the content and functionality of this app requires a subscription to Kahoot! Kids. The subscription starts with a 7-day free trial and can be cancelled at any time before the end of the trial.
The Kahoot! Kids subscription gives your family access to premium Kahoot! features and several award-winning learning apps for children to explore math and learn to read.
HOW THE GAME WORKS
Kahoot! Algebra by DragonBox covers the following algebraic concepts:
* Addition
* Division
* Multiplication
Recommended for age five and up, Kahoot! Algebra by DragonBox gives young learners the opportunity to get familiar with the basics of equation solving.
Kahoot! Algebra by DragonBox uses a novel pedagogical method based on discovery and experimentation. Players learn how to solve equations in a playful and colorful game environment where they are encouraged to experiment and use creative skills. By manipulating cards and trying to isolate the DragonBox on one side of the game board, the player gradually learns the operations required to isolate X on one side of an equation. Little by little, the cards are replaced with numbers and variables, revealing the addition, division and multiplication operators the player has been learning throughout the game.
Playing does not require any supervision, although parents can assist children in transferring acquired skills into solving equations on paper. It is a great game for parents to play with their kids and can also give them an opportunity to freshen up their own math skills.
DragonBox was developed by former math teacher Jean-Baptiste Huynh and has been recognized as an outstanding example of game-based learning. As a result, DragonBox games have formed the basis of an extensive research project by the Center For Game Science at the University of Washington.
FEATURES
* 10 progressive chapters (5 learning, 5 training)
* 200 puzzles
* Learn to solve equations involving addition, subtraction, division and multiplication
* Dedicated graphics and music for each chapter
AWARDS
Gold Medal
2012 International Serious Play Awards
Best Educational Game
2012 Fun and Serious Games Festival
Best Serious Mobile Game
2012 Serious Games Showcase & Challenge
App of the Year
GullTasten 2012
Children’s App of the Year

9th International Mobile Gaming Awards (2012 IMGA)
2013 ON for Learning Award
Common Sense Media
Best Nordic Innovation Award 2013
2013 Nordic Game Awards
Editors choice award
Children’s Technology Review"

bluejetty:00160809:ios.description:
Mural is a collaborative intelligence company powering effective ideation, innovation, alignment, and team building at 95% of the Fortune 100. Work together in real-time or asynchronously with a digital whiteboard and collaboration features designed to inspire better collaboration that leads to business-driving outcomes.
The Mural app for iPhone and iPad keeps you connected to your team and enables you to capture and share inspiration on the go.
Innovative teams at IBM, Intuit, Microsoft, GitLab, Steelcase, Thoughtworks, and Atlassian use Mural to collaborate from anywhere. Use the Mural iPhone and iPad apps to:
* Bring your best ideas to life, wherever you work best
* Invite your team to a collaboration session no matter where they are
* Review content and provide feedback to keep work moving forward
* Spark creative thinking with freehand drawing
* Map concepts and ideas with your Apple Pencil
Mural meets security standards for enterprise organizations with mobile device management and secure sign in supported by our Microsoft Intune Mobile Application Management integration. 
With the Mural app for mobile devices, you can:
* Create a new mural
* Add content in sticky notes, shapes, and text boxes with a variety of formatting options at your fingertips
* Draw ideas and sketch notes with a number of colors and line sizes
* Invite collaborators to your murals and easily change link permissions
* Add, edit, delete, and mention other collaborators in comments
* Enhance your visual thinking with a library of icons
* Participate in a voting session
* Share excitement and visual feedback with reactions
* Export a mural as a PDF, image, or zip file
* Add images from your photo library, take in the moment photos, or upload files
* Send a mural to a touchscreen display for hybrid collaboration sessions
* Organize content and ideas with frameworks
* Change mural settings
* Digitize physical sticky notes with Mural Scan or Post-it® App integration
* Easily present with outline and presentation mode
To use the Mural app, an account and sign-in is required. Learn more at www.mural.co.

bluejetty:00084105:ios.description:
iVueit App – the app that pays for the photos you take. 
Want to make money taking photos with your smartphone? You’re hired! No resume or pre-requisites needed. iVueit rewards you for gathering photos and completing surveys at local properties in your area. Anyone with an eye for taking pictures and a smartphone can do this. It’s really that simple.
When you sign up to be a Vuer, you help the world’s largest brands have on-demand insight on their properties nationwide. All while earning extra cash for snapping photos of the places you may know and visit anyways. That’s what we like to call a win / win. 
Here’s why you do what you do. 
Everyday tens of thousands of photos are taken of things like signage, landscape, painting, snow removal… you get the point. However, the lack of resources, and surplus of inaccuracy, has doomed the way of getting the job done. Enter iVueit. Our network of Vuers provide a real time solution to the never-ending demand of property photos and documentation. 
Imagine this... 
You walk outside of your local coffee shop and you receive a notification from iVueit that we need photos of the lawn and mulch around the store. Within minutes you've accepted the project and taken a few photos. Answer 5 easy questions on how the property looks and you are done. You've just paid for that latte and then some.
Sound too good to be true? Well here's how it works:
1) Download the iVueit app…at this point you have come too far not to
2) Check the map for open Vues in your area
3) Claim a Vue before someone else does and submit the requested photos and survey
4) The client receives and reviews your photos
5) Cha-Ching! Earn $5-$100 per Vue you successfully complete
Interested, but want to know more before downloading? Check us out on our webpage www.ivueit.com
QUICK TIP: For the best experience, keep your location and notification settings turned ON. This way, you will be alerted immediately when a new Vue drops in your area. 
"Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life."
