bluejetty:00116919:ios.name: iCardial - Heart Rate & Health
bluejetty:00116919:ios.summary: Take control of your heart health, blood pressure, and overall wellness with iCardial, our comprehensive heart rate monitor and health tracking app. Track your pulse, monitor heart rate variability (HRV), log blood pressure and blood sugar,
bluejetty:00116919:ios.description:
Take control of your heart health, blood pressure, and overall wellness with iCardial, our comprehensive heart rate monitor and health tracking app. Track your pulse, monitor heart rate variability (HRV), log blood pressure and blood sugar, and get detailed cardio insights—all in one place. iCardial supports ECG and EKG readings, enabling you to monitor your heart rhythm and cardiovascular health effectively.
Key Features:
Real-Time Heart Rate & Pulse Monitoring
Measure your heart rate, BPM, and pulse instantly using advanced PPG technology.
Blood Pressure Tracking
Log systolic and diastolic readings, analyze trends, and monitor hypertension risk.
Blood Sugar & Glucose Logging
Track your glucose levels daily to support diabetes management and overall health monitoring.
ECG & Heart Rhythm Monitoring
Record and review electrocardiograms (ECG/EKG) for deeper insights into your cardiac health.
AI Health Consultation
Receive personalized, easy-to-understand explanations about your heart rate, blood pressure, and blood oxygen patterns through an AI-powered health consultation system.
AI Expert Q&A
Ask health-related questions and get AI-generated responses based on your wellness data—helping you understand health trends and make informed lifestyle decisions.
Smart Food Scanner & Nutrition Insights
Scan foods using your camera to instantly identify items and view essential nutrition details such as calories and key nutrients, helping you understand how your diet interacts with heart and blood pressure health.
Apple Watch & Wearable Integration
Access heart rate, blood pressure logs, pulse data, and daily health metrics directly on your Apple Watch.
Comprehensive Health Tracking
Effortlessly monitor cardio fitness, heart rate recovery, blood pressure, glucose, pulse buddy metrics, and heart analyzer results.
User-Friendly Interface
Intuitive dashboards make it easy to track heart, blood pressure, glucose, and nutrition insights in one place.
Medical Disclaimer
iCardial is intended for general wellness and fitness purposes only. It is not a medical device and does not provide medical diagnosis, treatment, or prescriptions. The AI doctor, AI consultation, and AI expert Q&A features are for informational purposes only and do not replace professional medical advice. Always consult a licensed healthcare professional for concerns related to heart conditions, blood pressure, or diabetes. If you are experiencing a medical emergency, contact your local emergency services immediately.
Whether you're monitoring your heart rate, managing hypertension, tracking blood sugar, improving cardiovascular fitness, analyzing nutrition, or staying on top of daily health metrics, iCardial is your intelligent companion for a healthier life.

PPG Research: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/pmc5336072/

Terms:

bluejetty:00182460:ios.name: Headspace: Sleep & Meditation
bluejetty:00182460:ios.summary: Welcome to Headspace, your expert-led guide to mental health, mindfulness, and meditation. Whether you're navigating stress, anxiety, sleep trouble, or life’s ups and downs, Headspace is here to support you. Explore science-backed exercises
bluejetty:00182460:ios.description:
Welcome to Headspace, your expert-led guide to mental health, mindfulness, and meditation. Whether you're navigating stress, anxiety, sleep trouble, or life’s ups and downs, Headspace is here to support you. Explore science-backed exercises, courses, and programs that help you build everyday skills to care for your mind. For more support, you have access to licensed therapists, mental health coaches or Ebb, your empathetic AI companion. Headspace is always here, so you can always put your mind first.
DAILY MEDITATIONS
Discover mental wellness and mindfulness with over 500+ guided meditations. From quick 3-minute mental resets to longer sessions, we'll help you make meditation a daily practice. Meditate, practice mindfulness and relax. Headspace is proven to increase happiness and reduce stress in just 10 days.
BETTER SLEEP
Headspace helps improve your sleep with expert-led sleep tools, guided sleep meditations, sleep sounds, sleepcasts, and more. Explore sleep music and meditation for sleeping to reduce stress and anxiety.
ANXIETY & STRESS RELIEF
Headspace is the mental health app here to help you manage your stress through personalized recommendations, guided meditations, and exercises. Learn calming breathwork and breathing techniques to help with panic attacks, anxiety relief and calm. Just 2 weeks of Headspace reduces anxiety.
AFFORDABLE THERAPY 
From finding the right therapist to easy scheduling, Headspace therapy makes it easier to start feeling better. You’ll also get access to mindfulness tools and Ebb, your empathetic AI companion, for support anytime you need it. Plus, with partnerships with major insurance companies, your sessions could cost as little as $0.
COACHING & MENTAL HEALTH SUPPORT
Get matched and text with your own mental health coach and schedule sessions at your convenience. Headspace mental health coaches are trained professionals that provide personalized care to help you set and reach goals, manage everyday anxiety and stress, navigate major life events, and more.
WELLNESS & BALANCE
Increase balance with guided meditation and focus music. Calm and relax with quick breathing exercises, improve focus with binaural beats and calm your mind with relaxing music for studying.
MINDFUL MOVEMENT
Relieve stress, release tension, and strengthen your mind-body connection with mindful movement. Practice CBT techniques and CBT therapy exercises to reduce stress and anxiety.
PROGRESS TRACKING
Self-care tracker to follow your mental health journey. Share insights with your mindfulness coach or therapist so they can keep you on track towards your goals.
Headspace is the everyday mental health app that’s proven to help. Stress less, sleep better, and feel happier with do-anywhere exercises and personalized recommendations from Ebb, Headspace’s AI mental health companion.
Access online therapy and psychiatry through your organization.* (Check coverage with your coach or benefits team.)
Start your free trial and experience the benefits of meditation, mindfulness and expert mental health therapy & coaching. Subscription options: $12.99/month, $69.99/year. These prices are for United States, pricing in other countries may vary. Coaching and therapy pricing varies by subscription.
The subscription will automatically renew unless turned off in your iTunes Account Settings at least 24 hours before the current period ends. You can go to your iTunes Account settings to manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew. Your iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed. If you subscribe before your free trial ends, the rest of your free trial period will be forfeited as soon as your purchase is confirmed.
Headspace saves your meditation sessions to your Apple Health app.
Read the terms and conditions here: http://www.headspace.com/terms-and-conditions
Read the privacy policy here: https://www.headspace.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00146479:ios.description:
Figure Markets is the only platform that allows you to seamlessly borrow against top crypto currencies and earn by lending to real-world assets (RWAs)—all on-chain and completely under your own self-custody. With just one wallet and one powerful app, you maintain total control over your financial future.
EARN 8.5% YIELD ON YOUR CASH
Put your money to work and generate passive income. Tap into decentralized lending pools backed by real-world assets (RWAs) and earn up to 8.5% yield. You earn this by lending against assets like fully collateralized Home Equity Lines of Credit (HELOCs) originated directly by Figure, crypto-backed loans, and auto loans. Unlike volatile digital asset yields, these returns are backed by real cash flows.
FIXED-RATE CRYPTO LOANS
Need instant liquidity but don’t want to sell your digital assets? Borrow cash against your Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), or Solana (SOL) without triggering a taxable event. We offer the lowest fixed borrowing rates in the industry at 50% and 75% Loan-to-Value (LTV). Because we utilize Multi-Party Computation (MPC) for self-custody, your assets never leave your wallet. They remain fully visible on-chain at all times. Use the cash you borrow to handle real-world expenses, or use it to buy more crypto inside Figure Markets and amplify your stack. Loans offered by Figure Lending LLC dba Figure | NMLS ID 1717824 | 650 S. Tryon Street, 8th Floor, Charlotte, NC 28202.
YLDS: A YIELD-BEARING, REGULATED STABLECOIN
Experience the power of YLDS, backed by US Treasury assets, freely transferable stablecoin earns interest while you hold it. Currently paying 3.29% APY (rate subject to change), YLDS ensures your "dry powder" is always parked and productive. Buy YLDS with zero fees, earn daily interest, and seamlessly deploy it when you are ready to trade.
FULLY KYC'D
Security and compliance are built into our DNA. Figure Markets requires Know Your Customer (KYC) verification for all users, creating a safe, transparent, and regulated environment for everyone on the platform. Say goodbye to anonymous bad actors and trade with peace of mind.
KEY FEATURES AT A GLANCE:
• Earn up to an 8.5% target yield on real-world asset pools.
• Access low, fixed-rate cash loans using your BTC, ETH, or SOL as collateral.
• Keep complete ownership of your crypto with our secure, self-custodial MPC wallet.
• Hold YLDS stablecoin to earn daily, US Treasury-backed yield.
• One unified dashboard to track your loans and yields.
Download Figure Markets today and step into a new era of finance where crypto, real-world assets, and true self-custody finally live together.
Note: Rates are subject to change based on market conditions. Additional information available at https://www.figuremarkets.com/disclosures. Please review all terms and conditions inside the app. YLDS prospectus available at https://cdn.figure.com/docs/markets/fcc-prospectus.pdf.

Typeless tu
bluejetty:00100434:ios.description:
AI voice dictation that's actually intelligent. Speak naturally, and Typeless turns your speech into clear, polished messages, emails, and documents that read like you carefully typed them — in real time. 6× faster than typing.
Typeless turns your voice into superpowers. Suddenly, your phone can do things that once felt impossible — effortlessly and at 10× the speed.
Whether you're walking, commuting, or whispering around others, Typeless refines what you say into clear, polished writing. No filler words. No autocorrect fumbles. No awkward phrasing — just fast, fluent writing that sounds like you.
When you remove the friction of typing with the smartest voice-to-text AI that understands your intent, your thoughts flow freely. You become more creative and more inspired. It feels like magic.
Trusted by business leaders, professionals, engineers, creators, and students to save one day every week.
Key features
- AI voice dictation: The smartest voice-to-text AI that turns your speech into clear, polished writing.
- Speak to edit: Want to revise, refine, or rephrase your writing without typing? Just say what you want to change and it happens like magic.
- Works in every app: From WhatsApp to Slack to email, ChatGPT, and Notes.
Why People Choose Typeless
- Removes filler: Automatically removes filler words like "um," "uh," and "you know," making your writing clear and professional.
- Removes repetition: Detects and removes unnecessary repeated words, keeping your language concise and easy to understand.
- Auto-edits when you change your mind: Recognizes self-corrections mid-sentence and keeps only your final intended message.
- Auto-formats: Organizes spoken lists, steps, and key points into clean, structured text.
- Find the perfect words: Helps you express ideas effortlessly, so your message comes across clearly.
- Different tones for each app: Adapts tone and style based on the app you're using, from work emails to casual chats.
- 100+ languages: Speak in any language — or mix them seamlessly — and Typeless automatically detects and transcribes your language.
- Personal dictionary: Add your unique words effortlessly, and Typeless won't miss them.
Private by design
- Zero cloud data retention
- Never trained on your data
- On-device history storage
Unlock more with Typeless Pro
Upgrade to Typeless Pro to unlock unlimited dictation and other Pro features. Your Pro access is available across devices, so you can sign in and use it wherever Typeless is supported.
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings after purchase.
Terms of service: https://www.typeless.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://www.typeless.com/privacy

bluejetty:00062296:ios.description:
Prepare for your HSK exams like never before! Access HSK tests, practice offline, and track your progress in real-time. Start mastering Chinese today!
Prepare for the HSK Test with Confidence!
The Hànyǔ Shuǐpíng Kǎoshì (HSK), also known as the Chinese Proficiency Test, is the official standardized exam for non-native speakers to prove their mastery of the Chinese language.
HSK Online Test is your ultimate companion for preparing for the HSK exam. Whether you're just starting or advancing your proficiency, our app provides you with a real, interactive experience that mirrors the actual HSK exam, helping you get closer to achieving your language goals.
Why Choose HSK Online Test?
• 6 Full Mock Tests that simulate the real HSK exam conditions.
• Interactive Listening Section – experience the same structure as the official test.
• Instant Results – automatic grading, so you know your score immediately.
• Detailed Analysis – compare your answers with the correct ones to track your progress.
• Realistic Time Limit – practice under time pressure, just like the real exam.
Get Ready for HSK-2:
• Vocabulary: 300 essential words
• Characters: 347
• Listening: 35 questions in 25 minutes
• Reading: 25 questions in 22 minutes
• Writing: Not included at this level
Key Features:
• Simulates the complete HSK test experience, boosting your confidence.
• Easily track your progress and fine-tune your preparation.
• Accessible anytime, anywhere, and even offline!
Perfect for learners on the go!
If you spot any issues in the app or the tests, you can easily report them through the contact form in the app, and we’ll work to resolve them as quickly as possible.
Prepare smarter, not harder. Download HSK Online Test now and start your journey to HSK success!
Source: http://www.chinesetest.cn

bluejetty:00130288:android.name: Peridot
bluejetty:00130288:android.summary: Peridot fulfills your fantasy of bonding with a magical, brag-worthy creature that can fly through the air, always wants to be by your side, and might have a secret love for turkey sandwiches. With the power of AR, this pet simulation game
bluejetty:00130288:android.description:
Peridot fulfills your fantasy of bonding with a magical, brag-worthy creature that can fly through the air, always wants to be by your side, and might have a secret love for turkey sandwiches. With the power of AR, this pet simulation game places whimsical beings known as Peridots (“Dots'' for short) in the real world with you. And with Peridot, playing with friends is better, simple as that. Meet up with your besties IRL to Hatch new Dots that will inherit the Traits of their parents, then snap a pic and share it with your friends!
_______________
ADOPT your very own Peridot, creatures that feel and look totally real. Each Dot has unique DNA which makes them a truly special companion made just for you.
NURTURE your creatures and help them live their best lives. Play fetch, teach them how to shake their butt, give them belly rubs, and dress them up in hats, mustaches, bowties, and more!
EXPLORE the world, get outside, and see the world in a new way through your Dot’s eyes. Your Dot is curious about the environment and might uncover hidden items depending on where you adventure with them. When your Dot is looking particularly adorable, snap photos and videos to share with your friends on social.
COLLABORATE with your friends and other players to breed your Dots together and Hatch entirely new Dots that are genetically unique. Discover together what’s possible and encounter endless possibilities of Peridot Archetypes that resemble some of your favorite animals, including cheetahs, unicorns, peacocks, and more. You can even combine and pass down these rare Traits to the future generations of Dots.
EXPAND your beloved family of Dots by unlocking badass Peridot Archetypes and Traits as you climb the ranks within the Peridot Keeper Society.
EXPERIENCE a rich narrative as you learn about the mysterious ancient past of these creatures and work to preserve the species for future generations.
Join this heartwarming journey today and rediscover just how beautiful the world around you truly is. 
_______________
With the player's permission, Adventure Sync uses your location to enable the player to earn walking distance when the app is closed.
Notes:
• Peridot is optimized for high-end smartphones, tablets are not supported. Device compatibility is not guaranteed and may be changed at any time. Supported device information can be found at: https://niantic.helpshift.com/hc/en/36-peridot/faq/3377-supported-devices/
• Peridot is an AR-first experience and requires access to your smartphone’s camera while playing the game to interact with your creature in the real-world.
• Continued use of GPS running in the background or camera access can dramatically reduce battery life.
• It is recommended to play while connected to a network in order to obtain accurate location information.
• Please visit playperidot.com for additional information.

bluejetty:00145787:ios.summary:
The idea behind this application is that it will help you track and manage your Vitamin D. 
This new version integrates with the Apple Health app to make seamless data exchange possible in the following ways:
* on setup, profile informati
bluejetty:00145787:ios.description:
The idea behind this application is that it will help you track and manage your Vitamin D. 
This new version integrates with the Apple Health app to make seamless data exchange possible in the following ways:
* on setup, profile information is fetched from the Health App if the user allows it
* the user's weight (a factor in D generation) is fetched on an ongoing basis, making it unnecessary to update it
* the app will write vitamin D doses, including session information into the Health app
You setup basic information one time, like your height and weight and skin type and then any time you are outside, during the prescribed hours (and parts of the year), you can have it compute the amount of D you are getting in a stopwatch interface. It will also track how long you can stay out and warn you when the time is up. 
The application will notify you with the next opportunity to generate vitamin D. 
Each day, you can see forecasts based on your location, and you can also see the solar position, your generated vitamin D vs. target etc.
In the Pro version, you can see your exposures's history and you will be able to schedule future events for next exposures.
Weather data provided by Apple Weather. https://weatherkit.apple.com/legal-attribution.html
Subscriptions:
- D-Minder Pro Annual: $9.99/year (auto-renews)
- D-Minder Pro Lifetime: $24.99 (one-time purchase)
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase.
Terms of Use: https://dminder.info/terms
Privacy Policy: https://dminder.info/privacy

bluejetty:00069490:ios.description:
MathBox – Your AI Math Tutor for Students
MathBox is a personal AI tutor that helps you understand math, not just memorize it. Take a photo of any math problem—typed or handwritten—and get a clear, step-by-step walkthrough with explanations designed to teach you the method. Whether you're learning algebra, calculus, or basic arithmetic, MathBox guides you through each topic so you build real understanding.
Built for students of all levels, MathBox turns your phone into a 24/7 learning companion. Use it to review classwork, prepare for exams, study new topics, or finally make sense of that one subject you've struggled with.
Why Students Learn with MathBox:
* Photo a math problem and walk through it step by step
* Detailed explanations written by advanced math AI tutors
* Works with typed or handwritten problems
* Supports all levels: elementary, middle school, high school, and college
* Save and review past lessons in your History
* Export walkthroughs as PDF for study notes
Topics Covered:
* Basic Math: Arithmetic, fractions, decimals, factors, powers, roots
* Algebra: Linear & quadratic equations, inequalities, systems, graphs
* Geometry: Angles, shapes, theorems, coordinate geometry
* Calculus: Limits, derivatives, integrals
* And many more...
Extra Features:
* Works with camera and photo library
* Graph plotting and visual explanations
* Clean interface for distraction-free learning
Premium Upgrade: Upgrade to MathBox Premium for full step-by-step lessons, detailed explanations, and an ad-free learning experience.
Subscription Options:
* Weekly or monthly plans
* Cancel anytime in your Apple account settings
MathBox is the smarter way to learn math. Understand better. Study with confidence.
Privacy Policy: https://boxmath.co/privacy_policy.html
Terms and Conditions: https://boxmath.co/terms_and_conditions.html

- Visit Marina Bay
- Soak in the romantic vibes of Sunset Paris
- Experience the flavors of Japanese Cuisine
- And many more destinations on the horizon!
- Unlock stunning landmarks and attend vibrant food wherever you go!

- Explore: Begin your journey in a cozy kitchen and travel the world, unlocking exotic locations, cultural dishes, and exciting culinary challenges
If you’re passionate about food and dream of becoming a culinary master, Chef Festival: Cooking Game is the perfect choice!

bluejetty:00013772:ios.summary:
Apple "New apps and games we love" (on the Mac), March 2017
Apple "Staff Favourite" in the UK (on iOS), Jul/Aug 2010
Account Tracker is a powerful personal finance app that helps you track spending and monitor balances across multiple acc
bluejetty:00013772:ios.description:
Apple "New apps and games we love" (on the Mac), March 2017
Apple "Staff Favourite" in the UK (on iOS), Jul/Aug 2010
Account Tracker is a powerful personal finance app that helps you track spending and monitor balances across multiple accounts. Its clean, intuitive user interface, and features such as alerts, bill reminders, budgets, reports and full multi-currency support, make it easy to take control of your finances.
This Pro version is a subscription-free version of Account Tracker, with exactly the same content plus basic support for Apple Watch. Try Account Tracker before you buy, it is free to download and supports a 1 month FREE TRIAL. Simply cancel before being charged.
Also check out Account Tracker for Mac, now available on the Mac App Store. It requires Account Tracker version 6 or above (to sync over iCloud or Dropbox), and macOS Sierra (10.12) or above.
ACCOUNTS
- Track multiple accounts: checking, current, savings, credit cards, loans/mortgages ... etc
- Separate your accounts into groups, e.g. personal vs business accounts
- Enter your recurring transactions using calendar-based repeat intervals, e.g. every 2 weeks, the last Friday of every month ... etc
- Quickly and simply enter one-off transactions as they happen
- Reconcile your account data with your statements
- While it is useful to see where your money goes, you can also look FORWARDS, showing all of your future commitments
- Alerts if an account is likely to go overdrawn or hit its overdraft limit
BILLS
- Enable reminders for non-automatic transactions, e.g. bills that you have to pay manually
- View all transactions with reminders set
- Alerts to tell you when these transactions are due
BUDGETS
- Add budgets per category for spending, income and transfers across individual or multiple accounts
- View these as daily, weekly, fortnightly/biweekly, monthly, yearly or custom dates (e.g. tax years)
- Monitor your transactions against the goals you set
REPORTS
- Detailed reports to really understand your financial position
- Account balance over time, cash flow, spending by category or payee detail, income by category or payer and transfers by category
- View these as daily, weekly, fortnightly/biweekly, monthly, yearly or custom dates (e.g. tax years)
- Export or print reports as PDF files
DATA, BACKUPS AND SYNCING
- Import historical transactions or bank statements from a CSV file
- Export account statements, budgets and reports in CSV format for offline processing, e.g. in a spreadsheet
- Local backup and restore on your device, plus transfer of backups by AirDrop, email, Dropbox or iCloud
- Support for database syncing across multiple devices (using either Dropbox or iCloud)
- PIN code protection, plus Face/Touch ID and 1Password integration
PLUS
- Full multi-currency support, per account and per transaction
- The default currency is the one local to your device, but this can be overridden
- Supports sub-categories and splitting a transaction across multiple categories/subcategories
- Universal, retina enabled app that works on the iPhone, iPad and iPod Touch - buy once, use it on ALL of your devices
- Also supports the Apple Watch, to display account balances and a snapshot of your main budgets
- In-app user guide
SUPPORT
Please use the link to my support page from the AppStore page or from the app itself (or simply go to http://grahamhaley.co.uk/accounts/).
Alternatively, contact me directly via my support pages and you will get a quick response.

• ProTip strategies (Auto Magic, SEO & Search First, Curiosity Gap Hook, Problem Solver, Before/After).

• Check exact search ranking positions in the Top 50 for a target keyword or batch-check all tags on your video at once.

• 70+ ProTips with interactive Execution Checklists, Top Trending Tags across 20 countries, Copied Tags History, and 200+ Backlinks Generator for faster indexing.
Download TagYou today to optimize your channel content, master Video SEO, and build sustainable organic growth right from your iPhone!

bluejetty:00014359:ios.description:
Keeper is a secure password manager and digital vault trusted by 5,000,000+ people and 100,000+ businesses globally. Rated 4.9 stars by 228,000 people, Keeper combines enterprise-grade security with real human support to protect your passwords, passkeys, files and private information. Named Best Password Manager of 2026 by CNET, and the Top-Ranked Identity Security Solution by Newsweek.
PASSWORD MANAGER FOR EVERYDAY SECURITY
Create strong, unique passwords and passphrases with Keeper’s password generator. Save them in your encrypted password vault, autofill logins across apps and websites and unlock your digital life with Face ID or Touch ID.
PASSKEYS AND 2FA
Create and save passkeys that sync across your devices. Store two-factor authentication codes directly in Keeper for fast, secure, one-tap logins without a separate authenticator app.
WORLD-CLASS SECURITY
Every record is encrypted on your device before it ever touches our servers – unreadable to everyone, including Keeper. Protect your vault with hardware security keys such as YubiKey® and remotely lock or wipe a lost device.
Keeper supports zero-knowledge security and advanced encryption, including quantum-resistant cryptography for data in transit. Keeper is SOC 2 Type I and II; ISO 27001, 27017 and 27018 certified; FedRAMP High Certified; GovRAMP High Authorized; and recognized in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Privileged Access Management.
MORE THAN JUST PASSWORDS
Keeper is your complete digital vault. Store and organize payment cards, passports, driver’s licenses, insurance cards, secure notes, SSH keys, software licenses, medical records and other important documents alongside your passwords.
Everything is encrypted, searchable and available across your devices. Automatically fill payment details, addresses and forms on websites and in apps.
SECURE SHARING
Share passwords, passkeys or files with anyone – even people who do not use Keeper – with a One-Time Share link that expires automatically. Set view-only or edit access, revoke access instantly and organize credentials in shared folders with nested subfolders and individual permissions.
DARK WEB MONITORING
BreachWatch® continuously scans the dark web and alerts you when one of your accounts appears in a data breach, so you can change the password before cybercriminals use it. Monitoring runs within Keeper’s secure infrastructure, so your personal data stays private.
PERFECT FOR FAMILIES
Keeper Family includes five private vaults, 10GB of secure file storage, unlimited devices and emergency access.
Safely store Wi-Fi passwords, streaming logins, insurance documents and passport photos in one place for everyone you trust.
24/7 EXPERT SUPPORT
Get help from a real Keeper expert anytime. Our dedicated support team is available around the clock, every day of the year.
GET STARTED QUICKLY
Seamlessly import passwords, passkeys and other records from iCloud Keychain, Chrome, 1Password, LastPass, Bitwarden, Dashlane and more, including direct secure transfer from other apps.
Privacy Policy: https://keepersecurity.com/privacypolicy.html
Terms of Use: https://keepersecurity.com/termsofuse.html

Stream your videos or share your photos online, show your exciting moments to your friends

bluejetty:00074477:ios.summary: Clean Text helps you edit, correct, and organize text quickly and reliably, making everyday writing tasks easier. It’s designed for anyone who works with text: writers, students, developers, marketers, and anyone who copies and pastes conte
bluejetty:00074477:ios.description:
Clean Text helps you edit, correct, and organize text quickly and reliably, making everyday writing tasks easier. It’s designed for anyone who works with text: writers, students, developers, marketers, and anyone who copies and pastes content between different apps. From fixing formatting issues to preparing clean, readable text for emails, documents, websites, and social posts, Clean Text keeps your work consistent and well organized.
Complete Text Cleanup 
Clean Text solves the most common formatting problems that appear when copying text from emails, PDFs, web pages, or chat messages. Remove empty lines, extra spaces, tabs, unwanted characters, smart quotes, or line breaks in seconds. A rich set of cleanup tools lets you standardize content with a single tap, making even the messiest text immediately usable.
Editing with Apple Writing Tools 
Clean Text supports Apple Writing Tools, integrating them alongside all the classic text cleaning and formatting features. You can use them to correct, rewrite, summarize, and improve your text directly in the app. AI-based features are always optional and are only activated when you choose to use them.
Powerful Find and Replace 
Real-time search instantly highlights all matches in the text, making it easy to locate words, phrases, or patterns even in long documents. Options like Case Sensitive and Whole Word give you precise control, while the live preview makes replacements safe and reliable.
Recent Texts and Smart History 
Quickly access recently copied texts and reuse previously applied transformations to speed up repetitive workflows.
Seamless Cross-Device Integration 
Thanks to iCloud, you can start working on iPhone or iPad and instantly find your text on your other devices. Recent changes are always available, with no manual steps required.
Designed for iOS and iPadOS 
Clean Text integrates naturally with the system:
• Dark Mode support 
• iPad multitasking 
• External keyboards and shortcuts 
• Context menus and system integrations 
Key Features:
• Smart Clean and Clean & Compact 
• Clean clipboard content without pasting 
• Fix spaces, lines, and paragraphs 
• Convert tabs, spaces, and quotation marks 
• Text case conversion (uppercase, lowercase, title case, sentence case) 
• Indentation tools and line numbering 
• Line sorting and reordering 
• Encoding and decoding (URL, Base64, ROT13) 
• Convert HTML to plain text 
• Creative text transformations 
• Text statistics (characters, words, lines) 
• Find and replace with real-time highlighting 
• Regular expression support 
• Ignore List to protect specific words 
• Shortcuts and automation support 
Clean Text for iPhone and iPad is aligned with the macOS version in features and behavior, delivering a consistent experience across platforms with over 100 text transformation actions.
AI Features Note 
AI-based features are separate from traditional tools and are never applied automatically. Apimac continues to independently develop and improve all classic text cleaning and formatting features.
Subscriptions and Purchases
With the purchase you unlock all the app’s core features. In addition, subscribers benefit from continuous improvements, new features, and regular updates delivered to the app over time.
Plans available:
• Monthly subscription: 1-month free trial, then automatically renews at the monthly price
• Annual subscription: 1-month free trial, then automatically renews at the annual price
• Lifetime purchase: one-time payment with unlimited access to all features and continuous improvements
Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your App Store account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://www.apimac.com/about/privacy/
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00187755:ios.summary: Audio Bible with many languages that can be downloaded for your smartphone. Technology has made it possible to have the Bible on your phone. Are you tired of reading the Bible and not being able to listen to it, then you have the right app
bluejetty:00187755:ios.description:
Audio Bible with many languages that can be downloaded for your smartphone. Technology has made it possible to have the Bible on your phone. Are you tired of reading the Bible and not being able to listen to it, then you have the right app to solve your needs.
This dramatized bible will help you know the word in dramatized form. The dramatized bible has good and soothing background music and different voices which makes the Bible comes alive to you.
The app is also Bible offline because even if you don't have internet you can use the offline King James part without internet
This is an audio Bible that you can listed to different Bible versions at your own time. Currently for the English versions, we have King James Bible (KJV), King James Dramatized Bible (KJV Dramatized), Contemporary English Bible, and ESV Bible. There is also other non dramatized versions that you can listen to. 
Providing a KJV Audio Bible and Other Audio Bible versions for through iTunes is a mission project for us who are seeking to spread the word of God to millions of people worldwide. The Audio Bible is available to anyone with access to the internet. As long has you have an iPhone or iPad with the current iOS, you should be able to use this Audio Bible applicaiton
The Audio Bible comes with the most popular of the English-language translations such as King James Bible Audio, KJV dramatized audio, Spanish audio Bible, French audio Bible, Portuguese audio Bible and many more versions. This can be used together with your study Bible tools.
There is a music panel in the app that helps you to access the audio player controls so easily. On the panel you can choose to download the audio Bible file for offline use or simply stream it if you constantly have internet. To all our users, please know this app requires internet for the audio to work.
Bible audio contains several popular bible audio versions like English Standard Version (ESV) which is much easier for most people who are not familiar with KJV Bible. This is the go to audio bible version for you.
There is also King James Version Dramatized, twi version, ewe and others which is very convenient. For some versions there is only the New Testament. For both testaments of the audio Bible then check out the kjv and ESV
Read the Audio Bible which comes with many audio versions as well.
Key features of this app
1.Bookmarks
You can bookmark scriptures that you can refer to later. With this bookmark feature you will not forget your favorite verses as they will be in the app
2.Highlights
Highlighting allows you to return to some verses you have already read. It allows you to add colours to the verses that you like the most.
3. Notes
Write down your own thoughts and keep them absolutely private to you. As Christian we are required to meditate on the word and as result the best thing to do is to keep track of what God is speaking to you.
4. Complete Offline Bible
Access almost all features in KJV Bible text without internet connection. For audio you need to internet to be able to listen to it and you can choose to download it for offline use.
5. Daily Bible Reading
Every day you have a daily Bible reading that is sent to you. Reading a chapter a day helps you to grow spiritually as a Child of God.
6. Share feature
You can easily share your favourite scripture or verse on social media. This means if you have twitter, facebook or instagram you can easily share these prayers and images with our loved ones. Lets spread the gospel of Jesus christ all the time.
7. Daily prayer
Every day you will get a prayer which is done on a nice background which you can share for others.
8. Music playlist or Audio Bible playlist
You can create your own audio Bible play list which can be very handy if you have some favorite verses. Once it is saved you can always play it like other music players.
Enjoy your pocket Bible which is offline. Praise be to God.

bluejetty:00174798:ios.description:
Introducing you Bicycle ride tracker PRO - most accurate, powerful and precise cycle computer available for your iPhone. Either you are cycling for pleasure or training as professional - Bicycle ride tracker PRO is your irreplaceable assistant to healthier and longer live.
Don't even think of getting one of that slick and expensive standalone GPS devices, just try Bicycle ride tracker PRO instead. With Bicycle ride tracker PRO you can easily track how much you ride, how long it was, how many calories were burned, what was the speed or elevation and finally, see that all on a map.
What we did in Bicycle ride tracker PRO - is that we took user experience to the new level. Our easy to use and intuitive interface will help you to start cycling anywhere and set up everything right on the go. We thoroughly selected each and every element to show and combined them in quite simple but unique and outstanding user interface.
TRACK
Bicycle ride tracker PRO automatically records your time, distance, speed, elevation, calories burned and location.
MAP
Track your exact distance and speed for each and every ride using maps.
PERSONAL PROFILE
Fill in your personal weight, height, gender and age to make the stats more precise and accurate.
SHARE
Tell the world about your accomplishments via Facebook, Twitter and Email by posting them to your favorite social websites.
EXPORT
Improve your personal results by exporting complete summaries of your rides in GPX, KML or CSV formats.
APPLE WATCH
Start, stop and track your rides from Apple Watch.
GPS USAGE
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
Privacy Policy: http://appannex.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

California’s In-Home Supportive Services (IHSS) Program, Electronic Visit Verification (EVV) Solution for Non-Live-In IHSS & WPCS Providers.
Non-Live-In IHSS & WPCS providers will check-in at the beginning and check-out at the end of each
bluejetty:00028701:ios.description:
California’s In-Home Supportive Services (IHSS) Program, Electronic Visit Verification (EVV) Solution for Non-Live-In IHSS & WPCS Providers.
Non-Live-In IHSS & WPCS providers will check-in at the beginning and check-out at the end of each workday for each Non-Live-In IHSS/WPCS recipient they provide services for with simple easy to use screens. Providers are guided step-by-step to choose the recipient they are working for, if they would like to check-in or check-out, and select if they are in the home or in the community. Additionally, the app will conveniently add the provider’s hours to their IHSS Timesheet at the end of their workday. While the IHSS EVV app captures the start time, end time, and location of the visit using Location Services, it does not track the provider during the visit or at any other time. It simply takes a snapshot of the location when they check-in at the beginning and check-out at the end of each workday. 
California’s IHSS EVV Solution is in full compliance with the 21st Century Cures Act Federal EVV requirements by capturing:
o The date, time, and location where the IHSS/WPCS services start,
o The name of the recipient,
o The date, time, and location where the IHSS/WPCS services end, and
o The location the visit ends.
California’s IHSS EVV Solution also allows for complete capturing of data when the user does not have internet connectivity. The IHSS EVV app will store the encrypted visit information and will transmit the data once the user has internet connectivity.

bluejetty:00037791:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00037791:ios.description:
Say hi to your co-driver.
You’re searching for a top-notch EV charging experience? Here you are: Download the IONITY App to access Europe’s leading High-Power Charging (HPC) network available across 24 countries – open to EVs from all manufacturers. Our network delivers maximum charging speeds of up to 400 kW, enabling you to charge 300 kilometres of range in 15 minutes. Faster charging sessions — more time for you. 
Discover the highlights of the IONITY App
Navigation
• Search and find the nearest or a specific IONITY Station — the availability of all charging points is displayed in real-time.
• Use the IONITY Route Planner to plan your journey ahead and import your daily or upcoming routes to your favourite navigation app with ease. 
Charging
• Conveniently start and end your charging session directly within the IONITY App.
• Track your charging progress in real-time and receive a push notification when you’re at 80% to go back on the road.
• Optional: Use our app to scan the QR code on the charger to start the session. 
Payment
• Safely store your account and payment details within the app to conveniently pay for your charging sessions.
• Receive invoices for your personal or professional use to keep an eye on your spendings.
• Have a closer look at your past IONITY charging sessions and explore useful information like station location and kWh charged.
Find the right IONITY Subscription for you
Discover our subscriptions within the app: Choose the one that matches your lifestyle, driving habits, and charging needs by opting for IONITY Power or Motion. Sign up now and charge your electric vehicle at very attractive price per kWh. Prices vary by country. 
IONITY Power
Power your EV and charge for less: Our IONITY Power subscription is the right choice for most EV drivers. You save money after only two charging sessions per month: Benefit from the cheapest charging prices per kWh and continue your journey fast.
IONITY Motion
Keep yourself in motion: IONITY Motion is the ideal subscription for drivers that only occasionally use their electric vehicle and want to benefit from a cheaper charging price per kWh by using the IONITY App.
Your benefits with IONITY Power and IONITY Motion:
• A significantly lower charging price per kWh
• No seasonal or peak changes of kWh prices
• Switch your current subscription anytime 
• Cancel subscription anytime to next billing date
• Subscribe and pay via the IONITY App
Charging for registered users without IONITY Power or Motion subscription:
IONITY App tariff
Ready. Set. Charge! Sign up within the IONITY App and automatically benefit from a slightly lower charging price per kWh. No subscription and no monthly fees. This is the IONITY App tariff. Upgrade to our subscriptions to save even more.
About IONITY
IONITY builds and operates Europe’s largest ultra-fast charging network. With a High-Power Charging (HPC) capacity of up to 400 kW, it enables maximum charging speeds. IONITY exclusively uses renewable energy, ensuring emission-free and carbon-neutral driving. Currently, the IONITY network includes over 700 charging stations and more than 4,800 HPC charging points across 24 European countries.
IONITY was founded in 2017 and is a joint venture between the car manufacturers BMW Group, Ford Motor Company, Hyundai Motor Group, Kia, Mercedes-Benz AG and Volkswagen Group with Audi and Porsche as well as BlackRock's Climate Infrastructure Platform as a financial investor. The company is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and has additional offices in Dortmund, Germany, the French metropolis Paris, and outside the Norwegian capital Oslo. Further information at www.ionity.eu.

bluejetty:00122790:ios.name: GCB : Mobile Banking
bluejetty:00122790:ios.summary:
Georgia Community Bank offers the flexibility to access your accounts in the way that is most convenient to you. With GCB Mobile Banking for the iPhone, you can access your personal banking account information anytime, anywhere.
At Georgia
bluejetty:00122790:ios.description:
Georgia Community Bank offers the flexibility to access your accounts in the way that is most convenient to you. With GCB Mobile Banking for the iPhone, you can access your personal banking account information anytime, anywhere.
At Georgia Community Bank, your safety is always our top priority. To help safeguard your financial and personal information, your accounts are protected by 128-bit encryption, just as they are when you bank online. This means that your full account number is never revealed on your mobile device and we do not store your personal account information on mobile devices, so your accounts remain protected even if your phone is lost or stolen.
GCB Mobile Banking App Features
• Account monitoring
– View available balances
– Search transaction history
• Funds transfer and payments
– Pay bills to existing payees
– Transfer funds between accounts
• Mobile Deposits
– Use your camera equipped iOS device to deposit checks
• Digital Receipts 
• Use Touch ID or a PIN for a quick view of balances and completed transactions
Enrollment
For clients not already enrolled in Georgia Community Bank Online Banking, simply visit gcb.bank to self enroll. 
For support, call: 229.995.4461 (verify contact number)
Georgia Community Bank does not charge a fee for mobile banking. However, third-party message and data rates may apply. A supported mobile device is needed to use the Mobile Banking App. Use of the Mobile Deposit feature requires a supported camera-equipped device. An eligible Georgia Community Bank banking account and gcb.bank access are required. Certain other restrictions apply. See the Georgia Community Bank Service Disclosure and Agreement for more information.

Embark into a magical endless runner & collect charming Bubble Rangers. The Bubble Rangers, fearless adventurers, had a mission: to travel the vast expanse of the Imaginary World, hike up tall mountains, navigate through thick forests, cross wide oceans, and explore dark caves to collect these elusive Energy Bubbles. 
Bubble Rangers is an endless runner game with challenging obstacles, tons of fun, a beautiful world, and big rewards! Run, jump, slide, and collect Energy Bubbles! 
Race through a dynamic world for as far as you can! Use the power-ups to your advantage. Unlock rare Bubble Rangers and run through the different beautiful worlds. 
Run and complete challenging quests. Collect all the bubbles, create streaks to gain a multiplier to your score, and race to the top of the leaderboard. 
The free endless runner game keeps the Rangers coming and the maps exciting! Collect Bubble Rangers with unique looks and effects, and upgrade the power-ups for an even more exciting time!

A curated stream brings together the content that's important to you. Join your child's journey with a personalized stream of camp photos, albums, and quick updates from camp.
More Smiling, Less Searching
Campanion's Face Finder technology sifts through thousands of photos to find your camper so you don't have to. Upload a photo of your camper, then let Face Finder do the rest, finding and delivering pictures of your child directly to you. And with push notifications of new tagged photos of your camper, you won't miss a moment.
View Albums & Tagged Photos, Download & Share Free Hi-Res Images
Campanion organizes photos from camp in easy-to-browse albums to help you feel connected while your camper is away. View albums and tagged photos from camp and download hi-res versions to share with family and friends — all with a few taps.
Sending Letters Just Got Easier
Compose letters in the app that get printed and hand-delivered to your camper. One app, a few taps, and voila – you've sent your camper a little love.

bluejetty:00061168:ios.name: Choice of Games
bluejetty:00061168:ios.summary:
The choice is yours!
Choice of Games is a magnificent library of over 100 interactive novels: action, adventure, drama, historical, war, humor, supernatural, and more. Our games are entirely text-based—without graphics or sound effects—and
bluejetty:00061168:ios.description:
The choice is yours!
Choice of Games is a magnificent library of over 100 interactive novels: action, adventure, drama, historical, war, humor, supernatural, and more. Our games are entirely text-based—without graphics or sound effects—and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.
All CoG games allow you to create your own character, choosing your character’s gender and sexual orientation. Choose your path: your choices control the story.
Try a few of these Choice of Games classics:
• Affairs of the Court: Choice of Romance — Plunge into court politics and change the course of history, or pursue a love affair that rocks the kingdom to its foundations!
• Choice of Broadsides — Step into the shoes of the greatest naval hero of all time... you!
• Choice of the Deathless — Battle demons and undead attorneys, and win souls to pay back your student loans!
• Choice of the Dragon — Become a fire-breathing dragon who sleeps on gold and kidnaps princesses!
• Choice of Robots — The robots you design will change the world! Will you show them the true meaning of love, or conquer Alaska with your robot army?
• Choice of the Vampire — A 200-year journey of love, power, and redemption.
• Creatures Such as We — A philosophical romance with game designers on the moon. In this game within a game, there has to be a better ending! 2nd place in IFComp, 2014.
• Crème de la Crème — Climb to the top of the class at your exclusive private school for socialites! Winner of XYZZY Best Game, 2019.
• Grand Academy for Future Villains — Taking over the world? Welcome to the world's finest preparatory villain school!
• Heart of the House — What will you sacrifice when trapped in a haunted manor? Will you destroy this evil or claim its power? And can love bloom in a haunted house?
• Heroes of Myth — You faked a prophecy and pretended to save the world. Now, it's coming true!
• The Luminous Underground — Blast spirits out of a haunted subway system! Nebula Award finalist for Best Game Writing, 2020.
• The Magician’s Workshop — Uncover Renaissance Italy's magical secrets to solve your master's murder! Nebula Award finalist for Best Game Writing, 2019.
• Psy High — What's scarier: the principal, your psychic powers, or finding a date for prom?
• Rent-a-Vice — What doesn't kill you kills someone else, and leads down a rabbit hole of vice. Nebula Award finalist for Best Game Writing, 2018.
• Tally Ho — A Jazz Age comedy of manners—only a perfect servant can solve a perfect mess!
Learn more at https://choiceofgames.com

bluejetty:00183053:ios.description:
Drive, park, race and explore in Car Parking - Driving School! Master 60+ road signs, customise 120+ vehicles, take on exciting driving missions and challenge friends in an expansive multiplayer open world.
Explore a huge open world featuring cities, off-road routes, racing tracks, day-night cycles and rain. Enjoy a variety of car games and driving experiences, from precision parking and road sign lessons to multiplayer races, stunts and exciting missions.
Car Parking - Driving School combines physics-based driving challenges, realistic driving simulation, exploration and role-playing. Drive a wide variety of vehicles, including SUVs, sedans, hatchbacks, MUVs, sports cars, buses, trucks and vans. Customise your vehicles with body kits, rims, decals, wraps, underglow and coloured smoke.
MULTIPLAYER MODE
Challenge your friends to drag races, join public or private rooms and connect with players worldwide through live chat and direct messages. Add friends, explore the open world together, exit your cars and even ride as a passenger in other players' vehicles for a truly interactive multiplayer experience.
JOBS & ROLE-PLAYING
Take on different roles and experience more than just driving! Drive taxis, ambulances and school buses. Complete car transport, firefighter and garbage collection missions. Take on exciting jobs, earn rewards and unlock more vehicles as you progress.
LEARN & PARKING MODES
Learn 60+ road signs and understand how traffic rules work through practical driving lessons. With over 100 levels across Learn and Parking modes, there is plenty to master.
Improve your car parking skills with realistic handling as you navigate parking lots and realistic traffic to reach your designated parking spot. Recognise road signs, follow traffic signals, mind stop signs and use blinkers. Learn to apply traffic rules and respond to road signs as you build your confidence behind the wheel.
EXPLORE & DISCOVER
Drive around a huge open-world city, explore off-road areas, take on racing tracks and perform exciting stunts. Enjoy free drive at your own pace, discover new locations and buy houses with garages to build your own driving experience.
Try drift challenges, earn drift points and take on Speed Traps and Airtime stunts. Explore, drive and discover something new around every corner!
CARS & CUSTOMISATION
Choose from 120+ cars, including SUVs, sedans, hatchbacks, luxury cars, MUVs and sports cars, along with buses, trucks and vans.
Make every vehicle your own:
- Customise car colours, number plates, rims, body kits, spoilers, exhausts, canards and other body parts.
- Add decals, wraps, underglow and coloured smoke.
- Upgrade engine, suspension, brakes, tyres, transmission and exhaust.
- Adjust car tuning, suspension and camber to suit your driving style.
- Personalise your character with different hairstyles, clothes and accessories.
MORE TO EXPLORE
- Day-night cycles and changing weather, including rain.
- Realistic traffic and smooth vehicle handling.
- Manual and automatic gear shifting.
- Cruise control and parking sensors.
- Police role-play and speeding fines.
- Drift points, challenges and exciting stunts.
- Stunning 3D graphics and realistic game sounds.
- Multiplayer online mode with live chat and direct messaging.
- Exit vehicles, explore the open world and ride in other players' cars.
- Character customisation and extensive car modifications.
- Exciting missions and jobs to earn rewards and unlock vehicles.
Get Car Parking - Driving School now and experience driving, parking, racing and multiplayer fun in one game!
Note - 
Subscriptions and any free trials renew automatically as paid subscriptions unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel in your Apple account settings.
For cancellation information - 
https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
Privacy Policy - https://appsoleutgames.com/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use - https://appsoleutgames.com/terms&services.html

bluejetty:00063676:ios.name: Magic Fluids Lite
bluejetty:00063676:ios.summary: Magic Fluids Lite is a relaxing, colorful fluid simulation app that will help you calm down and relieve stress, or be creative and make aesthetic digital art. It is based on algorithms of fluid flow simulation and features fluid (pun intent
bluejetty:00063676:ios.description:
Magic Fluids Lite is a relaxing, colorful fluid simulation app that will help you calm down and relieve stress, or be creative and make aesthetic digital art. It is based on algorithms of fluid flow simulation and features fluid (pun intented!), beautiful graphics. It is the best time waster!
TOUCH THE SCREEN and enjoy hypnotizing motion of fluid swirls moving around, sometimes slow, quiet and elegant, other times dynamic, satisfying and trippy.
CALM DOWN AND RELAX as you draw and watch peaceful flows evolve in space and eventually settle down into colorful patterns. Magic Fluids will help you sleep, meditate, restore balance, relieve stress and anxiety.
GET CREATIVE and, with a touch of your finger, bring to life stylish patterns of paint and particles. If you like abstract digital art or acrylic pour painting, you'll love Magic Fluids! You can create impressive eye-catching designs that look like swirls, galaxies, liquid, fire, light, smoke, lava and much more!
KEEP YOUR KIDS BUSY - they love to doodle and watch the fluid move around! We hope that Magic Fluids can also help children with anxiety, autism and sensory issues.
Please note: this is NOT a live wallpaper.
Key features of Magic Fluids Lite:
- Highly configurable fluid behaviour and look
- Predefined configuration presets to get you started (10+ are free, ~70 more can be unlocked)
- Save your own presets
- Pause the animation anytime and save screenshots
- Smoke, water and jello animation
- 10 fluid textures that add fine detail to the fluid
- Amazing light and shadow visual effects
- Thousands of particles moving with the fluid
- Highly optimized, multiple quality settings
Fluid animation in your pocket! Touch the screen and create beautiful motion of colorful smoke and water. Calm down and relax as you watch trippy, magical swirls of flowing colors. Get artistic and design creative, satisfying patterns of paint and particles.

bluejetty:00084024:ios.name: bootmod3
bluejetty:00084024:ios.summary:
bootmod3 is the First and Most Widely Adopted flash tuning platform for the BMW F and G series vehicles and the new A90/A91 Toyota Supra.
Map Switching using steering wheel, Flex Fuel Tuning, Anti-Lag, Ethanol Content Checking on the RPM g
bluejetty:00084024:ios.description:
bootmod3 is the First and Most Widely Adopted flash tuning platform for the BMW F and G series vehicles and the new A90/A91 Toyota Supra.
Map Switching using steering wheel, Flex Fuel Tuning, Anti-Lag, Ethanol Content Checking on the RPM gauge in the dash, and more..
*** All New Map Editor!
Connect an ENET cable to your iOS device or use the bootmod3 WiFi Adapter for any programming, dashboard, datalogging and diagnostics.
bootmod3 allows end users to unleash the full performance potential of their BMW while doing so as the factory intended by programming the factory engine control unit (ECU/DME) and transmission (TCU, where applicable) over the OBD diagnostic port.
Program your car and gain 70-120hp in just 3minutes with an off the shelf tune. Switch among pump gas and race gas maps in just seconds. 
CustomROM Features available for most vehicles supported:
- Map switching using steering wheel cruise control buttons, switching entire calibration tables right inside the factory DME
- Flex fuel functionality integrating a Flex Fuel Sensor
- Antilag functionality to build boost off the line or while rolling
- Live adjust screens for adjusting exhaust burble on the fly without re-flashing using a simple slider control in the app
- In-Dash Ethanol content check on the RPM gauge using cruise buttons on the steering wheel (e.g. 1500rpm = 15% ethanol, 6000rpm = 60% ethanol)
/// OTS maps
Load pre-made performance tunes for your vehicle
/// CUSTOM TUNING
Customize the performance tuning on your DME / ECU using our custom tuning interface. Tailor performance, sound, fuel economy to your specific needs. Flash the transmission with GTS software on supported models.
/// Live Monitoring
Monitor your engine behaviour using a configurable gauges layout to keep on eye on any of the hundreds of engine monitors internal to the ECU including BMW specific logging channels and RAM variables. Monitor torque limits, boost, ignition timing, variable valve timing, fuel targets, fuel trims, across all cylinders, etc.
/// Cloud Enabled
Cloud services allow for datalogs and maps to be stored in one central location and access from any location
/// FEATURES
For feature descriptions please refer to our website for each particular vehicle you're interested in tuning using the bootmod3 platform.
Supported vehicles:
Bosch MEVD17.2 DME Vehicles:
F8x M3, M4
F2x F3x 135i, 235i, 335i, 435i
F1x 535i, 640i, M5, M6, 550i, 650i, X5, X6
F87 M2, M2 Competition
F4x X4, X4M
F8x X5M, X6M
Bosch MG1 DME Vehicles:
F2x 2015 - 2019 M140i 
F2x 2016 - 2019 M240i 
F3x 2015 - 2018 340i 
F3x 2016 - 2019 440i 
G3x 2017+ 540i 
GT G32 2017+ 640i 
G1x F0x 2015+ 740i 
G01 2017+ X3 M40i 
G02 2018+ X4 M40i 
G8x M3/M4
G9x X3M/X4M
2020+ A90/A91 Toyota Supra
* This racing product is for competition closed course use only.
** Use of this software may void portions of your vehicle’s factory warranty. Some items may not be legal for “on highway use”. bootmod3 makes no guarantees to the legality of any parts used for “on highway vehicles” and accepts no responsibility for compliance with the vehicle’s factory warranty.

bluejetty:00034656:ios.name: Royal Romances: Endless Winter
bluejetty:00034656:ios.summary: Embark on a captivating journey through "Royal Romances: Endless Winter," where your adventure takes you into a majestic kingdom frozen in eternal winter. The game invites you to find objects in a picture, solve logic puzzles, and unravel b
bluejetty:00034656:ios.description:
Embark on a captivating journey through "Royal Romances: Endless Winter," where your adventure takes you into a majestic kingdom frozen in eternal winter. The game invites you to find objects in a picture, solve logic puzzles, and unravel brain riddles in an epic tale of romance and mystery. Dive into the heart of a fantastical world with challenging hidden object games, seek and find hidden objects to progress through a riveting story, thaw the icy grip of fate and restore harmony to a kingdom in peril!
Eternal winter has descended upon the magnificent kingdom once filled with vitality and adventure. Cold and hunger have divided families and heroes, calling out their ugliest traits and draining their last strength. Meanwhile, dragons have returned to dwell among the people once more and help them in their misfortunes. Although some seek to profit from this, for others this is a cause for bringing back old grudges. After decades of mistreatment, the patience of the dragons themselves is wearing thin. Who can restore balance to the lands? A guardian of the forest, an elf, or an inept witch?
· ENGAGING LOGIC PUZZLES AND BRAIN RIDDLES!
Traverse through a frozen kingdom once brimming with life and now covered in an eternal winter. Test your skills with a variety of logic puzzles and brain teasers that will challenge and entertain you. Each riddle brings you closer to uncovering the mysteries of this enchanting realm!
· CAPTIVATING ROMANCE STORIES!
Experience rich romance stories and intriguing mystery tales. Your choices can influence the fate of individuals and entire kingdoms, making every decision critical to the outcome of the story!
· INTRICATE SEARCHING GAMES!
Enjoy a variety of searching games and soothing mini-games that add layers of excitement and reward. Earn achievements to prove your prowess in romantic games and discover bonus materials that will enhance your adventure!
· FANTASY-THEMED COLLECTIBLES!
Discover a wealth of collectible items hidden throughout the game. Explore breathtaking fantasy-themed sceneries and encounter a diverse cast of characters, from guardians of the forest to dragons seeking justice!
Experience the magic of "Royal Romances: Endless Winter" where hidden object games meet romance stories and mystery tales in a world full of riddles, brain teasers, and captivating adventures! Will you thaw the icy grip of fate and restore warmth to a kingdom in need?
-----

Find other games on our official website: https://dominigames.com/
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames
Check out our Instagram and stay tuned: https://www.instagram.com/dominigames

bluejetty:00153410:ios.description:
Bookology is a reading tracker and analytics app. Whether you're a casual reader or a devoted bookworm, it helps you organize your library, track your progress, and build a lifelong reading habit with ease.
[Library Management]
- Quickly add books via barcode scanning, online search, or manual entry
- Track reading status: Want to Read, Reading, Finished, Abandoned, On Hold
- Organize your collection with custom booklists
- Support for categories and series management
[Visual Bookshelf]
- Skeuomorphic bookshelf with spine and cover display modes
- Customize decorations and ornaments to create your own reading space
- Sync shelves and lists across devices via the cloud
[Reading Timer]
- Dedicated reading timer that automatically logs each session
- Supports Live Activities for real-time lock screen updates
- Start / pause / resume without breaking your tracking
- Literary Clock: shows excerpts from literature based on the current time
- Add countdown timers to stay focused and goal-oriented
[Progress Tracking]
- Log progress by pages or percentage
- Reading calendar for a clear daily overview
[Notes & Reflection]
- Capture quotes, thoughts
- Support for images and export
- Write reviews and rate books
- Daily note review: rediscover past notes with a curated daily selection
[Multi-Platform Import]
- Import notes from Kindle, Apple Books, WeRead, and DiMo Reader
- Import your library from Goodreads
- Automatic deduplication
[Reading Stats & Insights]
- Analyze reading time and session patterns
- Track formats: print, eBook, audiobook
- Monthly and yearly reading summaries
- Annual book showcase
- Most-read books statistics
[Widgets]
- Home screen widgets for quick progress tracking
- Reading streak widget to help maintain your habit
[Bookology Pro]
- Cloud backup and cross-device sync
- Unlimited booklists
- Advanced stats and historical data
- Unlimited reading session logs
- Full access to bookshelf decorations
- Goodreads library import
- Continuous access to future Pro features
Bookology is dedicated to being your best reading companion, exploring the joy of reading together with you.

Sync with your preferred service, use iCloud, or keep a lo
bluejetty:00165976:ios.description:
Make room for the reading you care about. Fiery Feeds brings your RSS subscriptions and saved articles together on iPhone, iPad and Mac, with layouts, fonts and colors you control.
Sync with your preferred service, use iCloud, or keep a local account. Fiery Feeds Pro adds Hot Links, Smart Views and full-text extraction to help you find what matters and read offline.
- Smart Views -
Hot Links - Find pages frequently linked in your articles.
Low and High Frequency - Separate quiet and busy feeds.
Long and Short Articles - Filter by article length.
Must Read - Keep important feeds together.
Recents - See today's articles.
- Text Extraction -
Read available full article text, including offline. Choose feed text, extracted text or the original website for each feed.
- Share Extension -
Save links to read later and subscribe to feeds from Safari and other compatible apps.
- Customizable -
Choose fonts, text sizes, colors and layouts. Create color themes with the included editor or browse the theme directory.
- Smart Searches -
Save searches by content, title, publication date, posting frequency and more.
- Home Widgets -
See articles, Hot Links and unread counts. Mark articles read or starred from supported widgets.
- Article Summaries and Translations -
Summarize and translate articles. Availability varies by device, OS, language and provider; external AI services require your own API key.
- Keyboard Shortcuts and VoiceOver -
Navigate with keyboard shortcuts and VoiceOver support.
- Custom URL Sharing -
Create URL actions and email templates for sharing articles.
- Feed Management -
Subscribe, organize feeds and folders, and work with multiple accounts.
- Even more -
Horizontal article swiping - Move between articles with a swipe.
Flexible read marking - Mark read on scroll, by age, or above or below an article.
Three Pane View - More room for reading on iPad and Mac.
- Supported Feed Accounts -
Feedly, Feedbin, Inoreader, NewsBlur, FreshRSS, Miniflux, Feeder, Gobbler, FeedHQ, BazQux, The Old Reader, Tiny Tiny RSS, Nextcloud News, Fever, iCloud and local accounts.
- Supported Read Later Accounts -
Instapaper, Raindrop.io, Karakeep, Wallabag, Pinboard, Paper Press, iCloud and local accounts. Features vary by account and service.
- Fiery Feeds Pro -
Pro includes text extraction, Smart Views, article summaries and translations, multiple accounts, saved searches, advanced widgets, feed management, custom themes and sharing actions. One subscription covers iOS and macOS.
Fiery Feeds Pro automatically renews as a paid subscription, unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the date of renewal. The payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. You can cancel a free trial or subscription anytime by turning off auto-renewal through your iTunes account settings. This must be done 24 hours before the end of a free trial or subscription period to avoid being charged. The cancellation will take effect the day after the last day of the current subscription period, and you will be downgraded to the free service. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a premium subscription during the free trial period.
Privacy Policy: https://voidstern.net/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://voidstern.net/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00024667:ios.description:
MY BENTLEY. ACCESS YOUR BENTLEY LIKE NEVER BEFORE.
Welcome to the My Bentley app. 
As the first step in your connected car journey, My Bentley provides you with new levels of access to your vehicle, enhancing your driving experience.
• Whether it is access to real time information about your vehicle, observing your vehicle’s past activity, or the peace of mind to check and lock your vehicle remotely, the My Bentley App provides you with access to a wide range of driver enhancing services.
• Access to a variety of vehicle features from the convenience of the My Bentley App. Whether it be pre-conditioning your cabin or remotely initiating your vehicle charging before you depart, you can making sure your vehicle is ready whenever you are.
• Put your mind at rest in the knowledge that you can observe your Bentley’s location and be notified of any triggered alarms from the comfort of the My Bentley App.
The companion to your Bentley, heightening your driving experience.
Please note:
You must register for a My Bentley account to use the My Bentley Connected Services. The availability of services will vary, depending on the model and equipment of your Bentley. Only Bentley models from 2017 and beyond will be able to use the My Bentley Connected Services.
My Bentley Connected Services require vehicle or handset cellular connectivity and availability of vehicle GPS signal. Standard text and data rates apply. Always pay careful attention to the road and do not drive while distracted. My Bentley includes services that may collect location information. Limitations apply. Some of the functions are dependent on the integration of third-party providers and may not be available at any time, at the same quality and be available in every country. Additional licenses or accounts may be required to access all functions of the application; music services.
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00159583:ios.description: VANSi provides financial wellness and stability insights into your daily balances, income, and upcoming expenditures at risk of overdrawing. VANSi also provides instant pay and transfer capabilities. This service allows you to pay or transfer funds to others from your existing funds or your future income whenever you don't have sufficient funds in your connected bank account. VANSi has an added on-demand feature that works as a cash advance, also known as Bridge-a-Gap "BaG" Cash, accompanied by education, motivation, and cutting-edge technologies. You must keep your bank account connected to the app and maintain your active membership to access these services. You may choose a free or premium membership by paying a fee. So long as you keep your membership active, if your bank account is at risk of being overdrawn, you may request a BaG (typically $20 or $50, gradually increasing to $200) to avoid financial strain. BaGs are offered to all clients with qualified accounts (subject to approval) as a welcome to VANSi. BaGs are not loans or traditional credits. After your necessity has passed and you have sufficient funds, if you choose to return your BaG to your VANSi account, you can access it again and again, each time with a larger amount, up to $200 (subject to approval). You may choose to receive your on-demand BaG with standard 3-business-day delivery (free of charge) or request to receive it expedited within a few minutes (or same-day by 9:00 pm EST, depending on your bank) by paying an express fee, which varies and will be shown to you on the Checkout screen based on your BaG amount.

bluejetty:00015318:ios.description:
EASY VOCABULARY MASTERY THROUGH GAMING
Learn hundreds of beginner-friendly Russian words through immersive space-themed gameplay. Experience fun flashcard learning that makes memorization effortless.
INNOVATIVE MULTI-SENSORY APPROACH
Master vocabulary through three learning formats: text, audio, and visual icons. This proven method enhances memory retention and accelerates language acquisition naturally.
COMPREHENSIVE WORD CATEGORIES
Build practical vocabulary across everyday topics:
 • Numbers
 • Animals
 • Fruits
 • Vegetables
 • Food & Drinks
 • Clothing
 • Weather
 • And more
DUAL STUDY MODES
Choose between two learning experiences:
 • Easy Learning Mode: Natural acquisition without English translations
 • Fun Review Challenges: Customizable quizzes to reinforce knowledge
COMPLETE RUSSIAN WRITING SYSTEM SUPPORT
Learn using Cyrillic script or phonetic transliterations. Switch anytime to match your learning style and skill level.
OFFLINE LANGUAGE LEARNING
Study anytime, anywhere—even without internet. Great for commutes, travel, or limited connectivity.
GAMIFIED PROGRESS TRACKING
Answer vocabulary challenges by tapping meteors in an interactive space-themed setting. Engaging gameplay makes language study feel like a game.
FREE ACCESS TO ALL VOCABULARY
All core vocabulary words are free to learn. Optional ads and in-app purchases support continued development.
KEY FEATURES:
 • Hundreds of curated Russian vocabulary words
 • Text, audio, and image-based learning
 • Spaced repetition for long-term retention
 • Phonetic and Cyrillic script support
 • Works offline
 • Customizable review quizzes
 • Space-themed gamified learning
 • Free core content with ads and optional upgrades
Transform your Russian vocabulary skills with this fun, immersive, and effective language trainer.
