bluejetty:00163790:ios.name: RGB Cube Solver &Timer
bluejetty:00163790:ios.summary: RGB Cube Solver &Timer, the ultimate application designed to transform you into a Cube solving expert. Mastering this iconic puzzle is a rare skill, but with Cube Solver, it's within your reach. Gone are the days of struggling with complex
bluejetty:00163790:ios.description:
RGB Cube Solver &Timer, the ultimate application designed to transform you into a Cube solving expert. Mastering this iconic puzzle is a rare skill, but with Cube Solver, it's within your reach. Gone are the days of struggling with complex algorithms – now, your trusty Cube solver fits right in your pocket. With Cube Solver, solving the Cube becomes a breeze. Choose between manual input for precise control or advanced camera input, allowing you to effortlessly capture each side of the cube. Once all sides are inputted, our powerful algorithm springs into action, delivering a solution to even the most challenging configurations. Follow the step-by-step guidance of our magical puzzle solver and conquer any combination with ease. Plus, explore a range of cube sizes, from 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, 5x5 and 6x6, and enjoy customizable options to suit your preferences.
Join over 3 million cubers who have used RGB Cube Solver to develop top problem-solving and pattern recognition skills. Save hours of frustration with simple instructions guiding you to solve your cube in a matter of minutes. Improve your concentration and speed over time to show off your Rubik’s cube solving skills to the world.
In addition to solving your favorite puzzles, our app also offers a variety of additional features to enhance your solving experience. With our Rubiks Cube Timer, you can track your solving times and compete with friends. We also have a One vs One Rubiks Cube Timer feature, allowing you to race against another person to see who can solve the puzzle faster.
*Intuitive Interface:
Welcome to Cube Solver, where user-friendly design meets effortless navigation. Whether you're a novice or a seasoned solver, our intuitive interface ensures smooth sailing throughout your cube-solving journey.
*Solver Algorithms:
Powered by a robust solving engine equipped with a diverse array of algorithms, Cube Solver tackles everything from the classic 3x3 cube to the intricate variations of magic cubes. Expect nothing but efficient and effective solutions tailored to your cube's unique configuration.
*Step-by-Step Guidance:
Embark on your solving quest with confidence as Cube Solver 3D breaks down the process into digestible steps. With clear and concise instructions, our app not only guides your moves but also enhances your understanding of the Cube logic, transforming you into a solving virtuoso with each progression.
*Multi Cube Support:
From the compact 2x2 to the challenging 4x4 and beyond, Cube Solver adapts to your cube preferences. Explore an array of configurations and hone your skills across various challenges without limitations.
*Camera Input:
Experience a seamless solving experience by scanning your cube's sides through our unique camera input feature. Say goodbye to manual input and embrace the convenience of effortless cube recognition.
* Cube Timer:
Track your solving speed with precision using our Cube Timer. Whether you prefer physical cubes or the virtual 3D experience, our timer runs in parallel, allowing you to measure your progress and enhance your skills with every solve.
*Customization Options:
Take control of your solving experience with Cube Solver's customization features. Adjust solver speed, explore different solving methods, and personalize the app to match your unique solving style for an unparalleled solving experience.
SUPPORTED CUBES
* 2x2 cube solver
* 3x3 rubik's cube solver
* 4x4 cube solver
* 5x5: Professor's Cube
* 6x6: V-Cube 6
* 7x7: V-Cube 7
* 8x8: V-Cube 8
* 9x9: V-Cube 9
* 10x10: V-Cube 10
* 11x11: V-Cube 11
Email: yikenyonggang@gmail.com.
Terms: http://cubesolv.com/terms-conditions/terms-conditions-2
Privacy policy: http://cubesolv.com/terms-conditions/privacy-policy-2

bluejetty:00025808:ios.description:
SOLDIERS!
Enter a world where existence itself is out to eliminate you! You are the last man standing, the only force able to resist and defeat the oncoming waves of enemies.
Step up, stack up awesome skills and fight like your life depends on it.
Enjoy creating countless combinations of unique skills all designed to help you survive.
Key Features:
• DUAL WEAPONS & DRONES!
• Random and unique skills to help you fight with enemies.
• Epic boss fights!
• Explore beautiful chapters and build your base.
• Enjoy the thrilling zombie fights.
• Level-up and equip yourself with powerful equipment to increase your stats.
IAP & Subscription Technical Integration 
PART I - IAPs
3 Basic rules for IAPs before starting their integrations:
“Remember that IAPs take time to pass the AppStore review”
“They always need to be submitted for review with a new build”
” The IAP bundle id should be the same on both platform”
To have a smooth integration we recommend you to carefully follow this article: https://voodoo.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/360007590839-In-App-Purchases
The documentation is ALL you should follow. It us up to date and fairly simple to follow.
HOWEVER: Remember IAPs are NOT subscriptions. It has to be a ONE TIME PURCHASE otherwise your account can be banned permanently.
PART II - SUBSCRIPTIONS 
Subscriptions are harder to implement.
Regarding the integration with VoodooSauce the best first step is to follow as much as possible:
This Voodoo documentation:
https://voodoo.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/360007590899-Subscriptions
You will also need a specific Apple Set Up:
“App-Specific Shared secret” on AppstoreConnect game page.
In order to find it, you can navigate to App information -> App-Specific Shared secret -> Manage.
If you don’t have permission to retrieve it, please ping the Publishing Ops team. They will be able to retrieve it for you.
For iOS, make sure to link https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
For iOS, the AppStore requires to have information about subscriptions on the app’s description so do not forget about this. If you don’t know what to use, feel free to copy and paste the one below:
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS
Your subscription will be charged to your Account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
You can turn off the auto-renew for the subscription whenever you want to through iTunes. Check https://support.apple.com/HT202039. When your current trial/subscription period expires, you will be unsubscribed. The current active subscription period can not be canceled. After your subscription expires, you will lose VIP membership benefits.
If you have any questions or comments, feel free to contact us at https://www.voodoo.io/
Privacy Policy: https://www.voodoo.io/privacy/
Term of use: https://www.voodoo.io/purchase/
For any other questions, please contact: mailto:studio-support@voodoo.io

bluejetty:00126892:ios.description:
Racecar Engineering is the world’s leading technology magazine for motorsport.
Every issue of Racecar Engineering looks under the skin of racing and rallying to show its readers why some cars go quicker than others. 
Read by thousands of racers every month it, Racecar Engineering magazine helps them keep a winning edge. 
Learn about the latest developments in F1 , Nascar, Rally and Le Mans, and find out what is coming up in the near future.
Each month Racecar Engineering magazine brings the best possible insight into all forms of the rapidly changing world of motorsport engineering. 
From keeping pace with the latest technologies to expanding your knowledge of racecar design and operation, no other magazine gets you closer.
Back issues and future issues are available for purchase within the App.
Future issues are also available through the following auto-renewing subscription(s):
-12 Issues (1 Year) at £49.99 / $64.99
- 6 Issues (6 Months) at £27.99 / $36.99
-1 Issue (1 month) at £4.99 / $6.99
The subscription will include the current issue if you do not already own it and subsequently published future issues. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. This subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period, your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. The cost of the renewal will match the initial subscription price.
You may turn off auto-renewing subscriptions by going to your user’s Account Settings after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during your active subscription period. 
Please find our Privacy Policy here: https://chelseamagazines.com/privacy/
Please find our Terms & Conditions here: https://www.chelseamagazines.com/the-chelsea-magazine-company-terms-and-conditions/

bluejetty:00118793:ios.description:
THE BBC APP: News, stories, audio, videos, documentaries and live coverage from our trusted global network of journalists.
BBC STORIES: The latest breaking news headlines, articles, podcasts and videos, including coverage of world News, UK News, elections, BBC Verify, BBC In-Depth and more. Stories and videos covering business, technology, health, culture, arts, travel, Earth, and more.
LIVE COVERAGE: Get live news and live global sport updates.
WATCH BBC NEWS: Live stream the BBC News channel for 24/7 world news coverage right from the app. 
BBC RADIO: Listen live to BBC World Service and Radio 4 while using the BBC app or background audio when switching to another app. Catch up on demand with some previously aired radio shows via the radio schedule page.
BBC PODCASTS: Listen to, save and follow on-demand podcasts such as The Global Story and World of Secrets. For offline listening, download episodes to your mobile device. Find current and past episodes from news, politics, culture, true, crime, history, science and sport. 
BBC VIDEOS: Watch BBC News videos, BBC Sport videos and video stories about climate, sustainability, science, health, technology, entertainment and history.
BREAKING NEWS ALERTS: Turn on breaking news notifications from BBC News. 
DOCUMENTARIES: Now you can watch on-demand documentaries right in your BBC app. Stream acclaimed series and films from the BBC and beyond, including history, true crime, royalty, natural history, biographies and global affairs. (In-app purchase required)
MORE FEATURES:
- Save articles, podcasts, and videos for later in app on BBC.com 
- Watch videos and listen to audio over cellular and wifi 
- Share articles, stories, podcasts, and videos to social platforms like Facebook and WhatsApp, and send via SMS and email
- Audio playback controls with sleep timer and live rewind
- Increase your font size for improved readability
- Dark mode available for a dark-background reading experience 
- Opt-in or opt-out of breaking news alerts
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS:
A paid subscription includes unlimited access to:
- Stream BBC News Channel 
- Acclaimed documentaries 
- Binge-worthy early access podcast episodes 
- News, analysis and features 
- Access across all your devices
Access your subscription on devices where the BBC app is available and on BBC.com. Choose a monthly or yearly plan. Your subscription will auto-renew unless you cancel at least 24 hours before renewal. You can manage your BBC subscription in the App Store. 
ADDITIONAL INFO:
If you choose to receive breaking news alerts, a unique identifier relating to your device will be stored by Airship on behalf of the BBC to provide you with the service. You can choose to unsubscribe from breaking news alerts from BBC in your device’s ‘Notifications’ screen.
Our data processor AppsFlyer collects information on behalf of the BBC for attribution and analysis purposes. You can opt out from AppsFlyer tracking by filling out their ‘Forget My Device’ form: https://www.appsflyer.com/optout
The BBC will keep your information secure and not share it with anyone else in accordance with the BBC’s Privacy and Cookies Policy. To read the BBC’s Privacy Policy go to: https://www.bbc.com/pages/privacy-policy
If you install this app you accept the BBC Terms of Use at: https://www.bbc.com/pages/terms-of-use
Subscription terms may apply: https://www.bbc.com/pages/subscription-terms

bluejetty:00162648:ios.summary:
Orthodox Calendar – An App for Believers
Orthodox Calendar – Your faithful companion in spiritual life! A convenient and functional tool with daily feasts, fasting periods, scripture readings, and prayers.
Orthodoxy in Your Phone
The app
bluejetty:00162648:ios.description:
Orthodox Calendar – An App for Believers
Orthodox Calendar – Your faithful companion in spiritual life! A convenient and functional tool with daily feasts, fasting periods, scripture readings, and prayers.
Orthodoxy in Your Phone
The app deeply reflects Orthodox traditions, helping you stay connected to your faith in the modern rhythm of life. It brings together all the essential tools for daily spiritual practice—from a feast day calendar to a prayer book and Holy Scripture.
Key Features:
∙ Orthodox calendar with vertical scrolling (Julian and Revised Julian styles).
∙ Detailed information about feasts, saints, and icons of the Mother of God for each day.
∙ Gospel readings.
∙ Birthdays from contacts (displayed in the calendar).
Bible (Full Version)
∙ All books of the Bible (KJV version).
∙ Adjustable font size using the "Tt" icon in the top-right corner.
∙ Navigate between chapters using the arrow buttons in the bottom-right corner.
Orthodox Prayer Book (Full Version)
∙ Contains the most essential Orthodox prayers: morning, evening, for Communion, and for various life situations.
∙ Adjustable font size via the "Tt" icon in the top-right corner.
∙ Read in page-by-page (horizontal) or scrollable (vertical) mode (switchable in font settings).
∙ If you miss any important prayers, please let us know in a review!
Memorial Book
∙ Enter the names of your living and departed loved ones into the Memorial Book.
∙ Access the Memorial Book by clicking the book icon at the top of the screen during prayer readings.
∙ When ordering memorial services (requiems), you can insert names from the Memorial Book using the menu in the top right corner.
Other Useful Features
∙ The Search menu allows you to look up feasts, saints, icons of the Mother of God, and prayers.
∙ The Notification Settings menu lets you set reminders for feasts, fasts, and birthdays.
∙ Add a widget to your home screen for quick access to calendar highlights.
Most app features work offline.
The Bible and Prayer Book are part of the full version, which requires a purchase or subscription.
Terms of Use: http://orthodoxcalendar.ru/terms

bluejetty:00061803:ios.description:
The USA Truck Driver Information Hub (Driver HUB) was designed with you, our valued professional driving team members, in mind. This is your portal to an easier and more efficient life on the road. You can do many things with this app, including:
• Send and receive messages
• Scan and send documents
• View load and stop details, including fuel stops
• Plan trips using the interactive Trip Planner Map showing stops, amenities, HOS range
• Navigate turn-by-turn using HERE Truck Routing Navigation with live traffic rerouting
• Accept/Reject planned loads
• Perform all Circle-of-Service steps for loads and stops using Dispatch Workflow buttons and forms
• Sync to Geotab for HOS duty status, perform DVIR, view eLogs
• Lookup your Elogs history and My HOS
• Process the current load and stop from the Home Dashboard Card
• Check current Hours of Service from the Home Dashboard Card
• Refer to My Info from the Home Dashboard Card
• Review recent Paystubs and Current Week Miles
• View Safety and Training videos, Permits, and Policies
• Report safety issues
• Scan Photos for sending DVIR, Collision, Breakdown photos
• Show the weather for each stop
• Launch other installed apps from the Main Menu such as CAT Scale, FleetAdvance, Drivewyze
• Have access to news
• Take a Survey
• Visit the Company Store
• Contact the Driver Access Line and Departments via Call USA Truck page
• Login using a shared device for Teams, Trainers, and Students
• Run the app from tablet devices for larger screen viewing
… And much more — anywhere you happen to be!

bluejetty:00094500:ios.description:
CART AI: STOP OVERSPENDING AT CHECKOUT
Do you lose track of your cart total and overspend at checkout?
Cart AI is a shopping budget tracker and grocery spending companion that helps you track your cart total in real time, stay under budget, and avoid surprises at the register.
Scan prices, monitor your spending, and build smarter shopping habits.
SHOP WITH A LIVE CART TOTAL
• Set a budget for every shopping trip.
• Scan price tags or enter prices manually.
• Watch your cart total update instantly.
• Get alerts before going over budget.
QUICK CART TOTAL
• Need a fast total without setting a budget?
• Add prices in seconds and instantly see how much is in your cart.
• Perfect for grocery shopping, mall trips, and everyday purchases.
SCAN FASTER WITH MULTI-SHOT MODE
• Scan multiple price tags without stopping.
• Add items continuously while shopping.
• Review everything at once after scanning.
STAY UNDER BUDGET WITH AI
Went over budget? Cart AI can suggest items to remove or adjust to help bring your cart back within budget. No manual math required.
SMART SHOPPING LISTS
• Create reusable shopping lists.
• Estimate costs before leaving home.
• Save favorite items in your personal item bank.
• Track price history to spot increases.
• Turn lists into active shopping trips with one tap.
SPENDING INSIGHTS
• View monthly spending and savings trends.
• See category breakdowns and your most-bought items.
• Review previous shopping trips.
• Track savings goals and understand your shopping habits over time.
ACHIEVEMENTS & GOALS
• Earn badges for staying under budget.
• Set monthly savings goals.
• Build better shopping habits over time.
SHARE YOUR PROGRESS
Share trip summaries, shopping lists, achievements, and insights using beautifully designed cards. Perfect for sharing with family, friends, or on social media.
SHOP ANYWHERE
• Works with or without Wi-Fi.
• Supports 100+ currencies.
• Travel Mode automatically converts prices to your home currency.
• Great for grocery shopping, travel shopping, and everyday purchases.
• Available in 19 languages.
WHY CART AI?
Cart AI is a grocery budget tracker, shopping list app, and spending tracker built for people who want to stay under budget without managing their entire financial life.
Whether you're shopping for groceries, home supplies, travel essentials, or everyday purchases, Cart AI helps you know your total before checkout and spend with more confidence.
PAY ONCE. NO SUBSCRIPTION.
Cart AI is available as a one-time purchase. Pay once and get access to the app without a recurring subscription.
Cart AI does not track your full financial history. It is designed specifically to help you track your cart total, avoid overspending, and manage your shopping budget more easily.

bluejetty:00170627:ios.description:
Make a tournament bracket in seconds and follow every game to the final.
Bracket Builder is a bracket maker for iPhone and iPad. Create single-elimination, double-elimination, round-robin and group-stage tournaments, enter scores as you play, then share the bracket or show it live on a TV. No account needed.
FORMATS
- Single elimination, up to 128 teams
- Double elimination with a losers bracket, up to 64 teams
- Round robin, up to 50 teams, with random doubles for pickleball, tennis and padel
- Group stage to knockout, up to 128 teams
- Best of 3, 5 or 7 series, a third-place match and two-sided brackets
DURING THE TOURNAMENT
- Tap a team to pick the winner; press and hold to enter the score
- Winners move on by themselves, and the path to the title lights up
- Undo any pick at any time
- Live standings: wins, draws, losses, goals for and against, and goal difference
- Automatic seeding with byes placed for you, or a random draw
SEASONS AND LEAGUES
- Run a league with its own schedule, table, play-in and playoffs
- Or group your brackets into a season and see every team's record in one table
SHOW IT OFF
- Show on TV: put the live bracket on an Apple TV or any AirPlay TV
- Share the bracket as an image or PDF, or print a scoresheet
- Pick your app icon, including a new gold trophy
YOUR TEAMS
- Save teams in rosters once and reuse them in every tournament
- Add a photo and a color for every team or player
- Rename, reorder or remove teams even after the bracket is made
SYNC AND BACKUP
- iCloud sync between iPhone and iPad, with no sign-up
- Import and export brackets as files
- Bring back a deleted bracket from the Trash
Made for pool and darts leagues, pickleball and tennis clubs, cornhole, soccer and basketball, esports, PE classes, office pools, family game night, or a bracket of anything: songs, movies, snacks.
SUBSCRIPTION PLANS
- Yearly Plan
- Lifetime Plan

bluejetty:00121526:ios.description:
Join chef Pepper and embark on a culinary journey that spans the globe. Prepare mouthwatering entrées, desserts, and sides and serve them to quirky customers in your personal upgradable food truck. Earn tons of tips for quick service, then upgrade ingredients and appliances to build the ultimate kitchen on wheels!
Challenge your time-management skills in this highly addictive game! Dash around kitchen environments crafted specifically for each famous cuisine. Enjoy an endless cooking journey as you travel the world. Become a food truck tycoon and master the delicious dishes in high demand by your adoring customers.
The Rundown:
• Cook dozens of delectable dishes from simple street food to haute cuisine!
• Upgrade your food truck and unlock new ingredients and appliances!
• Serve tons of quirky customers — but don’t make them wait!
• Combine items in new and unexpected ways to make even crazier recipes!
• Prepare and serve local delicacies from all over the world!
• Win huge rewards and cook your way to the top!
Serve Fantastic Food Anywhere, Anytime
• Free to download and play
Discover Interesting Foods From Around The World
• Cook up real recipes with the proper ingredients and methods
• Upgrade your ingredients and appliances to make your dishes even tastier!
• Thousands of upgrade combinations for deep customization
• Expertly simplified for everyone to enjoy! 
Cook & Travel
• Take your food truck on a road trip across numerous locations
• Each location features its own unique cuisine
• Master each local specialty as you progress!
Fun & Impactful Power-Ups
• Cook at lightning speeds
• Double your earnings from satisfied customers
• Never burn your food again with a handy fire extinguisher
• Hundreds of levels and counting
Cook Amazing Food
• Chick'N'Stuff: Fried Chicken Sandwich, Grilled Chicken Sandwich, Fries, Mozzarella Sticks, Stuffed Peppers, Salad, Grilled Corn
• Bun Noodles: Miso Soup, Green Tea, Pork Belly Udon, Torched Eel, Vegan Yakiudon, Fried Gyoza
• Gyro Hero: Greek Salad, Tapenade, Souvlaki, Pilaf, Dolmades, Spanakopita, Moussaka, Baklava, Tahini
Bonus Levels
• Unlock bonus levels in each location by completing the levels in Chick'N'Stuff location
• A challenging, additional level is unlocked with every locked gate cleared!
• Chance to play to these difficult levels is refreshed every 12 hours
• Complete the chef worthy levels to earn more rewards!
Look Forward To
• Getting substantial rewards from checking in daily
• Achievements and rewards for cooking up a storm!
• Regular free updates!
Coming Soon
• More Events
• Exotic cuisine themed levels and locations
• Game improvements

bluejetty:00184269:ios.description:
The BankFund Digital Banking app provides quick and convenient access to your BankFund Credit Union accounts anytime, anywhere, and on the device that is most convenient for you: smartphone, tablet, laptop, or desktop computer.
Access is quick and, most importantly, secure. Our biometric login uses your face to confirm your identity, providing an extra layer of protection. Once logged in, you can review and manage your BankFund accounts, check balances, transfer funds, make payments, deposit checks, send money with Zelle®, set alerts and notifications, and more – all from the app. You can even apply for a loan or open a new account, all while we keep your information safe.
BankFund Digital Banking also includes several additional features, including the ability for credit union members to send secure messages, check their Global Rewards level, and explore a variety of benefits based on their BankFund relationship.

• Location: The app will request permission to use your location to find BankFund branches and ATMs near you.
• Identity: Identity information is accessed to find accounts on your device. This is required to manage multiple user functionality and for push notifications.
• Contacts: Identity information is accessed to find accounts on your device. This is required to manage multiple user functionality and for push notifications.
• Camera: The app requires camera access for mobile check deposits.
• Photos/Media/Files: The app requires access to files on your device to process images, cache information, and save files, such as mobile check deposits.
• Storage: The app requires access to files on your device to process images, cache information, and save files, such as mobile check deposits.
• Device ID & call information: The app requires access to phone information, including the phone number, to correctly identify the device.

bluejetty:00145998:ios.description:
Pick up where pen and paper leave off with Mental Canvas Draw. Creatives are using Mental Canvas Draw every day to explore ideas, communicate concepts, design products and tell stories. 
Infinite space for your creative freedom: 
• Draw on infinite canvases arranged in space 
• Freely navigate the spatial drawing to view perspectives you never could on paper 
• Unlimited canvases, layers and bookmark views
Draw with the ease of pen and paper:
• Get started with templates or create scenes from scratch 
• Choose from several brushes with adjustable sizes and a fill tool
• Select color swatches or custom colors 
• Use layers to organize the drawings, group strokes and adjust opacity
Easy editing & image import: 
• Import JPEGs and PNGs to seamlessly collage images and drawings together or create entirely image-based scenes
• Select, duplicate, edit and transform drawings and images 
• Import and replace layers from your favorite drawing apps with ease
Quickly create animated flythroughs:
• Save bookmark views throughout the spatial drawing to create a flythrough 
• Customize the flythrough animation by adjusting the timing, transitions and visibility of canvases 
Transform and develop spatial drawings with projection: 
• Seamlessly place new canvases in the scene 
• Reinterpret existing strokes using novel projection tools
• Draw first, arrange strokes on canvases later
Share your creations: 
• Turn your drawing into an interactive web experience, shareable across phones, desktops, and VR
• Export video of animated flythrough with your choice of aspect ratio and resolution 
• Save high resolution images of bookmarks
Optimized for Apple Pencil and the Apple iPad Pro.

Elevate Your Financial Well-being with iXpenseIt: The Ultimate Personal Finance App
Welcome to iXpenseIt, where managing your personal finances becomes not just simple, but a part of your daily joy. Imagine a world where every penny is accounted for, every expense tracked effortlessly, and your financial goals are within reach. That's the world iXpenseIt creates for you. Whether you're looking to keep tabs on your personal budget, streamline business expenses for swift reimbursements, or simply find smarter ways to save, iXpenseIt is your financial companion.
Why Choose iXpenseIt?
• Award-Winning Excellence: Praised in Apple's TV commercials and lauded by CNN Money Magazine, LAPTOP Magazine, PC World, and many more for its unparalleled utility and user-friendly design.
• Effortless Expense Tracking & Budgeting: With intuitive daily expense tracking and comprehensive monthly budgeting, iXpenseIt turns the tedious task of managing money into a breeze. Capture photo receipts in an instant, enter expenses with a few taps, and enjoy powerful reporting that offers deep insights into your spending habits.
• Features That Empower You: From seamless Excel export, upcoming bill reminders, and quick data entry, to detailed PDF reporting, multi-currency support, and robust budgeting tools, iXpenseIt has everything you need to take control of your finances.
• Security You Can Trust: With Touch ID protection and secure backup options, your financial data is always safe and at your fingertips.
• Subscription for Seamless Synchronization: Sync your financial data across up to 5 devices for a consolidated view of your finances, ensuring you and your family are always on the same page.
What Sets iXpenseIt Apart?
• Visualize Your Financial Journey: With trend bar charts for expenses and cash flow, along with an instant overview of today's spending vs. the daily average, you'll gain valuable insights into your financial habits at a glance.
• Customizable and Convenient: Tailor the app to your needs with customizable budgets, categories, and icons. Plus, with support for VAT/GST, mileage tracking, and easy transaction personalization, iXpenseIt adapts to your lifestyle.
• Stay Informed and In Control: From reminders for upcoming bills to summaries of your monthly expenses and easy-to-generate graphical reports, you're always informed and in control of your finances.
• Join the iXpenseIt Community
Join millions who have transformed their financial lives with iXpenseIt. It's not just about tracking expenses; it's about discovering new ways to achieve your financial dreams. With iXpenseIt, you're not just managing your money; you're mastering it.

Terms of Use: http://www.mobilewareinc.com/legal/tos.html

Take the first step towards financial empowerment today with iXpenseIt and redefine your relationship with money.

bluejetty:00082105:ios.description:
Gotham Sports is the new streaming home for the New York Yankees, the New York Knicks, the Brooklyn Nets, the New York Rangers, the New York Islanders, the New Jersey Devils, the Buffalo Sabres, and more all in one, easy-to-use app. Access to Gotham Sports includes:
o Live games and full game replays
o Hometown coverage and in-depth analysis
o Award-winning original programming and exclusive content
o Play-by-play stats and Pick-N-Play predictor game with prizes
o Gotham Sports rewards program 
There are two ways fans can get access to Gotham Sports: 
1. Free with an eligible cable subscription: 
if you have access YES Network and MSG Network as part of your cable subscription, you’ll have free access to Gotham Sports. Just download the app, create a free account, and link your cable subscription account. 
2. Subscribe directly to Gotham Sports: 
if you don’t have access to an eligible TV subscription, you can subscribe directly in the Gotham Sports app.
Location restrictions:
o Gotham Sports will only stream games that are available on the YES Network and MSG Network. Local blackout restrictions apply.
o League and programming restrictions require Gotham Sports mobile & tablet users to turn on location services. Gotham Sports will use location services to determine what content users are eligible to view. Gotham Sports is only available in the continental US.
Please refer to Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Introducing Watch Faces, the ultimate application for Apple Watch users who want to personalize their device and express their unique style. With a powerful AI generator, Watch Faces can create one-of-a-kind watch faces that are tailored specifically to your preferences. Choose from a range of styles, colors, and designs to create a custom look that is uniquely yours.

Enjoy the app!

bluejetty:00135941:ios.description:
Traffic Hour - Car Escape is a fun and addictive 3D car parking jam puzzle game. 
Do you feel the excitement of resolving the traffic escape puzzle? Do you love traffic games? Let's dive into the world of car jam parking game which includes a hundred levels of car parking puzzle. Help the car escape from the crowded road during rush hour!
In the world of car escape puzzles, Traffic Hour is a brand new challenge that can bring you the excitement you can not imagine. Tap to move cars but be careful pedestrians, don’t crash! Train your brain with a puzzle challenge on the jammed highways, and test your strategic thinking to solve puzzles that get harder at each level. Let's see if you are skillful enough to resolve all the traffic escape puzzles in this game.
HOW TO PLAY Traffic Escape: 
▶ Tap to start the game & escape the traffic jam.
▶ Plan moves to avoid collisions & navigate the traffic.
▶ Aim for high scores, achievements & leaderboard rankings.
▶ Remember, quick thinking, careful planning & precise tapping will be key to successfully escaping the traffic jam & completing each level in this car escape
WHY PLAY Car Escape Game: 
▶New challenge car parking game. Many easy-to-hard challenges are waiting for you.
▶Refresh your mind with car traffic games. Easy to play, use one finger to clear the traffic jam
▶Levels will get harder and harder whenever you finish a challenge, this car puzzle game is easy to play but hard to master.
This traffic game puzzle combines addictive gameplay, brain-teasing puzzles & a realistic traffic jam escape environment to deliver a thrilling & challenging gaming experience. The amazing challenges can help you improve your logical thinking and strategy. Enjoy great time with family and friends with this addictive game and see how fast you can solve the traffic puzzle.
Play Traffic Hour - Car Escape, join this addictive and fun traffic puzzle game and challenge your brain skills now.

bluejetty:00036018:ios.name: DrawinGrid
bluejetty:00036018:ios.summary: DrawinGrid is a drawing companion and project manager built for artists who work from reference photos. Overlay an adjustable grid on any image, size and position it exactly how you need, and use it to keep proportions and perspective accur
bluejetty:00036018:ios.description:
DrawinGrid is a drawing companion and project manager built for artists who work from reference photos. Overlay an adjustable grid on any image, size and position it exactly how you need, and use it to keep proportions and perspective accurate as you sketch — on paper or digitally.
Beyond the grid tool, DrawinGrid helps you manage your art from first reference to finished piece, so your projects, progress, and portfolio all live in one place.
GRID & REFERENCE TOOLS
- Load and crop any reference image
- Adjustable grid settings — size, spacing, and style to match your workflow
- Full-screen zoom and drag for close, accurate work
- Export and save your gridded reference for later or for printing
TRACING
- AR Sketch — float your reference over the camera view and trace it
 straight onto paper
- Trace on Screen — draw over your reference on the screen with a finger
 or stylus
- Move, pinch and zoom the reference to line it up exactly where you want it
- Undo and redo every stroke while you work
- Export your finished tracing to save, share, or add to a project
PROJECT MANAGEMENT
- Organize your artwork into a personal project library
- Track project timelines and hours spent, piece by piece
- Sync and store your projects securely in the cloud
AI-ASSISTED WORKFLOW
- Let AI suggest project titles so you can spend less time naming files and more time drawing
SHARE YOUR WORK
- Publish a public gallery to showcase finished pieces
- Optionally list and mark artwork as sold to share your work with buyers
Whether you're a hobbyist filling a sketchbook or a working artist managing a full slate of commissions, DrawinGrid gives you the drawing aids and the organization to see every project through.
Some features, including cloud sync, AI-assisted tools, and the public gallery, require an account and are intended for users aged 13 and over. In-app purchases are available for these pro features.
EULA: https://drawinggrid.app/eula.html

bluejetty:00116364:ios.description:
Turn any pet photo into a talking, singing video — and find out what your dog or cat is trying to say.
TALKING & SINGING PETS
Upload a photo of your cat, dog or any animal, add a song or record your own voice, and AI makes your pet talk with smooth, realistic lip-sync. Birthday greetings, funny voice messages, pet memes — ready to share in seconds.
TEXT TO VOICE
Type any line and your pet says it out loud. Choose from a huge library of voices — search by language or style — and preview them for free.
DOG & CAT TRANSLATOR
Tap to listen while your pet barks or meows. The Pet Translator reads the sound's pace, energy and pitch and turns it into a playful human phrase like "Let's play — I'm ready!" or "A snack would be wonderful." Switch between Dog and Cat modes anytime.
AI PET VIDEOS FROM A PROMPT
Describe your idea — "my cat in a tiny hat singing a funny song" — and the AI video generator brings it to life.
AI PET AVATARS
Restyle your pet's photo in a new look, then animate it.
MY PET PROFILES
Add your buddies with name, breed, birthday and weight, so every video feels truly theirs.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Pick a clear photo of one pet facing the camera
2. Add a song, upload audio or record your voice
3. Tap Create and share the video with friends
The Pet Translator is made for fun and entertainment and does not provide a scientific interpretation of animal sounds.
Premium subscription unlocks unlimited video generation and faster rendering. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account and renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your Account Settings

【剧情】丰富的原创剧情，繁多的分支情节，层出不穷的悬念，幽默的对白桥段，为你打造一个与其他游戏迥然不同的光
bluejetty:00178576:ios.description:
"天下风云出我辈，一入江湖岁月催。皇图霸业谈笑中，不胜人生一场醉。提剑跨骑挥鬼雨，白骨如山鸟惊飞。尘事如潮人如水，只叹江湖几人回"。
 十四本天书重现江湖，掀起了新一轮的腥风血雨。主人公一不小心穿越到了这个风起云涌的武侠世界，身不由己地随着江湖的浪潮起起伏伏，经历了无数的艰难险阻和阴谋诡计之后，最终练成了绝世神功，找到了真爱，自由自在的在江湖上驰骋！
游戏的特点：
【剧情】丰富的原创剧情，繁多的分支情节，层出不穷的悬念，幽默的对白桥段，为你打造一个与其他游戏迥然不同的光怪陆离的武侠世界！
【人物】1000+个出场人物角色，每个人物都有鲜明的个性特色，故事感极强
【神功】600+个武功种类，囊括了武侠小说里几乎所有的神功秘籍，独特的武功设定，没有武学上限，你可以变得前所未有的强大
【装备】1000+种道具和装备，丰富而多变的装备设定，让每一件装备都有可能变成神兵利器
【天赋】200+的天赋设定，每个角色都有不用的武学个性，使得每个角色都显得真实而触手可及
【称号】100+的称号系统，让主人公不再在江湖中籍籍无名，与故事情节完美结合，不同的称号，在江湖的地位大不一样
【洗练】独特的洗练系统，随性所欲的定制符合自己要求的装备，让每一件装备都称心如意
【经络】独一无二的经络修炼系统，囊括了几百个穴位和奇经八脉，完全贴合武侠小说中的武功修炼之道，使得武功修炼更有挑战、更真实、更有趣
【锻造】每件装备都有巨大的成长空间，只要你去锻造和强化，一块凡铁也能成为闯荡江湖的最大依仗
【武学】平衡的武学设定，拳掌、刀、剑、奇门、内功等不同的武学修炼道路，在任何方面的修炼都可以成为绝世高手
【门派】几十个门派林立于江湖，可以虚心以求学，可以野心以吞并，可以残忍以灭门，怎么选，全看你
【招募】完成特定的任务就可以招募各种英雄于旗下，各路豪杰枭雄都唯你马首是瞻
【挂机】轻松的挂机系统，可以一边挂机一边刷副本，累了就把手机扔到一边，过几天再来收割经验
【扫荡】方便的扫荡系统，轻松获得巨量的升级经验，原来升级可以这么简单
【奖励】游戏中的奖励层出不穷，每日奖励都给你不一样的惊喜
【战斗】全自动战斗模式，解放双手，更轻松的养成角色和欣赏剧情
【副本】精彩而富有挑战的副本，大量的奖励，等你来拿
【音乐】当怀旧的音乐在你耳边响起时，宛如又穿越到了几十年前，荡气回肠，豪情万丈
 独特的故事设定，包含了大量的武侠爱情情节（分支剧情，需要探索）与人生体悟，告别无聊鼓噪的打怪升级套路，每一次游戏都给您带来一种独特的体验，让您的的武侠世界充满了丝丝的柔情和人生的酸爽！
 热烈欢迎各位玩家体验游戏，并提供宝贵的建议！

bluejetty:00174448:ios.description:
iCollect Books is the #1 library app on the app store! Used by over 2000 teachers in the state of Tennessee for managing their classroom libraries. 
This app is perfect for managing your book collection, library, or inventory, whether at home, work, or school and classrooms (it's a favorite for teachers). This app works on all device sizes and syncs directly with our iPhone, iPad, Mac apps, as well as our apps on other platforms. Scan in or search for any book you own or want and add them to your lists. Full of incredible features!
• Manage and inventory any book.
• Loaded with millions of books from around the world in our database.
• Full barcode scanning and database search.
• Cloud Backup
• Sync across multiple devices, including iPad, iPhone, Mac, and more.
• Supports input in any language and allows selections of any country and currency.
• Filters, sorting, and importing.
• Three different custom layouts.
• Exporting
• Multi-level sorting
• Shake to Select
• Default Field Data
• Customize which fields are displayed
• Section Counts
• Share your book collection with friends or on social media like Facebook and Twitter.
• Format your Titles with A, An, or The removed.
• Extra features like colored Themes, Dark Mode support, and more.
• Every field is editable.
• Store up to four pictures per book, including front, back, and inside images of books.
• Personal details per book including Loaned, Purchase Price, Purchase Date, Date Added, Personal Rating, Last Read, Storage Location, Notes, Estimated Value, and more.
• Index bars and search for quick access in large book collections.
This app is a completely new collecting experience, written from the ground up for iOS 18, the latest devices like iPhone 16, 16 Pro, 16 Pro Max, SE 2, iPad Pro, and full Universal iPhone/iPad support built-in and syncs directly to our Mac app. Our app was created with a cloud database backend designed specifically to allow each item to be stored with its own individual attributes.
We can import your book collection from nearly anywhere: CLZ Books, Delicious Library, BookBuddy, and much more. Just send us your import file and we'll get you rolling.
Note: Large collections require an in-app purchase to unlock unlimited storage. You will be prompted when you reach the limits of your selected collectible type.
Data provided by Amazon, Google, eBay, and users like you.
-------
PRIVACY INFO
-------
All of these are OPTIONAL when using our app.
Email Address: We only collect this if you enable Cloud Sync as a login user ID.
Contacts: We only use your contacts if you want us to for "Loaned To" fields.
Photos or Videos: We only use photos that you choose for your item details.
Camera: We only use this for barcode scanning.
None of your data is sold. See our Privacy Policy URL for details.
We do use Google Firebase and Facebook SDK's for analytics and crash data. See their policies for additional details on what they may track about your device.
-------
TERMS OF USE: https://www.icollecteverything.com/privacy-policy/

Soltaris : AI Photo to Video is an advanced AI-powered application that transforms your photos into engaging and dynamic videos in just a few taps. With intelligent animation technology, the app brings still images to life by adding natural movements, creative effects, and cinematic transitions.
The app is designed for users who want to turn ordinary photos into eye-catching video content without needing complex editing tools. Simply upload a photo, select an AI effect, and let Soltaris generate a short animated video automatically. The result is a smooth and realistic animation that makes your image look alive.
Soltaris offers a wide collection of AI video effects and trending animations. Users can apply different motion styles such as walking animations, spin effects, hair movement, dancing styles, and other popular social media trends. These effects help transform static portraits into engaging short videos suitable for sharing online.
The application features a simple and modern interface that allows users to quickly upload images, choose from available AI effects, and generate videos. The preview system lets users check the result before saving it to their device. Once the video is generated, it can be saved directly to the gallery and shared across social media platforms.
Soltaris also includes a library of trending templates that are constantly updated. This ensures users always have access to fresh and creative video styles. Whether you want to create fun content, social media reels, profile videos, or animated portraits, Soltaris provides an easy way to produce high-quality AI videos.
Soltaris : AI Photo to Video is the perfect tool for creators, social media users, and anyone who wants to transform their photos into creative and engaging video content with the power of artificial intelligence.

• Multiple trending AI video templates and styles
• Simple photo upload and instant video generation
• Preview your generated videos before saving

• Clean and user-friendly interface
• Fast AI processing for quick results

bluejetty:00013909:ios.summary: Manage your accounts securely and easily, any time, any place, with the CAMPUS USA Mobile Banking App. Quickly view account balances, pay bills, send and receive money with Zelle®, deposit checks, locate the nearest service center, and more
bluejetty:00013909:ios.description:
Manage your accounts securely and easily, any time, any place, with the CAMPUS USA Mobile Banking App. Quickly view account balances, pay bills, send and receive money with Zelle®, deposit checks, locate the nearest service center, and more.
Manage Your Accounts
 • Customize your home screen to view the accounts that are most important to you
 • Review transactions and balances of all your CAMPUS accounts
 • Deposit checks
 • View eDocuments
 • View credit card transaction history and schedule payments
 • Apply for an auto loan, credit card, mortgage, personal loan, and more
 • Add an additional checking or savings account
Payments & Transfers
 • Send and receive money with Zelle®
 • Set up and manage bill pay
 • Transfer funds between your CAMPUS accounts
 • Set up and manage external transfers to other financial institutions
 • Transfer funds to another CAMPUS member
 • Make loan payments
Budget and Tracking
 • Set goals and track your spending with the free personal finance management tool
Financial Management Tool
 • Create custom account alerts based on account activity
 • Connect your accounts to QuickBooks through Direct Connect
Security
 • Securely log in to the app with Touch ID® or Face ID®
 • Set up and manage security alerts 
 • Update your contact information
Contact Us
 • Schedule an appointment to meet with a CAMPUS Representative
 • Locate a CAMPUS Service Center or ATM near you
 • Securely chat with a CAMPUS Representative during normal business hours
See the CAMPUS USA Online Service Agreement and Disclosure at campuscu.com/online-disclosures for more information. 1. There is no charge from CAMPUS, but message and data rates may apply. Such charges include those from your communications service provider. Delivery of alerts may be delayed for various reasons, including service outages affecting your phone, wireless or internet provider; technology failures; and system capacity limitations. 2. U.S. checking or savings account required to use Zelle®. Transactions between enrolled users typically occur within minutes and generally do not incur transaction fees. Zelle® and the Zelle® related marks are wholly owned by Early Warning Services, LLC and are user herein under license. 3. Check deposits are subject to verification and not available for immediate withdrawal. See CAMPUS USA Mobile Deposit Agreement and Disclosure at campuscu.com/online-disclosure for restrictions. 4. FaceID, iPhone, iPad, and Touch ID are registered trademarks of Apple, Inc. 
The minimum repayment period is 60 days, and the maximum repayment period is 120 months. The Credit Union permits early payoff without penalty. The maximum Annual Percentage Rate (APR) is 17.99%. For example, a $30,100 loan at 8.69% for 48 months would require 47 monthly payments of $747.32 and a final payment of $746.77, a finance charge of $5,870.781 for a total of payments of $35,870.81. The amount financed is $30,000.00, and the APR is 8.86%.
Insured by the NCUA.

bluejetty:00152117:ios.description:
The Simple Way to Lose Weight with AI Calorie Tracker & Support
Losing weight shouldn’t feel like a second job. WeightBuddy simplifies weight loss with an AI calorie tracker and food tracker that make logging meals effortless. Just snap a photo, get instant calorie insights, and follow a personalized diet built for real life. Whether you want to burn fat, improve nutrition, or finally stick to a diet that works, WeightBuddy makes the process clear and easy so you can lose weight without stress.
WeightBuddy combines a fast calorie counter with supportive guidance from Buddy, your AI companion. Instead of complicated charts or overwhelming menus, you get a calorie tracker that understands your meals, tracks macros and fat, and adapts to your goals. This creates a smoother weight management system that helps you lose weight in minutes a day.
How WeightBuddy Helps You Lose Weight Effortlessly
1. Snap Your Food — AI Tracks Calories Instantly
Skip the typing and searching. The AI calorie tracker analyzes meals in seconds, giving accurate calorie, fat, and macro data. As a food tracker, it removes guesswork and makes your personalized diet easy to follow.
2. Smart Calorie Counter for Real-Life Nutrition
The calorie counter learns your patterns, helping you understand calories and nutrition without overwhelm. It supports flexible eating, better decisions, and long-term weight loss. Whether you’re cutting fat or improving your diet, the calorie tracker keeps things simple.
3. Built-In Intermittent Fasting Tools
If you practice intermittent fasting, WeightBuddy helps you stay consistent. Track fasting windows, support fat burning, and combine fasting with calorie awareness to improve weight management naturally.
4. Personalized Diet Guidance from Buddy
Buddy provides encouraging tips based on your calorie intake, nutrition habits, and fat-burning goals. This personalized diet approach supports weight loss without judgment. You’ll always know your next best step.
5. Clear Progress Tracking for Better Weight Management
See how your calorie tracking adds up day after day. With a simple calorie counter and food tracker, you can measure progress, understand patterns, and lose weight with confidence.

bluejetty:00141345:ios.description:
Sign up for a free account on the Western Union Send2Corrections app and send money to an inmate the easy way. You can register for a free Western Union money transfer profile via the app or website. Once you have, it's as simple as choosing 'Pay Inmate' to get started with transferring money securely to loved ones in prison or jail. At Western Union, we empower you to pay your own way, with payments available from a credit/debit card.
You'll need to have the inmate's name, account number and their correctional facility in hand for a smooth transaction. Each money transfer is allocated a Money Transfer Control Number (or MTCN) for tracking, to give you complete peace of mind. The MTCN is given on the receipt of each money transfer set up for simple money transfer tracking. In the app you'll also be able to review your transaction history and save account details for previous financial receivers. Western Union Send2Corrections money transfer is available for both federal and state prisons, as well as county jail. 
With the Send2Corrections app you can send money to correctional facilities in a flash, with multiple in-app security features available for your protection, including: 
 • Manual or Face ID login, plus multi-factor authentication
 • Password reset via app or web 24/7
 We're also empowering you to make repeat transfers even faster with:
 • Speedy 1-click resend transfer options
 • Saving card information to your profile for easy access
 • Debit and credit card payments accepted from all providers
Service provided by Western Union.

Experience the ease and enjoyment of meal planning with MealPlanner. We believe planning your meals should be quick and straightforward, with organized weekly meal plans for added convenience.
- Plan meals easily with a user-friendly interface
- Create and customize meal plans for different weeks
- Quick overview of weekly meals at a glance
- Easily create and share recipes

- Collaborate with others by sharing your meal plans for a shared and enjoyable experience

- Harness AI to generate meal plans by combining your chosen diet with your favourite cuisines
- Generate any recipe you desire with the tap of a button using AI
- Discover and import recipes from a vast range of diets and cuisines from some the world's top food bloggers
- Get step by step instructions with cooking mode

* Plan meals effortlessly with a seemless user experience.
* Create meal plans with as much or as little information you want to provide.
* Rapidly build up your meal plans with autocompletion.
* Copy and paste meals and entire meal plans to save time.

* Create your own recipes and add them to meal plans.
* Discover new recipes from various diets and cuisines.
* Share them with friends and family. 
* Add as much, or a little information as you like. 
* Import recipes and add them to your recipe book (Gold required)
Grocery Lists
* Ensure you have everything you need for delicious meals.
* Share your shopping lists with friends and family for easy collaboration.
* Seamlessly generate grocery lists directly from your meal plans (Gold required)
Synchronization
* Seamless synchronization across different devices.
* Access your meal plans, recipes, and grocery lists on the go.
Cooking Mode (Gold required)
* Enhance your cooking experience.
* Step-by-step cooking guidance through each recipe.
Plan meals to fit around a busy lifestyle. You can add as much, or as little information as you like to make meal plans your own. Whether you're planning meals for the week, creating shopping lists, or exploring new recipes, MealPlanner adapts to your needs.

On-Demand

• Share stories easily from within the app.
Additional features

Protect your privacy with TalkSafe.
In today's digital world, your personal number is a key to your identity. TalkSafe gives you a private 2nd phone number to keep your personal life separate and your real number secure. Stop giving out your real number to apps, online shops, or new acquaintances.
Use your TalkSafe number as your dedicated private line. It's the safe, easy, and reliable way to communicate without worry, giving you a powerful layer of privacy in any situation.
TalkSafe is the perfect for:
• Online Dating & Meeting New People
• Classifieds & Online Marketplaces (like Facebook Marketplace)
• Social Media & App Signups (for verification codes)
• Renting, shopping, or any online form
• Any time you need a private line and don't want to share your real number!
Get your TalkSafe number and keep your real number for your most trusted contacts.
Key Features:
• Get Your Private Number: Instantly get a new, private US or Canada number to use for all your safe calls and texts.
• Secure Unlimited Texting: Send and receive unlimited texts, pictures, and messages in a secure environment. No "credits" needed—just simple, unlimited texting.
• Private Unlimited Calling: Make crystal-clear, high-quality voice calls without revealing your primary number. No "credits" needed—just simple, unlimited calling.
• Passcode Security: Protect your private conversations by locking the TalkSafe app with a passcode.
• Keep Your Identity Safe: Communicate confidently, knowing your personal number is hidden.
• Block Unwanted Callers: Easily block spam, bots, or unwanted calls to your TalkSafe number.
• Works Everywhere (Global): Works on Wi-Fi or mobile data, so you can make calls from anywhere in the world without roaming fees.
• Simple, Secure Interface: A clean, easy-to-use app designed for your privacy.
• Dark & Light Themes: Choose the look that fits your style.
You will get a virtual number only with an active subscription.

bluejetty:00068151:ios.name: Nirnay
bluejetty:00068151:ios.summary:
Nirnay, Gujarati Calendar 2026
A simple Gujarati (Hindu) calendar with the traditional print copy look and feel but with the added benefit of user interaction to find more details about a specific date. The calendar will help you to find wh
bluejetty:00068151:ios.description:
Nirnay, Gujarati Calendar 2026
A simple Gujarati (Hindu) calendar with the traditional print copy look and feel but with the added benefit of user interaction to find more details about a specific date. The calendar will help you to find when the next Ekadashi is, what the Paksha (Sud,Vad) on a particular day is, when the next Poonam is (Full Moon) or the next Amavasya is and many more Hindu events in easy visual representations; due to images being used to represent key events, even a person who cannot read Gujarati is able to use the app.
In Vedic timekeeping, a tithi is a lunar day, or the time it takes for the longitudinal angle between the Moon and the Sun to increase by 12°. Tithis begin at varying times of the day and vary in duration from approximately 19 to approximately 26 hours. Tithi therefore is one of the most important aspect of the Indian Almanac or the Panchang as Hindu festivals and ceremonies are calculated based on this. The Hindu Calendar system is based upon the motion of the moon, each lunar year comprises of twelve months, each lunar year comprises of 354 days. This in comparison to the usual Georgian (English) calendar that we all use, leads to a difference in the number of days as the Georgian year consists of 365 ¼ days since it is based on the solar (Sun) system. To align the solar year with the lunar year, an additional month is added to the Hindu calendar every 3 years, this additional month is called Adhik Maas (Additional/Extra Month). Each and every second in vedic timekeeping is part of a Muhrat (moment), these can be auspicious or inauspicious depending on nakshatra and tithi (which are also auspicious and inauspicious)… sounds very complicated? It is complicated for most of us; thankfully we have this Nirnay iOS App which combines the lunar and solar calendar into an easy to understand format so that we can easily find out when we should celebrate Hindu festivals, when the most auspicious times are for various religious (and non-religious) activities so that we do things at a Muhrat which is good.

bluejetty:00133597:ios.description:
Ultimate texas holdem is popular poker variant played against the dealer ,
where both Dealer and player get 2 cards each.
The player is allowed to look at his cards and decide if he wishes to check or raise.
How To Play:
1.The game is played with a single 52-card deck.
2.The player must make an equal bet on both the Ante and Blind, and can also make an optional Trips bet.
3.Two cards are dealt face down to the player and dealer. The player may look at his own cards.
4.The player can check or make a Play bet equal to three or four times the Ante.
4.Then dealer turns over three community cards.
5.If the player previously checked, then he may make a Play bet equal to two times his Ante. If the player already made a Play bet, then he may not bet further.
6.Two final community cards are turned over.
7.If the player previously checked twice, then he must either make a Play bet equal to exactly his Ante, or fold, losing both his Ante and Blind bets. If the player already raised he may not bet further.
8.The player and dealer will both make the best possible hand using any combination of their own two cards and the five community cards.
9.The dealer will need at least a pair to open.Anything below that ante betts will push
The Game offers Following 
1. 2 hourly bonus
2. Weekly Ranking , shows ranking based on balance , it refreshes at start of week that is Monday
3. Achivements : 39 achievements to claim within your app 
4. Multile tables to bet on (40) starting from 1000 and goes in trillion 
5. Bet amount increases as you move on to higher tables , higher the table more amount of ante 
6. Tables have maximum limit you can bet on , it increases as your level in the game iincrease .
7. Multiple wager options. 
8. Many Tables , ranging from small to high Maximum bets
Poker Ranking is as follows 
 The poker hand rankings, from weakest to strongest, are as follows:
1.High card
2.One pair
3.Two pair
4.Three-of-a-kind
5.Straight
6.Flush
7.Full house
8.Four-of-a-kind
9.Straight flush
10.Royal Flush
The game is designed to give you best experience with poker game .Play and enjoy

bluejetty:00144951:ios.description:
From the beginning, we've been more than a delivery service; Circle is your go to for everything essential — Select from over 10,000+ items from grocery, bakery, coffee, beauty and hygiene products, and more, all delivered in less than 20 minutes, thanks to our network of dark-stores and swift last-mile service. Circle has become a symbol of efficiency and speed.
Circle - Groceries & More in 15 Minutes!
Circle is a highly efficient delivery service with a diverse selection of products delivered to your doorstep in just 15 minutes. Select from over 10,000+ items available in its extensive catalog, from fresh produce, snacks, and ready - made meals, to beverages, household essentials, personal and baby care items, and even pet food. You can also enjoy an array of special offers and discounts with our in-app promotions and coupons.
Circle is there for your late-night cravings, for a last minute grocery while you plan to unleash your inner home-chef on a weekend, for a quick cold brew coffee to get you through your mornings!
With Circle, you can order from your app and get your items delivered to your location within minutes.
Why Circle?
With Circle, we bring your groceries to your doorstep in just minutes, whether it's day or night, and at prices comparable to your local grocery store, with a free delivery, making the whole process even better. You can choose from over 10,000+ products across a wide range of products from popular brands you would find in your regular supermarket, ensuring that you're fully covered.
The categories of products we deliver:
► Fruits & Vegetables
► Bakery
► Dairy & Eggs
► Meat & Fish
► Deli 
► Beverages
► Ice Cream
► Breakfast
► Frozen
► Sweets & Snacks
► Vegan & Vegetarian
► Baby Products
► Toiletries
► Household Items
► Pet essentials
Smooth experience
Say goodbye to substitutions, too, our inventory is updated in real-time, ensuring you receive precisely what you ordered without substitutions. 
Circle’s delivery service is also contact-free to help you stay safe.
No more waiting in long grocery lines because we value your time.
No more wasting time stocking your fridge, as your groceries will arrive in minutes. 
We are faster
With our large network of mini stores where our riders pack your order, we ensure a fast and efficient delivery. Although speed is our mission, safety is key, our delivery riders are trained to follow traffic rules and ensure prompt and secure delivery of groceries. 
How to get the app
Simply download the Circle app, place an order, and enjoy lightning-fast delivery. Plus, Circle offers in-app promotions and coupons, making it an even more cost-effective option. 
Enjoy a discount on your first delivery and join the Circle family today!

bluejetty:00162382:ios.name: Cheap Flights online
bluejetty:00162382:ios.description:
The application for finding the cheapest prices for air tickets allows you to:
• find the best deals from airlines;
• use the sorting of air tickets by price, departure, arrival, rating;
• use convenient filters when choosing airline tickets: (morning, afternoon, evening), by the number of transfers, airlines, airports and payment methods;
• compare prices for air tickets in different companies, both with transfers and direct flights;
• book a plane ticket online (there is a choice of currency and different payment methods).
How to use the app
1. Choose a simple or complex search method.
2. Select a departure date and a return date.
3. Select the number of passengers.
4. Set the price category of the flight - economy or business.
5. Click on the button below "Search tickets".
6. In search results, use filters and sort order of offers.
7. Go to the page with the best offer.
8. Next, you can go to the airline's website and book a plane ticket online.
Important to know
This application acts as an aggregator (search engine) for low-cost flight tickets. We do not set prices, nor do we add any markups. The application developer is not a ticket seller. To book and purchase tickets, the application redirects users to the websites of the respective ticket sellers. Any questions regarding pricing, payment, or customer service should be addressed directly with the seller.

Go2 works like a minibus that comes when you want, where you want - book rides in seconds, get picked up steps from your door, and access the Muskegon metro area without needing a car.

SHARED.
Our tech matches people headed in the same direction. This means you’re getting the convenience and comfort of a private ride with the efficiency, speed, and affordability of a public one.
SUSTAINABLE.
Sharing rides reduces the number of vehicles on the roads, bringing down congestion and CO2 emissions. With a couple of taps, you get to do your part to make your city a little bit greener and cleaner, every time you ride.
AFFORDABLE
Aggregating people into one vehicle brings down prices. Visit https://matsbus.com/go2/ for up to date pricing information.
Questions? Head to https://matsbus.com/go2/ or reach out at support-muskegon@ridewithvia.com.

bluejetty:00127734:ios.description:
Your allergy progress at a glance.
Track your symptoms, triggers and treatments, take notes and visualize it!
Want to share it with your doctor? No problem, just generate a printable report!
Want a personalized experience? Define your own symptoms and treatments!
HOW ALLERGY TRACKER° WORKS
- Track your symptoms
- Add any triggers
- Track your treatments
- Write notes
- Have an easy overview of how you are doing
- Recognize patterns
- Analyze your statistics over time
- Create PDF or CSV reports and share them with your doctor
- Define your own symptoms and treatments
- Collect new achievements
- Stay on track with daily reminders
- Lock your journal with Face ID or Touch ID
We value your privacy. Your journal entries are just yours, only accessible with your device.
Consult with your doctor if you are experiencing any symptoms of an illness.
This software is not a replacement of a medical treatment. It is intended for informational purposes only and comes with no warranty.
You can read the terms of use and privacy policy here:
http://adamcziko.com/allergy-tracker-privacy-policy-and-terms-of-use/
The app includes a premium subscription possibility.
The subscription is automatically renewed after each subscription period.
Want to get to know more about your current subscription, or you want to cancel it?
You can get all the information by visiting the following page:
https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039

bluejetty:00156604:ios.name: HomeTrail App
bluejetty:00156604:ios.summary:
From our home to yours — the tools you need for happy homeschooling.
HomeTrail keeps your family's learning in one calm place: plan the week, capture what happened, and see how far you've come.
Day: Your homeschool day at a glance. Check
bluejetty:00156604:ios.description:
From our home to yours — the tools you need for happy homeschooling.
HomeTrail keeps your family's learning in one calm place: plan the week, capture what happened, and see how far you've come.
Day: Your homeschool day at a glance. Check off attendance, nature time and your Rhythm in a tap, see what's planned, and find ideas to explore.
Rhythm: The steady routines that shape your weeks, from morning read-alouds to Friday nature walks, laid out simply and easy to adjust.
Planner: Plan your weeks with your own activities and curriculum. Each activity shows its latest photo, so your plans look like your family.
Capture Learning: Snap a photo, jot a note, tag the children and subjects. Small moments become a record you'll be glad you kept.
Journey: Your family's learning as a trail. Scroll back through the days, the work and the wins.
Nature Time: A good day is spent outside! Track time in nature every day and watch it add up over the year.
Portfolios and reports: Gather your best work into portfolios and see attendance, subjects and progress whenever you need them.
Daily check-in: Less time on devices, more time on what matters. Get a short text at the end of the day and log how it went with a quick reply.
HomeTrail Plus adds more help when you want it:
• TrailGuide: log learning and attendance, send photos of finished work, and ask what's planned, all by text.
• Nest: personalized learning packs and printable daily editions for each child.
• Compass: a clear picture of where each learner is.
• Create Materials: worksheets and activities tailored to your children.
• Grading, transcripts, portfolio sharing and family access.
Your planner and record keeping are free.

Albertsons Market for U Grocery Deals & Delivery 
Shop, save & simplify your meal planning with Albertsons Market for U’s all-in-one grocery app. Find everything you need, from fresh produce to pet food and pharmacy prescriptions.  Choose convenience that fits your schedule: grocery delivery or DriveUp & Go™ grocery pickup service. 
CONVENIENT GROCERY DELIVERY OR PICKUP 
Get grocery delivery or choose DriveUp & Go™ for easy curbside grocery pickup. Use Schedule & Save to automate your household essentials and save more on every order. Flash™ 30-minute delivery available in select markets for additional convenience. 
SEND GROCERIES AS A GIFT 
Shop, add a personalized message & send fresh groceries, flowers, chocolates or everyday essentials to anyone — delivered to their door or ready for store pickup. Select "Make this order a gift" at checkout, with no extra gifting fees. bluejetty:00097895:ios.description:
Gravity's Ragnarok X : Next Generation Redefine RO Classic Adventure - Over 20 Million Players Worldwide
ROX is the official next-gen evolution of the classic Ragnarok Online MMORPG. With enhanced visuals, strategic combat, and diverse gameplay, ROX stays true to its roots while offering Fair Loot, Free Trading, and Ture Adventures. Your legend begins now— Are you ready?
◈ A Classic Reborn: Fair and Free ◈
ROX honors the original *Ragnarok Online*'s story, world, and job system while upgrading everything else: a more immersive world, better controls, modern graphics, and seamless mobile-to-cross play. Built for both veterans and newcomers, ROX is the future of classic MMORPGs.
◈ A Real Player-Driven Economy ◈
Just earn, trade, and thrive. In ROX, powerful gear comes from fair boss drops and player-to-player trading. Predict market trends, master the auction house, and compete with thousands of players in one shared economy. This is Trade-to-Win, not Cash-to-Win.
◈ A Living World of Adventures and Battles ◈
Embark on solo quests, challenge dungeons, or team up for massive multiplayer events. 
Explore diverse zones filled with epic storylines and real challenges. Join a guild, make lifelong friends, and experience a warm, social MMO community. From PvE raids to PvP arenas and GvG wars — Midgard is alive, and waiting.
◈ Deep Job & Gear Customization ◈
ROX features a rich class system rooted in deep lore — including newly introduced 3rd-tier jobs. Combine gear, skills, and strategies to create your own unique hero. Victory comes from smart builds and skilled play. Teamwork and class synergy are the keys to mastering battle.
◈ Life Skills, Crafting, and In-Game Prosperity ◈
Fish, garden, cook, mine, raise pets, and profit. ROX features a full life skill and crafting system where everything you produce—potions, food, gear—can be sold to other players. Build your in-game livelihood and even earn while playing.
◈ Iconic Monsters Return, Nostalgia Rekindled ◈
Step back into a world filled with familiar faces and unforgettable foes. From the charming Poring and mischievous **Golden Thief Bug**, to legendary bosses like **Osiris**, **Lord of Death**, and **Baphomet**—ROX brings the heart of Ragnarok Online back in full force.
◈ Cross-Platform Play for Unmatched Flexibility ◈
One of ROX's standout features is its seamless cross-platform play. Whether you're on mobile or PC, your progress is saved across all devices, allowing you to continue your adventure wherever you are. 
Begin your next-gen RO adventure now！Craft your legend and create your own path in Midgard!

bluejetty:00066006:ios.summary:
Magoosh has helped MILLIONS of students pass their GRE!
Master the 1500 most important GRE words with free flashcards! Practice every day to improve your vocab knowledge. Study to rectify your benightedness and prepare to trounce the GRE v
bluejetty:00066006:ios.description:
Magoosh has helped MILLIONS of students pass their GRE!
Master the 1500 most important GRE words with free flashcards! Practice every day to improve your vocab knowledge. Study to rectify your benightedness and prepare to trounce the GRE verbal section!
• 1500 vocab words picked by an expert GRE tutor
• Definitions and example sentences for every word
• Decks for every difficulty level
• Track your progress as you study
• Smart algorithm focuses your practice for efficient learning
This app gives you access to all of Magoosh’s GRE vocab flash cards.
Who makes the flashcards?
===
The entire GRE wordlist is selected and defined with usage examples by Magoosh’s expert GRE tutor, Chris Lele. He has been teaching the GRE for more than 10 years, runs a popular vocabulary series on YouTube and he’s also written an eBook on vocabulary. He is nigh unbeatable in Scrabble, or any other word game for that matter.
How well will I learn the words?
===
Academic research has found that memories are formed by repeated exposure to new information, so Magoosh’s flashcard app uses a spaced repetition system. Words you are learning will reappear frequently (occurring less frequently the better you know them) and words you already know won’t be repeated. The GRE word list is culled so that you focus on only the most important words.
Your practice will focus on the words that you need to review the most to make sure the words you learn will really stick.
What is Magoosh?
===
Magoosh is an online test prep company with a focus on teaching the GRE.
The Magoosh team blogs about GRE words, formulas, grammar, problem solving, quantitative reasoning, and reading comprehension along with GRE study guides and study tips.
How else should I study?
===
Search the app store for “magoosh gre” to prep for the GRE Exam with Magoosh’s video lessons app. Learn all the math, verbal, and writing you need to know for the test!
What about other tests?
===
Magoosh also has apps for GMAT prep and English grammar. Search the store for “magoosh gmat” or “magoosh english” to find them!
How do I contact you?
===
Customer satisfaction is incredibly important to us. If you have any questions or comments, please send us an email at help@magoosh.com and we’ll get back to you as quickly as we can. 
“The collection of words is great. I liked the visual indication of the three categories and their progress.”
“The Magoosh staff was awesome; I peppered them with questions and requests and they always responded thoroughly and quickly.”
“I didn’t have much time to prepare for the GRE, and Magoosh made it possible for me to succeed on the test in a short period of time. I looked at Kaplan GRE, Barron’s, and Princeton Review products, and I can confidently say that Magoosh was definitely the best.”
“The team is really great and actually cares about your score as much as they would care about their own. Simply the best.”
Don’t wait until the last minute to start studying, start memorizing words today!

firefox-addons:3094157.name: FireThemes
firefox-addons:3094157.summary: Nearly 100 ready-made themes for Firefox, a color editor with gradients and animations for endless customization possibilities, and automatic switching between light and dark themes. Everything stays on your computer.
firefox-addons:3094157.description:
FireThemes lets you change the look of Firefox directly from the sidebar.
- Style Library: professional dark and light themes, gradients, animated styles, and eccentric designs.
- Color Studio: customize the background, toolbar, accents, and text; create two- or three-color gradients with an adjustable angle.
- Color Animations: scrolling, breathing, pulsing, flames, rainbows, and more, with adjustable speed. No stroboscopic effects.
- Readability Check: shows whether the contrast between text and background is sufficient.
- Day/Night Automation: choose two styles and set the times for switching between them.
- Save Your Styles: save your styles and export or import them via the clipboard.
No data is collected or transmitted: the extension does not use the network and stores settings only in your browser.

apple-macos:592213926.name: Extreme Road Trip 2
apple-macos:592213926.description:
Your gas pedal is stuck AGAIN! Do stunts to get nitro boost and SLAM it all down to unlock the insane speed of OVERDRIVE! Collect coins to unlock new cars as you play! Complete missions and get rewards! 
It’s bigger, faster, and still FREE! 
The game features awesome music by Jimmy "Big Giant Circles" Hinson (of "Mass Effect 2" fame) and is frequently updated with more content. 
== Features == 
* Extremely fast and addictive gameplay 
* Unlock cars as you progress 
* 36 all-new cars with more to come 
* Complete missions to get rewards and master every car 
* Flips, wheelies, close calls, slams and other new stunts 
* Race against your friends’ replays 
* Huge gratifying explosions 
* Drive in 10 exciting locations 
* Use all-new power-ups like the coin magnet 
* Addictive music that makes your blood pump 
* Game Center Challenges, Achievements and Leaderboards
* Amazing on a big screen :) 
* Free! 
If you’re into free awesome things that are fun, this is a game you should download!
